description:
NATIONAL LOCAL GOVERNMENT FINANCE COMMITTEE

Governance to Enable Service Delivery (GESD) Project – GESD 2.0

                                           Agreement No:  IDA-E6540

Individual Consultant- Environmental Safeguard Specialist (ESS)  

No: MW-NLGFC-563908-CS-INDIV

Date of Issue: 20th August ,2026

 

  1. Background

 

The Government of Malawi (GoM) through the National Local Government Finance Committee (NLGFC) has received financing towards the cost of Governance to Enable Service Delivery (GESD) Project – GESD 2.0. The NLGFC intends to apply part of the proceeds of this financing to eligible payments under the contract for hiring Environmental Safeguard Specialist (ESS) on a three - year contract renewable annually based on performance and availability of financial resources or mutually agreed by both parties.    

 

NLGFC therefore invites applications from suitably qualified and interested candidates to fill the position of Environmental Safeguard Specialist (ESS) tenable at the NLGFC Offices.

 

The terms of Reference (TORs) for Environmental Safeguard Specialist (ESS) are as follows:

 

2. The Objectives of the Assignment

The Environnmental Safeguard Specilaist will ensure that GESD 2.0 activities comply with the Worlad Bank ESF and ESH guidelines as outlined in the governing Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (ESCP), and Project Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF) including all the supporting management plans as appropriate

3. Duties and Responsibilities

 

The duties will include but will not be limited to:

 

  1. coordination and provision of technical supervision, monitor and report on Environment safeguards in line with the national laws and in conformity with the Environmental and Social Framework of the World Bank and international best practices under the project;
  2. Provision of preventive and protective measures, including modification, substitution, or elimination of environmental risks and impacts; and
  3. Design and development of training programme for district officers, contractors and workers etc.
  4. Support the eligible local authorities in conducting environmental and social screening followed by the timely development and disclosure of Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs) of all sub-project activities implemented by local authorities with the aim of incorporating due processes as standard practice in social and environmental safeguards implementation;
  5. Conduct reviews of ESMPs of all the subprojects developed by the local authorities in compliance with Environmental and Social Management Framework (ESMF) and the Resettlement Policy Framework (RPF), RAPs, and other relevant E and S instruments to ensure quality and timely submission;
  6. Provide and review environmental and social inputs into the planning, design and contracting of investments, including the preparation of tender documents in line with the Environmental and Social Frameworks (ESF);
  7. Develop and implement an internal administrative tracking system for the PIU in order to monitor the progress of project activities in terms of meeting environmental and social safeguard requirements. The system will include the planning, assessment, approval, implementation and monitoring phases of GESD 2.0 Project activities. The system will be computer based (using a spread sheet or Microsoft Access) and designed for easy data entry and report generation. Reports generated by the system should be simple to produce, showing progress of a specific project activity, and highlight critical items such as pending or overdue actions;
  8. Design and deliver, or arrange for the delivery of, an environmental and social safeguards capacity building program for local authorities’ staff and other relevant stakeholders with the purpose of strengthening capacity of local authorities to implement environmental and social safeguard requirements effectively within the context of larger GESD 2.0 activities;
  9. Following up implementation of environmental screening and implementation of ESMPs and Social response operations at sector and district levels through EDOs (local authority staff);
  10. Undertaking review of CESMPs and provide feedback to local authorities;
  11. Undertake spots checks on compliance monitoring of Contractors Environmental and Social Management Plan for PBG sub-projects;
  12. Undertaking site visits and reviewing contractors' compliance with site-specific CESMPs, Labour Management Procedures (LMPs), Codes of Conducts etc. including determining and suggesting remedial actions in collaboration with the Environmental Expert and Occupational Safety and Health (OHS) Expert;
  13. Preparation of non-compliance reports and keeping track of respective responses/actions undertaken and preparation of periodic Environmental Compliance Monitoring Reports;
  14. Participating at the official meetings with the Bank and other forums related to the project;
  15. Undertake internal E&S Audits and support consultants in the preparation of external E&S Audits, and track the implementation of the corrective and remedial action plans by the district and municipal councils;
  16. Provide inputs and materials to Communication Specialist for devising communication strategy, knowledge products and dissemination of results;
  17. Timely preparation and submission of monthly, quarterly, annual and period reports to the Project Coordinator, Executive Director and World Bank task team; and
  18. Performing any other duties as may be necessary for the effective implementation of the project as assigned by Project Coordinator and or Director of Social and Economic Services.

 

4.      Qualifications and Experience

 

The candidate should meet the following qualifications:

 

  1. Master’s Degree in Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resources Management, Environmental Policy and Analysis; Environmental Management and Economics;
  2. A minimum of 8 years of experience in the field of environmental management at National level or international organization, and donor projects handling environmental and social aspects of planning, assessing and managing civil works projects of various scale in Malawi or similar African countries;
  3. Working knowledge of World Bank environmental and social frameworks, especially Environmental and Social Assessment (ESS1), Land Acquisition, Restriction on Land Use and Involuntary Resettlement (ESS5), and have demonstrated experience in successfully preparing ESIAs, ESMPs and RAPs in line with World Bank standards, policies will be considered an advantage;
  4. Working knowledge of regulations in Malawi related to Environmental and Social issues;
  5. Experience with designing and delivering capacity building programs;
  6. Familiarity with Article VI of Paris 21 Agreement; environmental, social and economic conditions prevailing in Malawi or similar African countries;
  7. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, as well as team participation and management skills;
  8. Strong organizational and communications skills and ability to interface with grassroots, district and sector players in the discipline;

AVIS A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET N°2026-040M/MAERAH/SG/DMP

SOLLICITATION DE MANIFESTATION D'INTERET POUR LE RECRUTEMENT D’UN AUDITEUR DE PROBITE AU PROFIT DU PROJET DE SECURITE DE L’EAU AU BURKINA FASO (PSE-BF).

 

N° de référence STEP :    BF-PIF-567185-CS-QBS

Pays : Burkina Faso

Projet : Projet de Sécurité de l’Eau au Burkina Faso (PSE-BF)

Projet ID : P177094

Financement : Crédit IDA n° 7559-BF.

 

Le Gouvernement du Burkina Faso a reçu un crédit de l'Association internationale de développement (IDA), et a l'intention d'utiliser une partie du montant de ce crédit pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat suivant : Sélection d’un consultant (firme) pour l’audit de probité au profit du Projet de Sécurité de l’Eau au Burkina Faso.

L'objectif du recrutement de l’Auditeur de Probité est de s'assurer que les procédures et l’examen appropriés sont mis en place pour maintenir l'intégrité du processus de passation et d'exécution des marchés (composantes 1 et 2).

La mission s’inscrit dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre des activités des composantes 1 « Sécurité et résilience climatique des infrastructures de stockage d’eau », 2 « Développement d’infrastructures hydro-agricoles intelligentes face au climat » et 5 « Gestion du projet » du PSE-BF, et couvre la période 2026-2030.

Il est attendu que cet audit permette à l’équipe du PSE-BF et à ses partenaires de :

  • Veiller au respect des procédures de passation des marchés en vérifiant que les processus sont correctement suivis et conformes aux règlements en vigueur ;
  • S’assurer que les prestations des Bureaux de suivi contrôle des travaux sont conformes aux exigences contractuelles ;
  • S’assurer de la conformité des travaux aux spécifications techniques et autres documents techniques régissant les activités ;
  • Formuler des recommandations pour renforcer la probité des activités techniques et financières du projet.

De façon pratique, l’auditeur de probité devra :

 

1. En matière de surveillance de la conformité éthique

L’auditeur de probité doit effectuer un suivi en temps réel. Il vérifie que :

  • les décisions prises (avenants, modifications de contrat) ne cachent pas de favoritisme ou de détournement de l'objet initial du marché ;
  • les relations entre les agents publics et le titulaire du contrat restent strictement professionnels pour prévenir tout conflit d'intérêts ;

 

2. En matière de contrôle de l'exécution technique et financière

L'auditeur examinera la réalité des prestations pour s'assurer que les fonds publics sont utilisés de manière régulière :

  • Vérification des services faits : s'assurer que les factures payées correspondent à des travaux ou services réellement exécutés selon les standards du contrat ;
  • Analyse des avenants : évaluer si les modifications contractuelles sont justifiées par des besoins techniques imprévus et non par une volonté de contourner les règles de mise en concurrence.

 

3. En matière de prévention et détection des risques de fraude

Il agit comme un rempart contre les atteintes à la probité (corruption, trafic d'influence, prise illégale d'intérêt) :

  • Signaux d'alerte : Il identifie les "red flags" durant l'exécution, comme des retards injustifiés, des paiements irréguliers ou des changements fréquents d'interlocuteurs ;
  • Bilan d'exécution : À la fin ou à des étapes clés, il dresse un bilan incluant un volet déontologique sur le déroulement du contrat.

Nature et intensité de la mission :

La mission revêt un caractère permanent et s’exécute en temps réel. Les documents de chaque procédure sont transmis en continu à l’Auditeur (flux dématérialisé) ; celui-ci émet un avis de probité, sous forme de rapport circonstancié, à chaque phase soumise à l’avis de non-objection (ANO) de la Banque mondiale — dossier d’appel d’offres, rapport d’évaluation et projet de contrat. L’audit de l’exécution technique et financière est réalisé de manière périodique sur les marchés en cours, jusqu’à la réception des travaux, et comporte des visites de terrain sur les sites de barrages et de périmètres irrigués concernés.

Les livrables attendus comprennent notamment : un rapport méthodologique, un rapport de démarrage annuel calé sur le plan de passation des marchés (PPM), les avis de probité produits au fil de l’eau, des rapports d’audit périodiques de l’exécution, un rapport de mi-parcours, ainsi que les rapports d’audit de probité provisoire et final et un rapport annuel de synthèse servant de base à l’évaluation de performance.

Le niveau d’effort minimal estimé est de soixante (60) hommes-jours par phase annuelle, dont au minimum vingt (20) jours consacrés à l’audit de la passation des marchés et vingt-cinq (25) jours à l’audit de l’exécution technique et financière ; le déroulement type d’une phase annuelle s’échelonne sur environ quatre (04) mois. L’Auditeur rend compte à l’Unité de Gestion du Projet (UGP), avec copie au MAERAH et à la Banque mondiale.

La réalisation de la mission requiert la mobilisation d’une équipe d’au moins quatre (04) experts clés — un chef de mission expert-comptable diplômé, un spécialiste des barrages (ingénieur en génie rural ou génie civil), un spécialiste financier des travaux publics et un spécialiste en passation et gestion contractuelle — dont les profils détaillés figurent dans les termes de référence. Conformément à la méthode de sélection retenue, les curriculums vitae du personnel clé ne sont pas exigés ni évalués au stade de la manifestation d’intérêt ; ils seront appréciés lors de l’examen de la proposition technique.

La langue de travail de la mission est le français ; la maîtrise de l’anglais, ainsi que d’une langue de la zone du projet, constitueront un atout.

Le contrat est conclu pour une durée de deux (02) ans, renouvelable, sans pouvoir excéder la durée de mise en œuvre du projet, soit au plus tard le 30 juin 2030. La poursuite de la mission au titre de chaque nouvelle phase est expressément conditionnée par une évaluation périodique satisfaisante des performances de l’Auditeur au titre de la période écoulée ; en cas de performance jugée non satisfaisante, l’Unité de Gestion du Projet se réserve le droit de ne pas reconduire le contrat.

La Direction des Marchés Publics du Ministère de l’Agriculture, de l’Eau, des Ressources Animales et Halieutiques invite les candidats admissibles à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Les Consultants (bureaux d’études) intéressés doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu'ils possèdent les qualifications requises et une expérience pertinente pour l'exécution des Services notamment :

  • brochures, prospectus de présentation du consultant ;
  • qualifications pour exécuter les services ;
  • référence des clients ;
  • références techniques dans les missions similaires exécutées (années de réalisation, coûts, clients et adresse/téléphone), et les attestations de bonne exécution ou les rapports de validation, etc.

NB : Les soumissionnaires joindront obligatoirement de manière chronologique et lisible, les copies des pages de garde (mentionnant l’objet, le commanditaire, le délai d’exécution) et de signature des marchés, des attestations de bonne fin pour justifier les expériences ou sous peine de nullité de la référence. Lorsque la production de la copie du contrat est empêchée par une clause de confidentialité liant le candidat à son client, celui-ci pourra produire, à titre de preuve équivalente, une attestation du client précisant l’objet, le montant, la source de financement, la période d’exécution et le rôle exact du consultant.

La participation à la concurrence est ouverte à tous les consultants éligibles au sens de la Section III du Règlement de Passation des Marchés de la Banque mondiale, en règle vis-à-vis de l’administration et qui ne font l’objet ni d’une interdiction ou suspension prononcée par les autorités nationales, ni d’une exclusion prononcée par la Banque mondiale (liste des firmes et individus exclus publiée sur www.worldbank.org/debarr).

Les pièces justificatives de la situation administrative, fiscale et sociale ne seront exigées qu’au stade de l’attribution du contrat ; les consultants étrangers pourront produire les documents équivalents délivrés par les autorités compétentes de leur pays d’établissement.

Le Consultant pourra être constitué de Cabinet d’audit financier et de Cabinet d’Ingénieur Conseil/ Bureau d’étude d’ingénierie pour renforcer leurs compétences respectives en la forme d'un groupement solidaire. Le groupement désignera son chef de file et joindra à sa manifestation d’intérêt l’accord de groupement ou, à défaut, une lettre d’intention de groupement signée par l’ensemble des membres, précisant la répartition des rôles. Les qualifications et références de l’ensemble des membres du groupement sont cumulées pour l’appréciation des critères de présélection ci-après.

NB : les missions similaires s’apprécient au regard d’une complexité similaire, entendue comme : ampleur des contrats, nature de la prestation, domaine technique et contexte géographique.

Les bureaux intéressés doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu'ils possèdent les qualifications requises pour l'exécution des services ci-dessus indiqués. Les dossiers de manifestation d'intérêt comporteront notamment :

  • une lettre de manifestation adressée à Monsieur le Ministre d’Etat, Ministre de l’Agriculture, de l’Eau, des Ressources Animales et Halieutiques (MAERAH) ;
  • une présentation du bureau faisant ressortir son identification (RCCM, IFU, localisation, adresse complète) et ses domaines de compétence ;
  • les critères de présélection :

Le candidat doit justifier, en tant que cabinet, d’une expérience professionnelle d’au moins cinq (05) ans dans les domaines de l’audit technique et/ou du suivi-contrôle des travaux de réalisation/réhabilitation de barrages et d’aménagements hydro-agricoles et de l’audit de passation des marchés, et avoir réalisé au cours des dix (10) dernières années l’une ou l’autre des combinaisons de références suivantes :

Option A — Profil « audit technique » :

    • au moins cinq (05) missions d’audit technique de réalisation/ réhabilitation de barrages ou d’infrastructures majeures de génie civil ;
    • au moins trois (03) missions d’audit de passation des marchés ;

ou

Option B — Profil « suivi-contrôle et audit financier » :

    • au moins deux (02) missions de suivi-contrôle des travaux de réalisation/réhabilitation de barrages de capacité d’au moins un million (1 000 000) de m3 ;
    • au moins trois (03) missions de suivi-contrôle des travaux de réalisation/réhabilitation de périmètres irrigués d’au moins 50 ha (par site) en maîtrise totale d’eau ;
    •  au moins trois (03) missions d’audit de passation des marchés.
    • Il devra prouver une connaissance et une expertise dans le domaine de la gestion intégrée des ressources naturelles et le suivi des projets réalisés par les sociétés d’état ou entreprises nationales.

Les références similaires doivent être justifiées par des copies de contrats (page de garde indiquant le montant et la source de financement, l’objet, le commanditaire, le délai d’exécution la page de signature, le personnel clé mobilisé par le consultant, le contact du client, le rôle du candidat en cas de groupement (chef de file ou membre), la taille des projets (Budget du programme/projet) et une attestation de bonne fin. Les expériences du consultant ou groupement de consultants sur financement multilatéral seront un atout, et à ce titre seront enregistrées et valorisées. Le consultant fournira également une fiche synthétique pour chaque mission similaire présentée.

Les références en tant que sous-traitants ne seront pas considérées.

Il est porté à l’attention des consultants que les dispositions des paragraphes 3.14, 3.16, 3.17 et 3.19 de la Section III de : « Banque mondiale, Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) », 6e édition, septembre 2025, relatifs aux règles de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts sont applicables.

À ce titre, le candidat joindra à sa manifestation d’intérêt une déclaration sur l’honneur attestant qu’il ne se trouve, directement ou par l’intermédiaire d’une entité affiliée, dans aucune situation de conflit d’intérêts avec l’Office National des Barrages et des Aménagements Hydrauliques (ONBAH), les entreprises de travaux, les bureaux de suivi-contrôle ou les maîtres d’œuvre intervenant sur les composantes 1 et 2 du PSE-BF. Le consultant retenu ne pourra, pendant toute la durée de la mission, se voir attribuer d’autres prestations d’études, de maîtrise d’œuvre, de suivi-contrôle ou de travaux au titre des marchés soumis à son audit.

Un Consultant (firme) sera sélectionné selon la méthode de Sélection fondée sur les Qualifications du Consultant (SQC), telle que décrite au paragraphe 7.11 de la Section VII du « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) » de la Banque mondiale, 6e édition, septembre 2025.

Republic of Tajikistan

Sustainable Financing for Rogun Hydropower Project (P181029)

Projects Management Group for Energy Facilities Construction under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan (PMG EFC)

Grant No.: IDA-E3800

Assignment Title: Provision of International Advisory and Technical Support Services to the Project Management Group under the President of Tajikistan

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): TJ-PMG-EFC-CS-QCBS-07

The Republic of Tajikistan has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Sustainable Financing for Rogun Hydropower Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services for Provision of International Advisory and Technical Support Services to the Project Management Group under the President of Tajikistan (PMG).

The overall objective of this assignment is to provide Project Implementing Agency with high-level technical, managerial, procurement, contract management, civil works, electromechanical, and environmental & social expertise required for effective oversight of the Rogun HPP project during the construction phase, including for the oversight of the Project Management Consultant (PMC), the HSE Supervisor, the Dam Safety Panel of Experts (DSPoE) and the Environmental and Social Panel of Experts (ESPoE) and Contractors.

The scope of services includes, among others, the following:

  1. Supporting Project Implementing Agency in the overall technical, managerial, procurement, contractual, and environmental and social oversight of the Project;
  2. Reviewing reports, deliverables, recommendations, and decisions prepared by the Project Management Consultant and other consultants;
  3. Advising Project Implementing Agency on technical, contractual, procurement, and E&S matters related to the Project;
  4. Participating in coordination meetings with the Project Management Consultant, contractors, financiers, and other stakeholders, as required by Project Implementing Agency;
  5. Supporting Project Implementing Agency in decision-making processes by providing independent professional opinions;
  6. Contributing to capacity strengthening of Project Implementing Agency through on-the-job support and knowledge transfer.

Anticipated date for commencement of the Services is April 2027 and the tentative duration of the assignment for the Services is 3 years.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the link 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aSBkt_BCeH9RthhpzxaFJUq6TdS0b7yK/view?usp=sharing 

but can be obtained at the address given at the end of this REoI.

The Project Management Group for Energy Facilities Construction under the President of the Republic of Tajikistan (PMG) now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants shall provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The shortlisting criteria are:

  1. Legal status. The Consultant shall be a legally registered entity that has been established and operating for at least the last ten (10) years. A copy of the certificate of incorporation or an equivalent registration document issued by the relevant authority in the country of establishment shall be provided. In the case of a joint venture (JV), this requirement shall apply to each JV member.
  2. General experience. The Consultant shall have at least fifteen (15) years of experience in providing advisory, owner’s-engineer, project-management, construction-supervision, or technical-support services to project implementing agencies or employers responsible for large dam and hydropower projects.
  3. Specific experience.

The Consultant shall demonstrate the following experience on large dam or hydropower projects:

  1. technical-support and/or owner’s-engineer services;
  2. construction-supervision services;
  3. contract-administration support under FIDIC-based contracts, including claims and variations management; and
  4. services in i, ii, or iii above on a project financed by the World Bank, AIIB, ADB, EIB, or another Multilateral Development Bank.

The above experience may be demonstrated through one or more assignments. However, the Consultant shall demonstrate at least one (1) principal assignment for a large dam or hydropower project with an installed capacity of at least 300 MW and a dam height of at least 100 m. The underlying construction-works value of the principal referenced project shall be at least US$300 million.

For each referenced assignment used to demonstrate any of the above requirements, the Consultant shall provide the name of the assignment, location and country, name of the client, description and scope of the services performed, Consultant’s contract value, value of the underlying construction works, duration, years of execution, completion status, and the Consultant’s role in the assignment.

In the case of a JV, the experience of the JV members may be combined. However, the experience of proposed subconsultants, affiliated entities, or individual experts shall not be considered the corporate experience of the Consultant or the JV members.

4. Capacity to deliver. The Consultant shall submit a detailed organogram demonstrating the managerial and organizational capability to carry out the assignment, and shall provide evidence of a quality management system (ISO 9001 or equivalent).

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (Seventh Edition, September 2025) (Procurement Regulations) setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but shall indicate clearly in the Expression of Interest whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

PJSC "Ukrhydroenergo" has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Project: 176114 Ukraine – Improving Power System Resilience for European Power Grid Integration (Installation of Hybrid Systems for Electricity Production in Ukrhydroenergo), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include comprehensive supervision and project management support to UHE for the implementation of contract for Design, Supply and Installation of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Ancillary Equipment at Kyiv HPP / PSP, Kaniv, Kremenchuk and Seredniodniprovska Hydropower Plants, including related services (training of UHE staff). The Project envisages the installation of BESS and the creation of an energy management system (EMS) of a total capacity of 197 MW 2-h BESS across 4 abovementioned locations. Each location and project Site is to be tendered as a separate Lot (meaning that each separate location might have their own separate contractor and their own separate contract with terms that might differ from the other), but construction is to be carried out simultaneously. Potential participants should keep in mind that they might have to deal with up to 4 different contractors and their own specific contracts during the implementation of this project. The Contract(s) is foreseen to commence on 01/02/2027, for an estimated duration of: from Effective Date until Operational Acceptance (DSI schedule, ~18 months), plus Defects Liability Period (DLP) as defined in DSI contract (forty-two (42) months from the date of Completion of the Facilities or thirty-six (36) months from the date of Operational Acceptance of the Facilities, whichever first occurs). Total estimated duration – 54 months.

PJSC "Ukrhydroenergo" now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality- and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the World Bank’s Procurement “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (November, 2020 edition)  (“Procurement Regulations”)and as further specified in the Request for Proposals.

    • Including at least two (2) projects related to installation and commissioning of HV substations (110 kV or higher), in the past five (5) years;

In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

Further information can be obtained by sending respective request to the e-mails provided below.

In order to facilitate the preparation and submission of the relevant information, the Consultants are proposed to use the following template for the preparation and submission of the Expressions of Interest (available at the following link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-nEllWAr4J593llSS--zfkIU_Hk6E_dr?usp=drive_link). Georgia

Trans-Caspian Transport Corridor - Georgia Accessibility and Transport Enhancement Project (TCTC-GATE)

Loan No. 9981-GE

Project No. P513957

 

Assignment Title: SUPERVISION OF CONSTRUCTION WORKS FOR BADIAURI-CHALAUBANI (LOT 4) AND CHALAUBANI – BAKURTSIKE (LOT 5) ROAD SECTIONS OF TBILISI–BAKURTSIKHE–LAGODEKHI (KAKHETI) HIGHWAY

Reference No. (As per Procurement Plan): TCTC-GATE/CS/QCBS-01

Georgia has received financing from the World Bank (WB) towards the cost of the Trans-Caspian Transport Corridor - Georgia Accessibility and Transport Enhancement Project (TCTC-GATE) and intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments for goods, works, and related services and consulting services to be procured under this project. The Project is co-financed by Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB). The financing agreement with AIIB is being processed and will be concluded in due course. 

The consulting services (“the Services”) include the SUPERVISION OF CONSTRUCTION WORKS FOR BADIAURI-CHALAUBANI (LOT 4) AND CHALAUBANI – BAKURTSIKE (LOT 5) ROAD SECTIONS OF TBILISI–BAKURTSIKHE–LAGODEKHI (KAKHETI) HIGHWAY. The proposed road sections form part of the Tbilisi–Bakurtsikhe–Lagodekhi (Azerbaijan Border) international highway and constitute a major transit corridor connecting Tbilisi to the Kakheti region and onward to north-western Azerbaijan. The Badiauri–Chalaubani road section (Lot 4) is a four-lane divided motorway that starts at Chainage (Ch.) 52+540, immediately after the Badiauri Interchange of Lot 3, and ends at Ch. 75+100 beyond the planned Chalaubani Interchange. The total length of this section is approximately 21.7 km, with a design speed of 120 km/h. The Chalaubani–Bakurtsikhe road section (Lot 5) is a four-lane divided motorway that starts at Ch. 75+100 and ends at Ch. 84+217.05, with the driving lanes separated by a double-sided concrete barrier. This section begins after the new Chalaubani Interchange, has a total length of approximately 9.1 km, and is designed for a speed of 100 km/h.

The primary objectives of the consulting services (“the Services”) are as follows: (i) to review the detailed designs (ii)Function as the Engineer in administering the civil works contracts for Lot 4 and Lot 5 (hereinafter “the Contract”) and execution of all rights and responsibilities of the Engineer in accordance with the Conditions of the Contract (FIDIC Red Book Second edition 2017, reprinted 2022); (iii) Comprehensive supervision of project implementation activities carried out by the Contractors to ensure compliance with the drawings, technical specifications and various stipulations contained in the contract documents, with high standards of quality assurance in supervision and in the execution of works; (iv) Advice the Client on all matters concerning the contract management and support the Client to have the works completed within the stipulated time for completion and cost to the extent possible.

The consultant is estimated to provide 817 person-months (full-time field presence) of consulting services. Escopo: Seleção e contratação de consultoria não individual (pessoa jurídica) especializada em mapeamento e definição de áreas prioritárias nos Territórios Quilombolas (TQ) Murumuru e TQ Murumurutuba, visando a implementação de um sistema de monitoramento participativo da regeneração da vegetação natural, no âmbito do Projeto Paisagens Sustentáveis da Amazônia (ASL Brasil – Fase 2).

 

O Beneficiário recebeu uma doação do Banco Mundial para a execução do Projeto PAISAGENS SUSTENTÁVEIS DA AMAZÔNIA FASE 2 – ASL BRASIL 2 de n° TF0B6898. O Projeto tem como principal objetivo promover a gestão integrada da paisagem e a conservação de ecossistemas terrestres e de água doce em áreas específicas, a fim de melhorar o manejo e a conectividade de Áreas Protegidas na Região Amazônica.

 

Solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse – SMI Nº 0015/2026

 

A FUNDAÇÃO GETULIO VARGAS, OU SIMPLESMENTE FGV, TORNA PÚBLICO QUE ESTÁ ABERTO O PRAZO PARA CONSULTORIAS ELEGÍVEIS INTERESSADAS NA APRESENTAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE, COM VISTAS À CONTRATAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA NÃO INDIVIDUAL (PESSOA JURÍDICA) ESPECIALIZADA EM MAPEAMENTO E DEFINIÇÃO DE ÁREAS PRIORITÁRIAS NOS Territórios Quilombolas (TQ) Murumuru e TQ Murumurutuba, no município de Santarém, estado do Pará, visando subsidiar a implementação de um sistema de monitoramento participativo da regeneração da vegetação natural. As consultorias interessadas deverão demonstrar que são qualificadas e que têm a experiência para desempenhar o serviço, conforme descrito no Termo de Referência, disponível em: https://asl-brasil.fgv.br/compras-e-contratacoes

 

Qualificação Requerida da Consultoria

A consultoria deverá apresentar experiência em:

i.     Execução de, no mínimo, 3 (três) trabalhos concluídos nos últimos 10 (dez) anos, relacionados aos seguintes temas: identificação e mapeamento de áreas com aptidão para restauração florestal ou para regeneração da vegetação natural preferencialmente na Amazônia; implantação, fortalecimento e monitoramento de sistemas produtivos, sistemas agroflorestais, restauração de florestal, agricultura regenerativa, monitoramento da restauração na preferencialmente na Amazônia, mapeamento participativo em territórios quilombolas e outras comunidades tradicionais.

ii.     Execução de, no mínimo, 5 (cinco) contratos, projetos ou serviçosno desenvolvimento de, diagnósticos socioeconômicos e ambientais, desenvolvimento de sistemas agroflorestais, agricultura regenerativa, regeneração da vegetação nativa preferencialmente no estado do Pará e/ou em outras áreas com reconhecimento de gestão integrada na Amazônia.

iii.    Execução de, no mínimo, 3 (três) contratos, projetos ou serviços  de gestão ambiental e territorial com mapeamento participativo em áreas rurais de comunidades agricultoras, extrativistas, quilombolas ou indígenas, preferencialmente na Amazônia.

iv.   Execução de, no mínimo, 3 (três) contratos, projetos ou serviços de planejamento e monitoramento de políticas públicas socioambientais com elaboração de bases de dados, indicadores e sistemas de monitoramento da regeneração da vegetação, preferencialmente na Amazônia.

 

Será considerada diferencial a experiência comprovada na Amazônia Legal e, especialmente, no estado do Pará. A consultoria deverá demonstrar capacidade técnica para planejar e executar pesquisas de campo em múltiplos territórios; produzir análises socioeconômicas, ambientais e institucionais; operar ferramentas de georreferenciamento e sistemas de informação geográfica (SIG); elaborar bancos de dados e indicadores de monitoramento e produzir relatórios técnicos, mapas temáticos e documentos analíticos.

 

A equipe chave deverá contar com os seguintes profissionais:  1 Coordenador(a)-Geral e 1 Especialista em Gestão Territorial e Ambiental . A consultoria deverá designar equipe de apoio necessária para realização das atividades desse TDR, sendo sugerida a inclusão de um técnico para atuar em campo.

 

            As Manifestações de Interesse deverão ser enviadas até dia 10/09/2026, às 23:59 horas, para o e-mail  asl2.compras@fgv.br. As Manifestações deverão estar identificadas como SMI Nº 0015/2026 – Mapeamento TQ Murumuru e Murumurutuba. A consultoria interessada deverá demonstrar capacidade técnica para atuar nos Territórios Quilombolas (TQ) Murumuru e TQ Murumurutuba, no município de Santarém/PA, garantindo que as atividades ocorram conforme o planejamento, que engloba o levantamento participativo de dados territoriais, o mapeamento e a priorização de áreas para regeneração da vegetação natural, e a proposição de um sistema de monitoramento participativo. A consultoria interessada deverá apresentar seu portfólio, os currículos da equipe-chave e demais documentos de acordo com os requisitos definidos no Termo de Referência.

 

Esta Solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse não pressupõe qualquer compromisso de contratação. As consultorias elegíveis serão avaliadas de acordo com as normas do "Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento, edição de setembro de 2023".

 

Informações adicionais sobre o processo seletivo poderão ser solicitadas pelo endereço eletrônico asl2.compras@fgv.br bb

 

A Fundação Getúlio Vargas entrará em contato somente com as consultorias elegíveis para a próxima etapa do processo.

The objective of the assignment is to develop the Waitukubuli National Trail Management Plan, in a highly participatory manner and following best practices worldwide. Qualifications

Experience

  • At least 3 similar projects or assignments.
  • Demonstrated experience working with national governments, communities, and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated experience in conducting beneficiary consultations, and stakeholder engagement/participation.
  • Experience in developing planning and management documents and analysis for long-distance trails is an asset.
  • Experience working within Small Developing Island States (SIDS) context would be an asset.
  • Fluency in English with the ability to write in a clear and concise manner. Dominican Creole will be an asset.

Skills

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and prioritize multiple tasks.
  • The ability to communicate complex procedures among various stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Applications and software.
  • Attention to detail.

  1. Letter of interest
  2. Curriculum Vitae
  3. Description of Similar assignment
  4. Details of experience working with national governments, communities, and diverse stakeholder groups.
  5. Details of experience in conducting beneficiary consultations, and stakeholder engagement/participation.

 

EOI’s should be a max of 5-10 pages.

Expressions of interest must be submitted in a written form (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) to the following addresses:

First Floor, 38 Cork Street

Roseau, Commonwealth of Dominica

Further information can be obtained through letbp@dominica.gov.dm or letbpprocurement@gmail.com to seek clarification.

LIBERIA REVENUE AUTHORITY

GOVERNANCE REFORM AND ACCOUNTABILITY TRANSFORMATION (GREAT) PROJECT (P177478)

IDA CREDIT No: 7511-LR

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRM SELECTION)

LR-LRA-568564-CS-CQS

Consultancy to Conduct Baseline, Midline, Endline and Post Launch VAT Awareness and Readiness Surveys

           

The Government of Liberia, through the Ministry of Finance and Development Planning (MFDP), is implementing the Governance Reform and Accountability Transformation (GREAT) Project with financing from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank. The Project supports reforms aimed at strengthening domestic revenue mobilization, public financial management, accountability, and institutional capacity.

Under Component 2 of the Project, support is being provided to strengthen domestic revenue mobilization, including capacity building for the implementation of Value Added Tax (VAT). The Government of Liberia is transitioning from the Goods and Services Tax (GST) to VAT, which is scheduled to take effect on January 1, 2027. To support the transition, the GREAT Project is financing a nationwide VAT implementation and awareness program to be implemented by the Liberia Revenue Authority (LRA) and MFDP.

The VAT implementation program seeks to achieve at least 70 percent taxpayer awareness of VAT obligations and at least 70 percent business readiness to comply by December 2026. To independently measure progress against these results, the GREAT Project intends to engage a qualified consulting firm to conduct a series of baseline, midline, endline and post-launch VAT awareness and readiness surveys.

SCOPE OF THE ASSIGNMENT

The consulting services will include the design, implementation, analysis and reporting of four survey rounds covering VAT awareness and business readiness. The assignment will include:

  • A nationwide Baseline VAT Awareness and Readiness Survey covering approximately 1,500 respondents across Liberia's fifteen counties;
  • A Midline VAT Awareness and Readiness Survey covering approximately 800 respondents;
  • A nationwide Endline VAT Awareness and Readiness Survey covering approximately 1,500 respondents; and
  • A Post-Launch VAT Survey and Outcome Assessment covering approximately 1,000 respondents.

The consulting firm will be responsible for, among other activities, developing the survey methodology and sampling strategy; developing and piloting survey instruments; undertaking field data collection; implementing quality assurance procedures; cleaning, validating and analyzing survey data; measuring changes in taxpayer awareness and business readiness across survey rounds; assessing the reach and effectiveness of the VAT awareness campaign; and preparing the required survey reports, datasets, codebooks and analytical documentation.

The four survey rounds will be undertaken under a single consultancy assignment to ensure consistency in the survey methodology, core instruments, sampling approach, indicator definitions and analytical framework and to enable reliable comparison of results over time.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment provides further information on the scope of services and deliverables.

REQUIRED CONSULTING FIRM'S QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

The Liberia Revenue Authority, through the GREAT Project, now invites the consulting firms receiving this Request for Expressions of Interest to indicate their interest in providing the services.

Interested consulting firms should provide information demonstrating that they possess the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the assignment. At a minimum, the consulting firm should demonstrate:

  1. At least five (5) years of demonstrated experience in survey research, socioeconomic research, market or public opinion research, monitoring and evaluation, or related applied research;
  2. Successful completion of at least three (3) similar survey assignments within the last five (5) years, involving large-scale quantitative data collection and analysis, of which at least one assignment involved nationwide or multi-county/multi-region coverage;
  3. Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing surveys involving businesses, taxpayers, households or the general public, including development of sampling methodologies, survey instruments, field protocols and analytical frameworks;
  4. Demonstrated experience conducting baseline, follow-up, perception, awareness, knowledge, attitude, readiness or comparable surveys designed to measure changes in indicators or outcomes over time;
  5. Demonstrated experience managing large-scale field data collection, including recruitment and training of enumerators, multi-location deployment, field supervision and implementation of data quality assurance procedures;
  6. Demonstrated experience with computer-assisted data collection, survey data management, statistical analysis, weighting and preparation of analytical reports;
  7. Demonstrated experience conducting surveys in Liberia or comparable West African contexts, including the capacity to mobilize field teams and undertake data collection across geographically dispersed locations; and
  8. Experience undertaking research related to taxation, domestic revenue mobilization, regulatory compliance, business formalization, public-sector reform or public awareness/behavior-change programs will be considered an advantage.

Relevant assignments should be presented in a table indicating, at a minimum, the name of the assignment, brief description/scope of services, client, country/location, contract start and completion dates, and client contact/reference information. Supporting documentation demonstrating successful completion of the assignments may be requested.

KEY EXPERTS

The consulting firm will be required to provide a minimum of eight (8) person-months of professional input through the following three key experts:

  • KE-1: Survey Specialist/Team Leader – 3 person-months
  • KE-2: Sampling Statistician/Data Analyst – 2 person-months
  • KE-3: Data Management and Field Operations Specialist – 3 person-months

At the Expression of Interest stage, firms should demonstrate their ability to mobilize suitably qualified experts for the assignment. Detailed qualification and experience requirements for each key expert are provided in the Terms of Reference.

EVALUATION OF EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

Expressions of Interest will be evaluated based on the following criteria:

Evaluation Criterion

Weight

General qualifications of the consulting firm relevant to the assignment

25%

Relevant experience in similar assignments

70%

Availability of the required key experts

5%

Total

100%

The minimum qualifying score is 70 percent.

The consulting firm ranked first based on the evaluation of Expressions of Interest will be invited to submit its technical and financial proposal for the assignment in accordance with the Consultants' Qualifications Selection (CQS) procedure.

DURATION OF THE ASSIGNMENT

The consultancy is expected to be implemented over a period of approximately Seventy Working Days. The services will be undertaken on an intermittent basis in accordance with the timing of the baseline, midline, endline and post-launch survey rounds and the associated reporting requirements.

SELECTION METHOD

The consulting firm will be selected using the Consultants' Qualifications Selection (CQS) method under a Limited Competition approach, in accordance with the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, September 2025.

This Request for Expressions of Interest is therefore being issued directly to a limited number of qualified consulting firms identified as having relevant experience and capacity to undertake the assignment.

Consulting firms may associate with other firms in the form permitted under the applicable World Bank Procurement Regulations to enhance their qualifications. The attention of interested consulting firms is drawn to the applicable provisions of the World Bank Procurement Regulations concerning eligibility and conflict of interest.

SUBMISSION OF EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

Expressions of Interest should provide sufficient information demonstrating the firm's qualifications and relevant experience to undertake the assignment. Firms are not required to submit a full technical or financial proposal at this stage.

Expressions of Interest must be submitted in both hard copy and soft copy on a USB drive in a format that cannot be altered (PDF format is preferred) to the address below by Friday, September 11, 2026, at 16:00 GMT and clearly indicate:

“Expression of Interest – Consultancy to Conduct Baseline, Midline, Endline and Post-Launch VAT Awareness and Readiness Surveys – Ref. No. LR-LRA-568564-CS-CQS.”

The detailed Terms of Reference for the assignment and further information may be obtained from the Liberia Revenue Authority at the address below during office hours, 09:00 to 16:00 GMT, Monday through Friday.

Le Gouvernement du Burundi a obtenu un don de 113 millions de dollars de la Banque mondiale pour financer le Projet d’Urgence sur la Résilience Urbaine (PRU, P177146), qui vise à renforcer la résilience face aux inondations et à améliorer la gestion urbaine résiliente au climat à Bujumbura sur cinq ans.

Il est prévu qu’une partie des ressources de cette avance soit utiliser pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat de services suivant : « LA REALISATION DE L’ETUDE D’IMPACTS ENVIRONNEMENTAL ET SOCIAL (EIES) ET D’UN PLAN D’ACTION POUR LA REINSTALLATION (PAR) DES ROUTES A PAVER

 

L’objectif de la mission de consultance Les prestations attendues consistent en une Étude d’Impact Environnemental et Social des routes à paver, l’analyse documentaire (initiale), le diagnostic environnemental et social, l’évaluation des impacts, le recensement des personnes et actifs affectés, la proposition de mesures d’atténuation, l’élaboration du PGES et la consultation publique

Les compétences recherchées et qui constituent les critères de présélection sont les suivantes :

  1. Avoir huit (8) ans d’expérience dans la réalisation des Etudes d’impacts environnemental et social pour les infrastructures routières ;
  2. Avoir réalisé en tant que Bureau principal au moins trois (3) missions concernant la réalisation d’études d’impact environnemental et social pour la construction et/ou la réhabilitation de routes en terre ou pavées d’au moins dix (10) km et la préparation des aspects environnementaux et sociaux de l’APD et DAO ;
  3. Avoir réalisé en tant que Bureau principal au moins deux (2) missions similaires concernant la réalisation d’études d’impact environnemental et social pour la construction et/ou la réhabilitation de routes goudronnées totalisant au moins cinq (5) kilomètres inclus la préparation des aspects environnementaux et sociaux pour l’APD et DAO
  4. N.B : Les experts clés ne seront pas évalués à ce stade.

Dans le cas d’une coentreprise, tous les partenaires de la coentreprise seront conjointement et solidairement responsables de l’ensemble du contrat, s’ils sont sélectionnés.

Un Consultant sera sélectionné conformément à la méthode de Sélection Fondée sur les Qualifications des Consultants (SQC), énoncée dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés Edition Février 2025 et conformément aux critères exigés au regard des Termes de Référence de la mission.

Financement Projet N° P507220

Contexte

D’une manière générale, l'Union des Comores à travers le Ministère de l’Education Nationale, de l’Enseignement, de la Recherche Scientifique, de la Formation et de l’Insertion Professionnelle s’associe et participe à l’Approche Programmatique Multiphase (APM) pour promouvoir des méthodes innovantes pour favoriser l’apprentissage en Afrique de l’est et australe. L’APM proposée, intitulée « Advancing Innovative Methods to Promote Learning » (AIM4Learning) ou Favoriser des méthodes innovantes pour promouvoir l’apprentissage, intègre des approches résolument nouvelles pour offrir une meilleure éducation aux élèves.

Cependant, l’Union des Comores a subi ces dernières années des chocs et des perturbations qui ont fortement impacté le système éducatif du pays, accentué les pertes d’apprentissages, les profondes inégalités scolaires et les risques d’exclusion scolaire des groupes les plus vulnérables. Il est nécessaire de rétablir et sauvegarder l’éducation en tant que droit fondamental, vecteur de développement, facteur de réduction de la pauvreté et levier puissant pour la paix, la résilience aux changements climatiques et au développement durable.

C’est ainsi que le Gouvernement comorien a obtenu un Don de l’Association International de Développement (IDA) et du Fonds du Partenariat mondial pour l’éducation équivalent à 23,7 millions de dollars pour répondre aux besoins du pays en matière d’amélioration et du renforcement de l’éducation pour l’amélioration des Résultats en Matière de Capital Humain aux Comores.

Il est prévu qu’une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce Don sera utilisée pour effectuer le paiement à titre du contrat portant « Recrutement d’un (e) consultant(e) international(e) — expert(e) en évaluation des apprentissages (EGRA/EGMA) ».

Le Consultant sera recruté Conformément au « Règlement de Passation des Marchés dans le Cadre du Financement de Projets d’investissements (FPI) Fournitures, Travaux, Services Autres que des Services de Consultants et Services de Consultants », 7ème Edition - Septembre 2026.

La méthode de sélection est la « Sélection de Consultants Individuels (SCI) ».

Profil du/de la consultant(e)

Formation

Titulaire au minimum d'un Master (idéalement doctorat ou équivalent) dans un domaine pertinent : sciences de l'éducation, psychologie cognitive, linguistique appliquée, statistiques appliquées à l'éducation, économie de l'éducation ou discipline connexe.

Expérience professionnelle

  • Au moins 8 années d'expérience dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'analyse d'évaluations des apprentissages à grande échelle

  • Connaissance du contexte éducatif des Comores ou expérience antérieure dans le pays constituera un atout significatif.

Contexte

D’une manière générale, l'Union des Comores à travers le Ministère de l’Education Nationale, de l’Enseignement, de la Recherche Scientifique, de la Formation et de l’Insertion Professionnelle s’associe et participe à l’Approche Programmatique Multiphase (APM) pour promouvoir des méthodes innovantes pour favoriser l’apprentissage en Afrique de l’est et australe. L’APM proposée, intitulée « Advancing Innovative Methods to Promote Learning » (AIM4Learning) ou Favoriser des méthodes innovantes pour promouvoir l’apprentissage, intègre des approches résolument nouvelles pour offrir une meilleure éducation aux élèves.

Cependant, l’Union des Comores a subi ces dernières années des chocs et des perturbations qui ont fortement impacté le système éducatif du pays, accentué les pertes d’apprentissages, les profondes inégalités scolaires et les risques d’exclusion scolaire des groupes les plus vulnérables. Il est nécessaire de rétablir et sauvegarder l’éducation en tant que droit fondamental, vecteur de développement, facteur de réduction de la pauvreté et levier puissant pour la paix, la résilience aux changements climatiques et au développement durable.

C’est ainsi que le Gouvernement comorien a obtenu un Don de l’Association International de Développement (IDA) et du Fonds du Partenariat mondial pour l’éducation équivalent à 23,7 millions de dollars pour répondre aux besoins du pays en matière d’amélioration et du renforcement de l’éducation pour l’amélioration des Résultats en Matière de Capital Humain aux Comores.

Request for Expressions of Interest (REoI)

Country: Lebanon
Project: Green Agri-Food Transformation for Economic Recovery (GATE) Project
Implementing Agency: Kafalat SAL
Assignment Title: Credit Administration Officer - PMU (Sub-component 1.2)
Reference No.: LB-KAFALAT-564926-CS-INDV

1. Background

The Government of Lebanon has secured financing under the Green Agri-Food Transformation for Economic Recovery (GATE) Project, supported by the World Bank. Under this Project, Sub-component 1.2 (“Access to Finance for SMEs”) is implemented by Kafalat SAL as the designated Implementing Agency. This Sub-component supports the provision of direct SME lending managed and administered by Kafalat, with a dedicated Project Management Unit (PMU) responsible for credit operations, fiduciary oversight, procurement, safeguards, and monitoring. To ensure effective execution, Kafalat will establish this PMU in line with the Subsidiary Agreement and Project Operations Manual (POM).

2. Objective of the Assignment

The objective of this assignment is to recruit a full-time Credit Administration Officer to support the efficient administration and operational processing of SME lending activities under Subcomponent 1.2, ensuring completeness of documentation, compliance with internal procedures and project requirements, proper file management, timely coordination with stakeholders, and accurate updating of records and systems.

3. Scope of Work

The Credit Administration Officer will:

  • Receive, organize, and maintain SME loan applications and supporting documentation, ensuring proper filing, archiving, scanning, and maintenance of complete physical and electronic credit files.
  • Verify completeness and accuracy of all legal, financial, operational, and collateral-related documentation in accordance with the Lending Manual, application checklist, and operational procedures.
  • Ensure all required declarations, undertakings, approvals, and legal documents are properly signed and filed.
  • Track and monitor the validity and renewal of supporting documentation, including licenses, commercial registrations, insurance policies, and collateral-related records.
  • Support the preparation and circulation of loan files for appraisal and Credit Committee review.
  • Check that every SME credit file contains all mandatory legal documents required prior to loan approval and disbursement, in line with Kafalat's internal procedures and the GATE Project legal framework.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely processing of applications and follow up with SMEs on missing documents, outstanding conditions, and other collateral-related matters.
  • Prepare and submit requests for credit information via the Central des Risques platform, and coordinate with Compliance, AML/KYC, and credit bureau agencies to ensure proper maintenance of customer due diligence documentation.
  • Maintain accurate, consistent, and up-to-date information within the Loan Management System (LMS) and other tracking systems, including updated records of all submitted, pending, approved, rejected, and disbursed applications.
  • Support the implementation and enhancement of credit administration processes, controls, and operational workflows, and escalate operational bottlenecks or file deficiencies to management.

A detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) is available upon request at: yolla@kafalat.com.lb.

4. Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Law, or a related field. A Master's degree or professional certification is an asset.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in credit administration, loan operations, credit documentation, or banking operations, preferably within a commercial bank or financial institution.
  • Good working knowledge of Lebanese legal and regulatory requirements applicable to commercial documentation and collateral (pledges, mortgages, guarantees).
  • Strong knowledge of lending operations, collateral management, and credit administration procedures.
  • Experience working with Loan Management Systems (LMS), banking systems, or credit administration platforms.
  • Good understanding of KYC, AML, compliance, and documentation requirements.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent command of Arabic and English; strong communication and coordination skills.

5. Application Process

Interested qualified candidates are invited to submit their Expressions of Interest (EOI), including:

  • A cover letter highlighting relevant experience.
  • An updated CV.
  • Contact details of at least two professional references.

Submissions must be sent by email to yolla@Kafalat.com.lb   with the subject line: “EOI - Credit Administration Officer “ no later than 26/08/2026.

6. Selection

A shortlist will be established based on qualifications and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews.

description:
Avis à Manifestation d’Intérêts : N°2026-6/PCH pour le recrutement d'un cabinet ou un groupement de cabinets spécialisé en communication pour le Projet Capital Humain (PCH)

Sources de financement : E3990 – GW ; P179509 DONATIVO IDA

 

  1. Contexte

La République de Guinée-Bissau, par l'intermédiaire du Ministère de l'Économie, du Plan et de l'Intégration Régionale, a sollicité et obtenu de l'IDA/BM un don pour financer les coûts des activités du Projet Capital Humain, par l'intermédiaire de l'Unité de Gestion et de Coordination dudit Projet (UGCPCH) et entend utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer les paiements autorisés aux termes des contrats pour lesquels ce avis a été préparé, à savoir : recrutement d'un cabinet ou un groupement de cabinets spécialisé en communication pour le Projet Capital Humain (PCH).

 

  1. Objectifs de la mission

Recruter une agence de communication ou un groupement d’agences pour concevoir et déployer une stratégie de communication intégrée à 360°, destinée à accroître la visibilité des interventions du projet et à valoriser leur impact sur les bénéficiaires.

L'agence ou le groupement d’agences devra notamment :

  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de communication globale adaptée au contexte local (langues, cultures), y compris un plan de communication du Projet budgétisé. 
  • Définir les messages clés et identifier les canaux les plus efficaces (médias traditionnels, digitaux, communication de proximité).
  • Mettre en œuvre un plan de Communication des Risques et Engagement Communautaire (CREC).
  • Assurer la visibilité digitale (gestion et animation du site web, Facebook, LinkedIn).
  •  Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie spécifique pour chaque plateforme numérique (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube et toute autre plateforme pertinente), en adaptant les contenus, les formats, le ton, la fréquence de publication et les objectifs aux caractéristiques et aux publics cibles de chaque réseau social, afin de maximiser l'engagement et la portée des actions de communication.
  • Recourir, lorsque cela est pertinent, à des influenceurs, créateurs de contenus et ambassadeurs crédibles disposant d'une forte audience sur des plateformes telles qu'Instagram, TikTok et autres réseaux sociaux populaires, afin de renforcer la visibilité des campagnes, d'accroître l'engagement des communautés cibles et de favoriser l'adoption des messages du projet, dans le respect des principes d'éthique, de transparence et des directives de communication du Projet.
  • Produire des supports institutionnels et promotionnels de haute qualité (newsletters, articles, brochures, vidéos, photos) qui mettent en valeur les résultats, les retombées et les bonnes pratiques du projet auprès des bénéficiaires, les pouvoirs publics, les partenaires techniques et financiers et les médias.
  • Définir des indicateurs de performance en matière de communication et établir des rapports périodiques sur la portée des campagnes, le niveau de participation des parties prenantes, l'impact des messages et la perception du projet par le public ;
  • Gérer les relations publiques et les relations presse.
  • Mettre en œuvre des actions de communication pour le changement social et comportemental (CMSC) liées à l’importance de l’éducation ; l’utilisation et conservation des manuels scolaire, nutrition et protection de l´enfant.
  • Assurer que toutes les actions de communication intègrent les principes de l’inclusion, l’égalité des sexes, l’accessibilité, la protection d’enfance et la diversité ;
  • Élaborer des histoires de réussite (Success Stories).
  • Rédiger une foire aux questions (FAQ).
  • Production de supports graphiques (logos du projet, brochures, affiches, roll-ups, bannières).
  • Soutenir l'organisation événementielle du projet (missions sur le terrain, campagnes et cérémonies officielles relayées par la presse, la radio communautaire, la télévision et les plateformes numériques).

 

  1. Durée de la mission

La durée chaque mission est estimée à 12 mois (renouvelable selon les performances.

  1. Profil de l'agence ou le groupement d’agences (critères de qualification)

L'agence ou le groupement d’agences doit être un cabinet ou un groupement de cabinets spécialisé disposant de:

  • Expérience générale : Minimum 5 ans d'existence légale et d'expérience avérée en communication/marketing et en communication digitale
  • Expérience spécifique : Au moins 3 missions similaires au cours des 5 dernières années (attestations de bonne exécution requises). Une expérience avec des projets financés par des bailleurs internationaux (Banque mondiale, ONU, etc.) est un atout majeur.
  • Équipe clé : Experts diplômés (Bac+4 minimum) en Marketing, Communication, Journalisme ou Production Audiovisuelle.
  • Langues : Maîtrise parfaite du Portugais (obligatoire). La maîtrise du Français ou de l'Anglais est requise pour les rapports internationaux.
  • Une expérience de campagnes menées en créole à Bissau ou dans les régions en dehors de Bissau sera considérée comme un atout. De même, une expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de l’éducation ou de la protection sociale serait souhaitable
  1. Dossier de candidature

      Les manifestations doivent comprendre :

    1. Proposition technique : Présentation de l'agence ou du groupement, méthodologie de travail, compréhension des TDR.
    2. Portfolio : Exemples de réalisations (campagnes, designs, vidéos).
    3. Références : Liste des contrats similaires (faire la preuve en joignant la page de garde et page de signature et attestation de bonne exécutions) avec contacts et 3 lettres de recommandation.
    4. Preuves techniques : Liste du matériel de production et logiciels maîtrisés.
  2. Critères de sélection

 La sélection du candidat se fera conformément à la sélection de Consultants Fondée sur la Qualité et sur le Coût (SFQC) conformément au Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) Sixth Edition, February 2025. A l’issu de l’évaluation des manifestations d’intérêts, une liste restreinte sera dressée et une demande de proposition sera envoyée aux auditeurs qui y figureront.

Les Termes de Référence de la mission peuvent être obtenus sur demande à l´adresse : quartier Penha, à côté de l'École libanaise - Bissau, Guinée-Bissau, tél. : (+245) 955 219 738/956 420 998/ 966 136 070, e-mail : alfamajal@gmail.com/gualb_kab@yahoo.fr, gualb_kab@yahoo.fr/ geraldoindeque7@gmail.com/ elisamariaembalo@gmail.com , de 9h00 à 16h00 du lundi au vendredi.

 

Les consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires à l'adresse mentionnée ci-dessous aux heures d’ouverture des bureaux suivantes : 09h00 à 16h30 GMT.

  1. Date et lieu de dépôt : les manifestations d’intérêt doivent être envoyées par courriel ou déposées à l’adresse ci-dessus indiquée au plus tard le 17 août 2026 à 15h00 GMT à 10h 00 GMT.

SYSTEM INTEGRATOR (SI) FOR MOMS LMIS ARCHITECTURE REVITALIZATION, DEVELOPMENT, ENHANCEMENT, AND PROVIDING IMPLEMENTATION SUPPORT SERVICES

Reference No. ID-MOM-555653-CS-QCBS 

Labour Market Information and Skills for Transformation for Labour Market Flexibility Project – International Bank for Reconstruction and Development – Loan Number 9636-ID

 

The Government of the Republic of Indonesia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Labour Market Information and Skills for Transformation for Labour Market Flexibility (LISTRAF) and intend to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. 

The main purpose of this assignment is to focus on the revitalization of the existing SIAPkerja platform, a digital ecosystem developed and managed by the Ministry of Manpower (hereinafter referred to as the “Ministry”), through the following: (i) redesign of the SIAPkerja user interface based on user mapping and end-user needs; (ii) redesign of the system architecture to improve interoperability among existing Ministry services and across other ministry/agency services; (iii) strengthening of system features to address unmet service needs; and (iv) enhancement of IT architecture and supporting technology infrastructure.

The duration of the assignment is expected to be around 12 (twelve) months. The total estimated level of effort is about 198 (one hundred ninety eight)  professional staff months. The complete scope of services and other details pertaining to this assignment including the key and non-key experts required are provided in the Terms of Reference which can be found at https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id. 

The Ministry of Manpower now invites eligible consultant firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the services. They shall submit the Expression of Interest (EOI) demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services, i.e presenting the consultant/firm profile, the legality of consultant/firm, description of similar assignment on the last 10 (ten) years (the information shall be completed with the assignment title, assignment location, name of employer, type of services provided, period of work (start and completion dates), and contract value, as evidenced by the Contract Agreement and the Handover Certificate). The experience data should be in .pdf format submit on https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id and should be in .xls format submit on pokmilalistraf@gmail.com, the submission of EOI must be submitted before as per the schedule stated in the SPSE ICB LKPP. 

The shortlisting criteria are as follows: 

  1. Demonstrated experience in designing and managing Integrated Digital Enterprise Architecture/ Core Systems (e.g., Digital Government MIS/National Financial Management Systems/Labor Market Information System (LMIS), Enterprise Resource Planning Systems (ERP) /Public Employment Service (PES Platform/Large scale Government Enterprise MIS or relevant projects of similar scale and nature) for the last 10 years;
  2. At least 3 Enterprise Architecture development projects/System Development projects - out of which at least any 2 projects mentioned above must have been completed within the past 10 years (remaining 1 project could also be an ongoing project);
  3. Proven experience in managing projects with system accountability for public services, meaning the firm has been responsible for the performance, reliability, security, and continuity of systems serving the public.

Note: Firms meeting all three criteria will be shortlisted and invited to submit a full technical and financial proposal.

 

Consultant may associate with other firms in the form of a joint venture or sub-consultancy to enhance their qualification. For the purpose of shortlisting, the qualifications of sub-consultants will not be considered in the EOI evaluation.  In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

The Consultant is drawn to paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank of the Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (September 2023) (Procurement Regulations), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (September 2023). Further information may obtained in the below address during office hours 7.30 to 16.00 (GMT+7).
