REPUBLIC OF MALAWI

MINISTRY OF ENERGY

DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AFFAIRS

 REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (CONSULTING SERVICES –FIRM SELECTION)

Country:  Malawi

Project Name     :ASCENT Malawi Project

Project Number :P502464

Assignment Title: Consultancy Services for the Design, Development and Implementation of Carbon Mitigation and Carbon Financing Activities in the Energy Sector

Reference No. :  MW-MOE.-550566-CS-QCBS

EOI Issue Date :  3rd August 2026

This request for expression of interest follows the General Procurement Notice for this Project that appeared in the United Nations Development Business (UNDB) on 31st January 2025.

The Government of the Republic of Malawi through the Ministry of Energy has received financing from the International Development Association (IDA) and Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP) towards the cost of implementing the Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation in Malawi (ASCENT Malawi) Project. It is intended that part of the proceeds of the financing will be used to cover eligible payments under the contracts for Consultancy services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) intent is to engage a qualified consulting firm to provide consultancy services to the Ministry of Energy (MOE), for the design, development and implementation of carbon mitigation and carbon financing activities in the energy sector, with a pilot for clean cooking solutions (CCS), in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. The firm consultant will provide analytical, advisory and process support including preparing required documentation to (i) support the GOM quantifiably determine the potential for emission reductions (ERs) in its current and potential energy sector investments, and the potential for generating, certifying and monetizing the ERs, across multiple technologies, scales and types; and (ii) pilot an ERs (sub)activity for clean cooking solutions under ASCENT Malawi completing full carbon financing cycle(s).

The assignment will cover the entire energy sector including at individual project levels such as ASCENT Malawi where the GOM seeks to raise carbon finance under Components 1, 2, 3 and 4 of the Project.

The objective of the assignment is to support the Government of Malawi, particularly the Ministry of Energy, in the design, development, operationalization, and implementation of carbon mitigation and carbon financing activities within the energy sector.

The scope of work under this assignment shall include the following, but not limited to:

  • Carbon Financing Modalities and Framework Development
  • Carbon Mitigation Activity Design and Registration
  • Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV)
  • Carbon Credit Issuance and Commercialization
  • Clean Cooking Carbon Finance Pilot
  • Capacity Building and Stakeholder Engagement

The detailed Terms of Reference (TORs) for the assignment can be found at the following websites: Ministry of Energy and Mining (https://energy.gov.mw/resources/), Ngwee Ngwee Ngwee Fund (https://www.nnnf.energy.gov.mw/resources/) and ASCENT Malawi Project (https://www.ascent.mw/resources/) or upon request through the following email address amopiha@ascent.mw copy to info@ascent.mw and austin.theu@energy.gov.mw. All requests for clarification should be sent through above emails, and the Client will respond to the requested clarifications.

The MoE now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are as follows:

  1. Core business of the firm(s) and years in business of not less than Seven (7) years
  2. Relevant similar experience, which should specifically include the below:
  • Experience in, and understanding of, the renewable energy and clean cooking market in sub-Saharan Africa, with preference for experience in East or Southern Africa;
  • Demonstrated experience applying household energy or clean cooking carbon methodologies under any of the following: Verra VM0050 or predecessor VMR0006 and VMR0011; Gold Standard TPDDTEC; Gold Standard Improved Cook Stove methodology; CDM AMS-II.G; GCCNMT016; or CLEAR Methodology;
  • Experience preparing PoAs and/or PDDs for clean cooking or energy access projects, of which at least two PoAs were successfully registered;
  • Demonstrated experience in successful registration of carbon projects under recognized standards (e.g., VCS, Gold Standard, CDM, Article 6), preferably including programmatic approaches such as PoAs
  • Proven experience with Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, including knowledge of Corresponding Adjustments, NDC accounting, and Letter of Authorisation processes;
  • Proven experience conducting KPT, CCT, and WBT tests, and designing statistical sampling frameworks for carbon projects at scale;
  • Experience with digital MRV systems and data integration, including familiarity with DMRV or equivalent dMRV platforms;
  • Experience structuring, drafting and reviewing contract documentation, and providing advisory support, on carbon credit commercialisation transactions;
  • Experience managing validation, verification, and issuance cycles with accredited VVBs; and
  • Experience working with governments or development partners on energy access and carbon monetization activities in Africa

3. Technical and managerial capability of the firm (provide only the structure of the organization, general qualifications, and number of key staff. Do not provide CVs of the staff. Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage).

This Request for Expressions of Interest is open to all eligible firms as defined in the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (July 2016, as revised November 2017, August 2018, September 2023 and February 2025). Firms declared ineligible by the World Bank Group in accordance with the Bank's guidelines on Preventing and Combating Fraud and Corruption in Projects Financed by IBRD Loans and IDA Credits and Grants are not eligible to participate.

Consultants may associate with other firms in the form of a Joint Venture (JV) or sub-consultancy to strengthen their qualifications. In the case of a JV, firms should indicate clearly the lead firm and also whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Interested firms are requested to submit an Expression of Interest containing the following information:

  • Firm Profile: Organization name, legal status, country of registration, year of establishment, core business, and contact details.
  • Relevant Experience: Description of at least three (3) similar assignments completed in the last ten (10) years, including client name, project title, contract value, duration, and role of the firm. Reference contacts must be provided.
  • Approach and Methodology: A brief outline of the proposed approach to the assignment (maximum 3 pages).
  • Key Staff: Names and brief biography (maximum 2 pages each) of proposed key experts, demonstrating their qualifications and relevant experience. Do not provide full CVs of the staff.
  • Statement of Availability and Commitment: Signed declaration of the firm's availability and commitment to execute the assignment.
  • Joint Venture Agreement (if applicable): A Letter of Intent to form a JV or sub-consultancy, signed by all parties.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours from 8:00 to 12:00 and 13:00 to 16:00 hour’s local time Monday to Friday, Except National Holidays.

Expressions of Interest must be submitted in either electronic or hard copy formats no later than the 14th September 2026.

Electronic submission (PDF format) to: amopiha@ascent.mw (primary) with copy to info@ascent.mw and austin.theu@energy.gov.mw.

Hard copy submission addressed to:

IPDC Chairperson

Ministry of Energy – ASCENT MW Project

Area 47 Sector 5, House No. 66

Assignment Title:                       Consultancy Services for the Feasibility Study for Ngwempisi Multipurpose Hydro Scheme

 

  1. The Government of the Kingdom of Eswatini (GoKE) has received financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD), the International Development Agency (IDA) and grant funding from the Global Public Good (GPG) Facility, which are all under the World Bank. The received financing is for the purposes of implementing the Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation in Eswatini (ASCENT Eswatini) Project (P508960) (the Project), with the involvement of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Energy, as set out in the Loan Agreement, Financing Agreement, Grant Agreement and Project Agreements.

 

  1. The EEC now invites Expressions of Interest (EOI) from interested and eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to provide consulting services for the Feasibility Study for Ngwempisi Multipurpose Hydro Scheme.

 

  1. The Consultant shall undertake, but not necessarily be limited to the following tasks:

 

  1. Compilation and Initial Review of Existing Documents and Data

The Consultant shall undertake a highlevel reconnaissance by collecting and reviewing existing reports, data, and policies on the Ngwempisi River and regional strategies, then synthesizing information on institutions, infrastructure, hydrology, geology, environment, and socioeconomic conditions, with further details provided in the Terms of Reference.

 

  1. Review of the Pre-feasibility Study of the Ngwempisi Hydropower Cascading Scheme.

The Consultant shall review the 2018 prefeasibility study to identify gaps for further analysis and update assumptions, including assessment of dam alternatives, type options, and storage capacity, with further details provided in the Terms of Reference.

 

  1. Water resources availability and water demand assessment

The Consultant shall conduct a highlevel assessment of water resources availability and future demands, including climate change impacts, water balance forecasting, and evaluation of storage structures and consumptive uses, with further details provided in the Terms of Reference.

 

  1. Preliminary Studies for Agriculture

The Consultant shall conduct a highlevel assessment of irrigation potential along the Ngwempisi River downstream, including policy review, land and soil suitability, farming systems, value chains, irrigation scheme options, cropping systems, and water demand projections, with further details provided in the Terms of Reference.

 

  1. Environmental and Social Impacts Assessment (ESIA) studies

The Consultant shall conduct a preliminary Environmental and Social Impact Assessment of the project including a Preliminary Environmental and Social Management Plan (ESMP).

 

  1. Preliminary Cost Estimates, Economic Analysis and Ranking

The Consultant shall conduct a highlevel cost and economic assessment of the preliminary scheme layout, including infrastructure requirements, lifecycle cost comparisons for power production, detailed capital cost breakdowns, and preliminary financial and economic analyses, with further details provided in the Terms of Reference.

 

  1. Assessment of Financing Options

The Consultant shall conduct a highlevel assessment of financing options for the multipurpose water project, considering government fiscal capacity, potential loans from multilateral development banks, and publicprivate partnership arrangements.

 

  1. Preliminary Designs

The Consultant shall prepare highlevel preliminary designs to meet projected needs through 2050, optimizing infrastructure dimensions and capacity to balance water supply, hydropower, irrigation, and environmental flows, while respecting socioenvironmental constraints and international transboundary agreements, with further details provided in the Terms of Reference.

 

  1. Interested consultants must provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform all the services. The following documents shall also be submitted along with the EOI applications by all the consulting firms, including each member of JV firms:
      • Copies of certificates of incorporation/registration of the consulting firms
      • Annual Financial records of the firm(s) for the past 5 years
      • Corporate profile of the firm(s) with quality assurance plan, e.g. ISO 9001, information on organizational strength (Organization structure, number of permanent professional staff and their expertise, qualifications and number of total staff), availability of licensed software and tools.  

 

  1. The qualifications and shortlisting criteria are:
      • At least ten (10) years’ of demonstrated experience in undertaking consultancy services of a similar nature and complexity.
      • Demonstrated experience of at least two (2) relevant assignments involving water resources planning, hydropower, multipurpose dam development, irrigation, environmental and social assessment, feasibility or prefeasibility studies, economic analysis or related infrastructure advisory services.
      • Demonstrated experience of at least one (1) relevant assignment in Africa involving water resources planning, hydropower, multipurpose dam development, irrigation, environmental and social assessment, feasibility or prefeasibility studies, economic analysis or related infrastructure advisory services.
      • Demonstrated experience of at least one (1) relevant assignment in hydropower development, specifically in planning and delivering projects that enhance electricity generation through the establishment of hydropower plants.
      • Demonstrated experience of at least one (1) multidisciplinary studies covering technical, environmental, social, economic, financial, and institutional aspects of infrastructure.

 

  1. The purpose of this EOI is to establish a shortlist of not more than eight (8) Prequalified Respondents for the subsequent Request for Proposal and to invite technical and financial proposals from these Respondents. All responses shall be assessed for completeness. The qualification criteria in (v) above shall be assessed on a Yes/No basis to determine a PASS or FAIL result. Respondents who attain a Pass shall be shortlisted on the following weighted aspects:
  • General Corporate experience in undertaking consultancy services.[10]
  • Specific experience in hydropower development, specifically in planning and delivering projects that enhance electricity generation through the establishment of hydropower plants.[25]
  • Specific experience in multidisciplinary studies covering technical, environmental, social, economic, financial and institutional aspects of infrastructure development.[20]
  • Specific experience in assignments involving water resources planning, hydropower, multipurpose dam development, irrigation, environmental and social assessment, feasibility or prefeasibility studies, economic analysis or related infrastructure advisory services[30]
  • Regional (African) experience in assignments involving water resources planning, hydropower, multipurpose dam development, irrigation, environmental and social assessment, feasibility or prefeasibility studies, economic analysis or related infrastructure advisory services.[15]

 

 

  1. In order to substantiate the aforementioned consulting jobs/contracts, the Consultant shall submit the Completion Certificates or End User Certificate from clients depicting description of services provided. All Completion Certificate or End User Certificates should be in English; Completion Certificates/ End User Certificates in other languages should be translated and notarized. Incomplete Consulting Contracts will not be taken into account and hence will not be evaluated.

 

  1. Consultants may associate with other consultants to enhance their qualifications. For a JV/consortium, the qualifications and experience of the members may be combined to meet the qualification requirements. The Lead Partner shall demonstrate substantial relevant experience and shall be responsible for contract performance. Consortium members may combine qualifications and experience to meet the overall qualification requirements.

Shortlisted Consultants will subsequently be invited to submit Technical and Financial Proposals and Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based (QCBS) selection method as per the Seventh edition of Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers dated September 2025.

Le Gouvernement du Royaume du Maroc a obtenu de la Banque mondiale un prêt destiné au financement du projet « Appui au renforcement des filets sociaux pour le développement humain au Maroc ». Une partie de ce financement sera utilisée pour effectuer financer l’amélioration de l’accès aux prestations monétaires de l’ASD et leur gestion. Dans ce contexte, L’Agence Nationale du Soutien Social invite les fournisseurs admissibles et qualifiés à présenter une cotation pour les fournitures et services connexes décrits ci-après. La procédure est conduite suivant la méthode de Demande de Cotations prévue au Règlement de passation des marchés de la Banque mondiale.

1. Objet et consistance de la demande de cotations

La consultation porte sur l’extension de la plateforme principale du système d’information de l’ANSS. Elle comprend les fournitures suivantes, ainsi que leur installation, leur configuration et leur intégration dans l’environnement existant :

N°

Fourniture

Quantité

Principales exigences

1

Extension de la mémoire du cluster hyperconvergé existant composé de quatre nœuds

32 unités

Barrettes de 64 Go DDR5 (4800 MHz), soit 512 Go additionnels par nœud ; installation et paramétrage du cluster inclus.

2

Extension du stockage SSD NVMe du cluster hyperconvergé

8 unités

Disques SSD NVMe de 7,68 To, à raison de deux disques par nœud ; installation, configuration, intégration et paramétrage inclus.

3

Licence Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) - Ultimate Edition

1 licence

Souscription pour un cluster de quatre nœuds et une capacité totale de 50 cœurs CPU, avec support éditeur pendant trois ans ; installation et configuration incluses.

Les services connexes comprennent notamment le cadrage du projet, la livraison, l’installation, la configuration, l’intégration et la mise en production, les tests de validation, un audit de sécurité, la formation officielle à la plateforme NKP au profit de quatre agents de l’ANSS, le transfert de compétences et la remise des livrables techniques. Le détail de la prestation est téléchargeable à partir du portail des marchés publics à l’adresse : www.marchespublics.gov.ma.

2.  Lieu d’exécution : Rabat.

3. Délai d’exécution : deux mois et demi (2,5 mois), à compter de l’ordre de service prescrivant le commencement de l’exécution.

4. Garantie : trois (3) années à compter de la réception provisoire.

5. Retrait du dossier et demandes d’éclaircissements

Le dossier de la demande de cotation, est téléchargeable à partir du portail des marchés publics à l’adresse : www.marchespublics.gov.ma.

Les demandes d’éclaircissements doivent être transmises au maître d’ouvrage via le portail marocain des marchés publics  au plus tard le 21 août 2026.

6. Qualification de soumission

Peuvent participer à la présente consultation les sociétés ou personnes physiques légalement constituées et habilitées, dont l’activité couvre la fourniture, l’installation, la configuration et l’intégration des équipements, logiciels informatiques et services connexes objet de la consultation.

Les soumissionnaires doivent :

  • Être admissibles conformément aux règles de la Banque mondiale ;
  • Justifier d’au moins deux références similaires réalisées au cours des cinq dernières années, pour un montant total supérieur ou égale à 1 500 000 DH TTC  pour chaque référence; portant sur des prestations se rapprochant de l’objet de la présente demande de cotation ou leurs copies certifiées conformes à l’original délivrées par les maîtres d’ouvrage publics ou privés, ou par les hommes de l'art sous la direction desquels le concurrent a exécuté des prestations dans le domaine d’installation et d’extension des plateformes des systèmes d’information.

Il est impératif que ces attestations concernent des projets réalisés au cours des cinq dernières années et portent sur des prestations avec un montant total supérieur ou égale à un million cinq cent mille dirhams toutes taxes comprises 1 500 000 DH TTC

  • Signaler toute situation réelle, potentielle ou apparente de conflit d’intérêts ;
  • Ne pas se trouver dans une situation susceptible de compromettre leur capacité à exécuter le marché de manière indépendante, notamment en raison d’obligations présentes ou passées envers d’autres clients ;
  • Ne pas faire l’objet d’une sanction en vigueur prononcée par la Banque mondiale.

 

7. Composition du dossier de la soumission :

  1. Au moins deux attestations de référence similaires à l’objet de la cotation, réalisées au cours des cinq dernières années, pour un montant total de 1 500 000 DH TTC chacune comme spécifié dans le point précédent;
  2. Formulaire de cotation et bordereau des prix et quantités, dûment renseignés, signés et cacheté par la personne habilitée à représenter le concurrent avec indication du prix total (Annexe 1) ;
  3. Tableau de conformité technique dûment renseigné, signé et cacheté par la personne habilitée (Annexe2)
  4. Prospectus et fiches techniques cacheté et signé par la personne habilitée ;
  5. Attestation du constructeur ou de l’éditeur faisant référence à la présente consultation et précisant le niveau de partenariat ;
  6. Les pièces justifiant les pouvoirs conférés à la personne agissant au nom du concurrent ;
  7. Déclaration d’acceptation des Directives de la Banque Mondiale en matière de lutte contre la corruption, et de son régime de sanctions signés et cacheté (Annexe 3) ;
  8. Garantie de soumission en dirhams ou dans une monnaie convertible, sous forme d’une caution bancaire d’un montant de 25 000,00 dirhams en faveur de l’ANSS indiquant l’objet de la cotation.
  9.  Une attestation ou sa copie certifiée conforme à l’original, délivrée depuis moins d’un an par le

percepteur du lieu d’imposition certifiant que le concurrent est en situation fiscale régulière ou

à défaut de paiement qu’il a constitué les garanties. Cette attestation doit mentionner l’activité

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

CONSULTANT’S QUALIFICATIONS BASED SELECTION (CQS)

Name of Project

Sustainable, Integrated and Safe Road Infrastructure Project (SISRI)

Loan No./Credit No./Grant No.

IBRD Loan No. 97800-BA

Assignment Title

Construction Supervision Services for Rehabilitation of Main Road MII-504 (R-454), Konjevi Polje - Bratunac

Procurement Plan Ref. Number

BA-RS-SISRI-CS-CQS-26-1.2.5

Country of Delivery

Bosnia and Herzegovina (Republika Srpska)

The Ministry of Finance and Treasury of Bosnia and Herzegovina (the “Borrower”) has received financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) toward the cost of the Sustainable, Integrated and Safe Road Infrastructure Project (SISRI) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for the following consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) comprise construction supervision, project management and contract administration for the rehabilitation of the main road MII-504 (R-454), Konjevi Polje - Bratunac (Works RFB No. BA-RS-SISRI-W-RFB-26-1.2.3), covering approximately 23.9 km. The Works include pavement rehabilitation and strengthening; earthworks and drainage; shoulders and roadside elements; repair of culverts and related structures; traffic signage and road markings; safety barriers and other road safety equipment; bus-stop treatments; temporary traffic management; and environmental, social, occupational health and safety measures.

The Intended Completion Date for the Works is 365 days after the Commencement Date. The Services are expected to commence in coordination with the commencement of the Works and to cover the construction period and the related completion, close-out and Defects Liability Period services as specified in the Terms of Reference. The Defects Liability Period under the Works contract is 730 calendar days. The detailed scope, deliverables, level of effort and implementation arrangements are set out in the Terms of Reference.

The Terms of Reference (TOR) for the primary procurement stage for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Public Company “Republic of Srpska Roads” Ltd. now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: “Procurement Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting, and Consulting Services, Seventh edition, September 2025”  (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The best qualified firm to carry out the Services will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection (CQS) method set out in the Regulations and based on the following criteria:

Qualification requirements to be met by the Consultant:

1. Core business and general experience: at least seven (5) years of demonstrated experience in construction supervision, project management and/or contract administration of road or transport infrastructure works.

2. Relevant specific experience: successful completion, within the last ten (10) years, of at least two (2) assignments for supervision and contract administration of construction, reconstruction or rehabilitation of paved public roads of similar nature and complexity; at least one such assignment should have involved a road section or combined road sections of not less than approximately 20 km.

3. Similar technical scope: demonstrated firm-level experience supervising asphalt pavement rehabilitation, earthworks and drainage, culverts and roadside elements, traffic signage and road markings, safety barriers and other road safety equipment, temporary traffic management under live traffic conditions, and environmental and social requirements.

4. Technical and managerial capability: demonstrated organizational and management capacity for quality assurance/quality control, supervision of materials testing, measurement and certification of works, progress and cost control, contract administration, environmental and social compliance, occupational health and safety monitoring, and regular reporting.

5. Previous experience with World Bank or other international financial institution (IFI/MDB)-financed road infrastructure projects and related contract administration procedures will be considered an asset;

6. Experience in Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Western Balkans or comparable legal, climatic and operating environments will be considered an asset;

Interested Consultants should submit a concise company profile and evidence of relevant assignments, including the client, country, scope, duration, implementation period, value of the supervised works where available, the Consultant’s role, and client contact details for verification. In the case of an association, the Expression of Interest should clearly state the form and proposed role of each member/partner.

The qualifications and experience of individual Key Experts shall not be evaluated at the REOI stage and CVs of Key Experts are not required with the Expression of Interest.

Evaluation criteria:

Consultants meeting the minimum qualification requirements set out above will be evaluated and ranked on the basis of their demonstrated qualifications and relevant experience related to the assignment. The evaluation will be based on the information submitted in the Expressions of Interest and in accordance with the following criteria:

  1. Core business, general experience and organizational capacity of the firm (20%)
  2. Relevant experience in supervision and contract administration of road projects of similar nature, scope and complexity (60%)
  3. Technical and managerial capability demonstrated through previous assignments (20%)

PROJET DE RENFORCEMENT DE L’ÉDUCATION POUR AMÉLIORER LES RÉSULTATS EN MATIÈRE DE CAPITAL HUMAIN (P507220)

****************

UNITE DE GESTION DE PROJET (UGP- PFSS-RRC/PREMCH)

AVIS D’APPEL A CANDIDATURE POUR LE RECRUTEMENT D’UN CONSULTANT NATIONAL POUR L’ELABORATION DES GUIDES ET OUTILS DE COMMUNICATION EN LANGUE NATIONALE ET DU CARNET DES PARENTS

Date de l’avis : 01 Septembre 2026

Financement Projet N° P507220

Don N°E4100-KM

Contexte

D’une manière générale, l'Union des Comores à travers le Ministère de l’Education Nationale, de l’Enseignement, de la Recherche Scientifique, de la Formation et de l’Insertion Professionnelle s’associe et participe à l’Approche Programmatique Multiphase (APM) pour promouvoir des méthodes innovantes pour favoriser l’apprentissage en Afrique de l’est et australe. L’APM proposée, intitulée « Advancing Innovative Methods to Promote Learning » (AIM4Learning) ou Favoriser des méthodes innovantes pour promouvoir l’apprentissage, intègre des approches résolument nouvelles pour offrir une meilleure éducation aux élèves.

Cependant, l’Union des Comores a subi ces dernières années des chocs et des perturbations qui ont fortement impacté le système éducatif du pays, accentué les pertes d’apprentissages, les profondes inégalités scolaires et les risques d’exclusion scolaire des groupes les plus vulnérables. Il est nécessaire de rétablir et sauvegarder l’éducation en tant que droit fondamental, vecteur de développement, facteur de réduction de la pauvreté et levier puissant pour la paix, la résilience aux changements climatiques et au développement durable.

C’est ainsi que le Gouvernement comorien a obtenu un Don de l’Association International de Développement (IDA) et du Fonds du Partenariat mondial pour l’éducation équivalent à 23,7 millions de dollars pour répondre aux besoins du pays en matière d’amélioration et du renforcement de l’éducation pour l’amélioration des Résultats en Matière de Capital Humain aux Comores.

Il est prévu qu’une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce Don sera utilisée pour effectuer le paiement à titre du contrat portant « Recrutement d’un consultant national pour l’élaboration des guides et outils de communication en langue nationale et du carnet des parents ».

Le Consultant sera recruté Conformément au « Règlement de Passation des Marchés dans le Cadre du Financement de Projets d’investissements (FPI) Fournitures, Travaux, Services Autres que des Services de Consultants et Services de Consultants », 7ème Edition- Septembre 2025.

La méthode de sélection est la « Sélection de Consultants Individuels (SCI) ».

Profil et qualifications du consultant

Le consultant devra répondre aux qualifications suivantes :

  • Être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire (au moins Bac +4) en communication, sciences sociales, éducation, développement communautaire ou domaine connexe ;
  • Justifier d’au moins 5 années d’expérience dans la conception d’outils de communication sociale ou de sensibilisation communautaire ;
  • Avoir une expérience confirmée dans la production de supports pédagogiques simplifiés destinés aux communautés ;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance du contexte socioculturel des Comores ;
  • Maîtriser parfaitement le français et la langue nationale comorienne ;
  • Une expérience dans des projets financés par des partenaires techniques et financiers sera un atout.

Composition des dossiers de candidature :

  • Curriculum vitae détaillé et coordonnées pour contact rapide
  • Lettre de motivation datée et signée
  • Copies des diplômes et des attestations
  • Copie de la carte d’identité biométrique 
  • Copies des attestations de bonne exécution des missions similaires
  • Expérience spécifique dans des produits comparables
  • Communication comportementale et adaptation aux publics
  • Compétences éditoriales, graphiques et multimédias
  • Noms, adresses, téléphones des personnes de références à contacter

Les dossiers de candidatures portant la mention suivante peuvent être déposées au Secrétariat de la Coordination nationale à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous au plus tard le 14 septembre 2026 à 15 heures 30 (heure locale) avec la mention suivante :

« Recrutement d’un consultant national pour l’élaboration des guides et outils de communication en langue nationale et du carnet des parents ».

NB : Le dépôt en ligne n’est pas autorisé

Pour toutes informations complémentaires, veuillez consulter les Termes de Références (TDR) dans le site Web : pfss-comores.org/ www.pfss-comores.org

Country – Commonwealth of Dominica

 

Assignment Title: Technical Specialist for Implementation, Operations and Maintenance of an E-ticketing System

Reference No DM-MOERMKU-563244-CS-INDV

Project: Leveraging Eco-Tourism for Biodiversity Protection in Dominica (P170846)

Grant No. TF-B9551

Implementing Agency: Ministry of Environment, Rural Modernisation, Kalinago Upliftment and Constituency Empowerment

1. Background

The Government of the Commonwealth of Dominica has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Leveraging Eco-Tourism for Biodiversity Protection in Dominica and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. The Ministry of Environment, Rural Modernisation, Kalinago Upliftment and Constituency Empowerment intend to procure the services of an individual consultant to serve as a Technical Specialist for the Implementation, Operations and Maintenance of an E-ticketing System.

 

2. Objective of Assignment

The objective of the assignment is to support the full deployment, operationalization, maintenance, and optimization of an integrated e-ticketing system across all eco-tourism sites and the Waitukubuli National Trail (WNT). This includes assessing IT infrastructure and organizational readiness, recommending appropriate hardware and organizational arrangements, providing training and software configuration, and ensuring smooth integration and operation within national IT systems.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Qualifications

  • University degree (bachelor or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Business Information Systems or another relevant field.

Experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years’ experience on similar assignments as in this Terms of Reference.
  • Experience with e-ticketing systems and visitor management systems.
  • Experience with ICT infrastructure deployment and procurement.
  • Experience with payment gateways and electronic transactions.
  • Experience in training and organizational change management.
  • Experience working with donor-funded projects and government institutions.
  • Experience in tourism, protected areas, parks management, or similar sectors would be an asset.

 

Skills

  • Good knowledge of English, verbal and written.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work in remote field locations throughout Dominica.

 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment may be requested by contacting the following email addresses: letbp@dominica.gov.dm or letbpprocurement@gmail.com

4. Submission Requirements

Expressions of Interest shall include:

  1. Letter of interest
  2. Curriculum Vitae
  3. Description of Similar assignments
  4. Details of experience with e-ticketing/visitor management systems, ICT infrastructure deployment and procurement, payment gateways/electronic transactions, training and organizational change management, and working with donor-funded projects and government institutions.

 

EOI’s should be a max of 5-10 pages.

Expressions of interest must be submitted in a written form (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) to the following addresses:

 

Attn: Project Coordinator

Leveraging Eco-Tourism for Biodiversity Protection in

      Dominica Project

First Floor, 38 Cork Street

Roseau, Commonwealth of Dominica

E-mail: letbp@dominica.gov.dm letbpprocurement@gmail.com copied to letbp.procurement@gmail.com .

 

Deadline for Submission: 11:59 p.m. Eastern Caribbean Time (ECT), September 11, 2026

Further information can be obtained through letbp@dominica.gov.dm or letbpprocurement@gmail.com to seek clarification.

5. Shortlisting and Selection

In the assessment of submissions, consideration will be given to the applicant’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and experience in similar assignments, including experience in e-ticketing/visitor management and ICT infrastructure/integration experience. Only experience clearly demonstrated and supported by the submitted documentation will be considered. The Individual Consultant who is determined to be the best qualified and experienced for the assignment will be selected.

6. Fraud and Corruption

The attention of interested Individuals is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” 7th Edition (September 2025) setting forth the World Bank’s policy on Conflict of Interest.  In addition, please refer to the following specific information on conflict of interest related to this assignment i.e., 3.17 (c) & (d) of the Procurement Regulation.

SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE PARA SERVIÇOS DE CONSULTORIA INDIVIDUAL – SMI Nº 2026/006

 

Mutuário: Banco da Amazônia (BASA)

Instituição Financiadora: Banco Internacional para Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD)

País: Brasil

Projeto: Acelerando a Transição Energética na Amazônia (P177200)

Empréstimo: Loan Agreement IBRD [P181966 - TF0C8868]

 

Objeto:

Contratação de Consultor(a) Individual Especialista em Gestão Financeira para apoiar a Unidade de Gestão do Projeto (UGP) e o Banco da Amazônia na implementação do Projeto Acelerando a Transição Energética na Amazônia (AETA), mediante a realização de análises técnicas e financeiras, planejamento e monitoramento orçamentário, desenvolvimento de instrumentos e procedimentos de gestão financeira e fiduciária, apoio à execução e ao acompanhamento dos recursos do Projeto, preparação de relatórios financeiros e gerenciais, suporte aos processos de desembolso, auditoria, supervisão fiduciária e prestação de contas, bem como fortalecimento da capacidade institucional do Banco da Amazônia em gestão financeira de projetos financiados por organismos multilaterais, em conformidade com os requisitos do Banco Mundial, os acordos de financiamento, a legislação aplicável e os instrumentos de governança da operação.

 

Princípios Aplicáveis

O processo de seleção observará os princípios de Value for Money, Integridade, Eficiência, Adequação ao Propósito, Transparência, Economia e Equidade previstos no Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial.

 

Resumo:

O Projeto AETA tem por objetivo ampliar a geração de energia renovável, apoiar investimentos em infraestrutura energética sustentável e reduzir custos de energia na Amazônia Legal, por meio de financiamento do Banco Internacional para Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD) e de recursos de assistência técnica destinados ao fortalecimento institucional do Banco da Amazônia. O Banco da Amazônia atua como mutuário, instituição financeira intermediária e entidade implementadora do Projeto, sendo responsável pela gestão dos recursos financeiros, pela implementação dos componentes financiados e pelo cumprimento das obrigações assumidas perante o Banco Mundial.

No âmbito da implementação do Projeto, o Banco da Amazônia deverá assegurar a adequada gestão financeira e fiduciária dos recursos disponibilizados, incluindo atividades relacionadas ao planejamento orçamentário, monitoramento da execução financeira, gestão de desembolsos, prestação de contas, elaboração de relatórios financeiros, acompanhamento de auditorias e observância dos requisitos fiduciários estabelecidos pelo Banco Mundial e pelos acordos de financiamento da operação.

A estrutura da operação, que combina recursos de empréstimo e de doação destinados ao financiamento de investimentos em transição energética e ao fortalecimento institucional, demanda mecanismos robustos de planejamento financeiro, controle orçamentário, monitoramento da execução físico-financeira, acompanhamento da utilização dos recursos e geração de informações gerenciais e fiduciárias que apoiem a tomada de decisão da UGP e da administração do Banco da Amazônia.

Nesse contexto, a UGP necessita de apoio técnico especializado para fortalecer os mecanismos de gestão financeira e fiduciária do Projeto, apoiar a elaboração de análises financeiras, projeções de desembolso e instrumentos de planejamento orçamentário, desenvolver processos, metodologias e ferramentas de monitoramento financeiro, estruturar mecanismos de controle e conformidade, apoiar auditorias e supervisões fiduciárias e contribuir para o fortalecimento institucional do Banco da Amazônia em gestão financeira de projetos financiados por organismos multilaterais.

A presente contratação tem por finalidade selecionar Consultor(a) Individual Especialista em Gestão Financeira para apoiar a implementação do Projeto AETA, contribuindo para o fortalecimento da governança financeira e fiduciária da operação, para a adequada utilização dos recursos financeiros disponibilizados pelo Banco Mundial e para o fortalecimento da capacidade institucional do Banco da Amazônia em gestão financeira de projetos de investimento.

 

Manifestação de Interesse:

Os interessados deverão apresentar Currículo Vitae (CV) detalhado, no qual o cumprimento dos requisitos obrigatórios e desejáveis, bem como suas qualificações e experiência relevantes para o escopo dos serviços, estejam claramente demonstrados.

As Manifestações de Interesse deverão ser enviadas para o e-mail [samara.farias@basa.com.br e pablo.nahmias@basa.com.br] até às [23:59 – horário de Brasília/DF] do dia [28/08/2026].

Os critérios de avaliação do perfil profissional do Consultor Individual estão descritos no Termo de Referência (TDR) da consultoria, que será disponibilizado aos interessados mediante solicitação encaminhada aos e-mails [samara.farias@basa.com.br e pablo.nahmias@basa.com.br]. Para fins de identificação, recomenda-se que a solicitação informe o número da Solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse (SMI) correspondente. Os critérios incluem, minimamente: 

Qualificações Obrigatórias (Critérios Eliminatórios):

  • Formação Acadêmica Mínima:  Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Finanças, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Econômica, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas reconhecidas pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional comprovada em atividades relacionadas à gestão financeira, planejamento financeiro, orçamento, controladoria, gestão fiduciária, finanças corporativas, auditoria, gestão de projetos, acompanhamento de investimentos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Projetos Complexos: Mínimo de 5 (cinco) anos de experiência comprovada em projetos de elevada complexidade técnica e financeira, envolvendo investimentos, infraestrutura, energia, desenvolvimento sustentável, instituições financeiras, organismos multilaterais, programas governamentais ou iniciativas de grande porte.
  • Experiência em Gestão Financeira e Orçamentária: Experiência comprovada na elaboração, monitoramento ou gestão de orçamentos, projeções financeiras, planejamento financeiro, fluxo de caixa, acompanhamento de execução financeira ou instrumentos equivalentes de gestão financeira.
  • Experiência em Elaboração de Relatórios e Análises Financeiras: Experiência comprovada na elaboração de relatórios financeiros, análises gerenciais, pareceres técnicos, estudos financeiros, indicadores de desempenho, projeções ou instrumentos de apoio à tomada de decisão. 

Qualificações Desejáveis (Critérios de Classificação) 

Os candidatos habilitados nos critérios obrigatórios serão avaliados e classificados com base nos seguintes aspectos: 

  • Formação Acadêmica Complementar: Pós-graduação Lato Sensu (Especialização), Mestrado ou Doutorado em Finanças, Administração Financeira, Controladoria, Economia, Contabilidade, Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Pública, Planejamento, Finanças Corporativas, Avaliação Econômica, Gestão de Riscos, Governança Corporativa ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com Organismos Multilaterais: Experiência profissional em projetos financiados pelo Banco Mundial, Banco Interamericano de Desenvolvimento (BID), CAF, KfW, AFD, GCF, GEF ou organismos multilaterais equivalentes.
  • Experiência em Gestão Financeira e Fiduciária de Projetos: Experiência na gestão financeira, monitoramento fiduciário, planejamento orçamentário, execução financeira, prestação de contas ou acompanhamento de operações financiadas por organismos multilaterais ou instituições financeiras de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência em Relatórios Financeiros e Prestação de Contas: Experiência na elaboração, revisão ou monitoramento de demonstrações financeiras, relatórios financeiros periódicos, relatórios fiduciários, relatórios gerenciais, indicadores financeiros ou instrumentos de prestação de contas para financiadores nacionais ou internacionais.
  • Experiência em Auditoria, Controles Internos e Conformidade: Experiência na condução, acompanhamento ou suporte a auditorias financeiras, auditorias de projetos, controles internos, gestão de riscos, compliance, controles fiduciários ou processos de supervisão financeira.
  • Experiência em Instituições Financeiras: Experiência profissional em bancos de desenvolvimento, bancos públicos, bancos multilaterais, agências de fomento, fundos de investimento, cooperativas financeiras, instituições financeiras reguladas ou organizações com processos estruturados de gestão financeira e controle fiduciário.
  • Experiência em Planejamento Orçamentário e Monitoramento Financeiro: Experiência comprovada na elaboração de orçamentos institucionais, planejamento plurianual, acompanhamento de execução financeira, projeções de desembolso, controle orçamentário e monitoramento de indicadores financeiros.
  • Experiência em Projetos de Infraestrutura, Energia ou Desenvolvimento Sustentável: Experiência profissional em projetos relacionados à infraestrutura, energia renovável, transição energética, desenvolvimento regional, sustentabilidade, mudanças climáticas ou investimentos de impacto socioeconômico.
  • Experiência na Amazônia Legal: Experiência em projetos desenvolvidos na Amazônia Legal, envolvendo investimentos, desenvolvimento sustentável, infraestrutura, energia, bioeconomia, finanças sustentáveis, financiamento ao desenvolvimento ou fortalecimento institucional.
  • Produção Técnica: Experiência comprovada na elaboração de estudos financeiros, análises econômicas, diagnósticos institucionais, modelos financeiros, matrizes de riscos, painéis gerenciais, procedimentos operacionais, manuais, metodologias de monitoramento, relatórios técnicos ou documentos de apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência em Sistemas e Ferramentas de Gestão: Experiência na utilização de sistemas corporativos de gestão financeira, sistemas orçamentários, ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI), plataformas de monitoramento, ERPs ou sistemas de gestão de projetos.

SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE PARA SERVIÇOS DE CONSULTORIA INDIVIDUAL – SMI Nº 2026/008

 

Mutuário: Banco da Amazônia (BASA)

Instituição Financiadora: Banco Internacional para Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD)

País: Brasil

Projeto: Acelerando a Transição Energética na Amazônia (P177200)

Empréstimo: Loan Agreement IBRD [P181966 - TF0C8868]

 

Objeto:

Contratação de Consultor(a) Individual Especialista em Monitoramento, Avaliação, Conformidade e Reporte para apoiar a Unidade de Gestão do Projeto (UGP) do Banco da Amazônia na implementação do Projeto Acelerando a Transição Energética na Amazônia (AETA), por meio da estruturação e operacionalização dos mecanismos de monitoramento e avaliação da operação, acompanhamento de indicadores e resultados, monitoramento de conformidade, gestão da informação, reporte institucional e acompanhamento da carteira de subprojetos financiados, em conformidade com os requisitos do Banco Mundial e os instrumentos de implementação do Projeto.

 

Princípios Aplicáveis

O processo de seleção observará os princípios de Value for Money, Integridade, Eficiência, Adequação ao Propósito, Transparência, Economia e Equidade previstos no Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial.

 

Resumo:

O Projeto Acelerando a Transição Energética na Amazônia (AETA) tem por objetivo ampliar a geração de energia renovável, apoiar investimentos em infraestrutura energética sustentável, aumentar o acesso à energia e reduzir os custos energéticos na Amazônia Legal, por meio de financiamento do Banco Internacional para Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD) e de recursos destinados ao fortalecimento institucional do Banco da Amazônia. O Banco da Amazônia atua como instituição financeira intermediária e entidade implementadora do Projeto, sendo responsável pela gestão dos recursos, coordenação da implementação, acompanhamento dos investimentos apoiados e cumprimento das obrigações assumidas perante o Banco Mundial.

A implementação do Projeto requer mecanismos estruturados de monitoramento, avaliação, conformidade e reporte capazes de assegurar o acompanhamento sistemático dos indicadores, resultados, metas e compromissos da operação, bem como a adequada prestação de contas ao Banco Mundial e às instâncias de governança do Projeto. Considerando a complexidade da operação, a diversidade de atores envolvidos, os requisitos fiduciários, ambientais e sociais aplicáveis e a necessidade de monitoramento dos subprojetos financiados, torna-se fundamental fortalecer a capacidade institucional da Unidade de Gestão do Projeto (UGP) para geração, consolidação, análise e reporte de informações estratégicas relacionadas à implementação do AETA.

Nesse contexto, a UGP necessita de apoio técnico especializado para estruturar e operacionalizar sistemas de monitoramento e avaliação, desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores, monitorar compromissos institucionais, fiduciários, ambientais e sociais, apoiar a gestão de evidências de conformidade, elaborar relatórios gerenciais e institucionais, apoiar missões de supervisão, auditorias e avaliações, bem como acompanhar a carteira de subprojetos financiados no âmbito da operação.

A presente contratação tem por finalidade selecionar Consultor(a) Individual Especialista em Monitoramento, Avaliação, Conformidade e Reporte para apoiar a implementação do Projeto AETA, contribuindo para o fortalecimento da capacidade institucional do Banco da Amazônia, para a melhoria da gestão baseada em resultados e para o cumprimento dos requisitos de monitoramento, supervisão e prestação de contas estabelecidos pelo Banco Mundial.

 

Manifestação de Interesse:

Os interessados deverão apresentar Currículo Vitae (CV) detalhado, no qual o cumprimento dos requisitos obrigatórios e desejáveis, bem como suas qualificações e experiência relevantes para o escopo dos serviços, estejam claramente demonstrados.

As Manifestações de Interesse deverão ser enviadas para o e-mail [samara.farias@basa.com.br e pablo.nahmias@basa.com.br] até às [23:59 – horário de Brasília/DF] do dia [01/09/2026].

Os critérios de avaliação do perfil profissional do Consultor Individual estão descritos no Termo de Referência (TDR) da consultoria, que será disponibilizado aos interessados mediante solicitação encaminhada aos e-mails [samara.farias@basa.com.br e pablo.nahmias@basa.com.br]. Para fins de identificação, recomenda-se que a solicitação informe o número da Solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse (SMI) correspondente. Os critérios incluem, minimamente: 

Qualificações Obrigatórias (Critérios Eliminatórios):

  • Formação Acadêmica Mínima:  Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos, Ciências Contábeis, Administração Pública, Relações Internacionais, Ciência de Dados, Sistemas de Informação, Matemática, Direito, ou áreas correlatas, com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.
  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência profissional comprovada mínima de 5 (cinco) anos em pelo menos uma das seguintes áreas: Monitoramento e avaliação de projetos; Gestão de indicadores de desempenho; Gestão por resultados; Planejamento e monitoramento institucional; Gestão da informação; Controle e acompanhamento de programas ou projetos; Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e analíticos; Gestão de conformidade e acompanhamento de compromissos institucionais.
  • Experiência em Projetos Complexos: Experiência profissional comprovada mínima de 5 (cinco) anos em projetos de elevada complexidade técnica envolvendo Organizações públicas ou privadas de médio ou grande porte; Instituições financeiras; Programas governamentais; Organismos multilaterais; Projetos de infraestrutura, desenvolvimento regional, sustentabilidade ou transformação institucional.
  • Experiência em Monitoramento e Reporte: Experiência comprovada na elaboração, implementação ou operação de pelo menos um dos seguintes instrumentos:  Sistemas de monitoramento e avaliação (M&A); Matrizes de indicadores; Painéis de monitoramento e desempenho; Sistemas de reporte institucional; Relatórios de acompanhamento de projetos; Instrumentos de controle e conformidade; Sistemas de gestão da informação; Mecanismos de acompanhamento de metas e resultados.

Qualificações Desejáveis (Critérios de Classificação) 

Os candidatos habilitados nos critérios obrigatórios serão avaliados e classificados com base nos seguintes aspectos: 

  • Formação Acadêmica Complementar: Pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) em áreas como Monitoramento e Avaliação; Gestão de Projetos; Administração Pública; Economia; Estatística; Ciência de Dados; Planejamento e Gestão Estratégica; Gestão por Resultados; Gestão de Riscos; Governança; Compliance; Sustentabilidade; Desenvolvimento Regional; Políticas Públicas; Engenharia de Produção; Áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência em Conformidade e Gestão de Compromissos: Experiência comprovada em Monitoramento de obrigações contratuais; Gestão de conformidade; Auditorias e controles internos; Gestão de evidências; Monitoramento de requisitos ambientais e sociais; Acompanhamento de planos de ação; Gestão de riscos de implementação.
  • Experiência em Instituições Financeiras: Experiência profissional em Bancos de desenvolvimento; Bancos públicos; Agências de fomento; Instituições financeiras multilaterais; Fundos de investimento; Estruturas de financiamento ao desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência em Projetos de Energia, Infraestrutura ou Sustentabilidade: Experiência comprovada em projetos relacionados a Energia renovável; Transição energética; Infraestrutura; Sustentabilidade; Finanças climáticas; Desenvolvimento regional; Investimentos socioambientais.
  • Experiência na Amazônia Legal: Experiência em projetos, programas, avaliações ou estudos desenvolvidos na Amazônia Legal envolvendo Desenvolvimento regional; Energia; Infraestrutura; Sustentabilidade; Finanças verdes; Políticas públicas; Gestão pública; Fortalecimento institucional.

Specific Procurement Notice (SPN)

Request for Bids

Framework Agreement(s) for Goods

(One-Envelope Bidding Process)

Procuring Agency: Federal Board of Revenue (FBR), Government of Pakistan

Country: Pakistan

Name of Project: Pakistan Raises Revenue Program

Framework Agreement Title: Procurement and Installation of External Electrification Systems for Digital Enforcement Stations (DES) at Indus Sites, Phase-I (10 Sites)

RFB Reference No.: 3(7)/2026-Addl-Dir(P&F) / PK-FBR-565389-GO-RFB

Loan No./Credit No./Grant No.: 7867-PK

  1. The Procuring Agency, Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Pakistan Raises Revenue Program (PRRP), and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under Call-off Contracts that may be awarded under the Framework Agreement (FA) for the Procurement and Installation of External Electrification Systems for Digital Enforcement Stations (DES) at Indus Sites, Phase-I (10 Sites) concluded through this RFB Procurement process.
  2. The Procuring Agency is undertaking Procurement with a view to concluding Framework Agreements. The Procuring Agency now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for Procurement and Installation of External Electrification Systems for Digital Enforcement Stations (DES) at Indus Sites, Phase-I (10 Sites) vide Framework Agreement, at various locations mentioned in the bidding document.
  3. This procurement will result in a Framework Agreement for each Lot with a Framework Supplier. Technical specifications, unit rates, contractual terms and conditions shall be finalized during the Procurement process. Call-off Contracts shall be issued as administrative Work Orders for identified sites.
  4. The selection of a FA Supplier to be awarded a Call-off Contract will be done through the Procurement process as defined in Framework Agreement. However, the conclusion of a Framework Agreement shall not impose any obligation on the Procuring Agency, to purchase Goods under a Call-off Contract. The conclusion Framework Agreement does not guarantee that a FA Supplier will be awarded a Call-off Contract.
  5. Bidding will be conducted through National Competitive Procurement using a Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers”, Fifth Edition, September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”) and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations.
  6. Bidders may submit Bids for one or more of the Lots. Each Lot shall be evaluated independently and a separate Framework Agreement shall be concluded with one successful Bidder for each Lot. Bidders shall quote for 100% of the requirements of the respective Lot(s) and sites. Partial bids for incomplete quantities for a lot or sites within a Lot shall not be permitted. Appel d’Offres pour Fournitures (Processus à Une Enveloppe)

1. Le Gouvernement de la République de Madagascar a reçu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour financer le Projet de Productivité et de Résilience des Moyens de Subsistance Ruraux - Riz plus, et à l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer des paiements au titre des Marchés de « Fourniture, livraison et installation de 595 kits de matériels FLID de la Région Alaotra Mangoro ».

Pour ce marché, l’Emprunteur utilisera la méthode de décaissement par Paiement Direct, telle que définie dans les Directives de Décaissement de la Banque mondiale pour le Financement de Projet d’Investissement, à l’exception des paiements pour lesquels le marché prévoit l’utilisation de crédit documentaire.

2. L'Unité de Gestion du Projet RIZ PLUS sollicite des offres fermées de la part de soumissionnaires éligibles et répondant aux qualifications requises pour la fourniture, la livraison et l'installation de 595 kits de matériels FLID (kits d'irrigation solaire) destinés à la Région Alaotra Mangoro, constituant un lot unique et indivisible (595 Kits « PortaSol » (pompe solaire de surface transportable, 2 panneaux de 380 W minimum)).

Les lieux de destination finale, au sens de la version des Incoterms spécifiée dans le Dossier d'Appel d'Offres, sont constitués par les sites d'implantation des kits situés dans les trois (03) districts de Ambatondrazaka, Amparafaravola et Moramanga dans la Région Alaotra Mangoro, République de Madagascar. Les Fournitures transiteront par un magasin de transit à Antananarivo puis par les chefs-lieux de districts, conformément au calendrier de livraison figurant dans le Dossier d'Appel d’Offres.

Les prestations comprennent, outre la fourniture des équipements conformes aux Spécifications techniques de la Section VII : le transport jusqu'au magasin de transit d'Antananarivo, l'ensemble des formalités et frais d'importation et de dédouanement, le magasinage, le gardiennage et l'assurance des Fournitures au magasin de transit, l'allotissement par district et la réexpédition jusqu'aux chefs-lieux des trois districts, le transport terminal jusqu'aux sites d'implantation, l'installation et la mise en service de chaque kit avec essais de bon fonctionnement, la formation individuelle de chacun des 595 exploitants bénéficiaires sur sa parcelle, une démonstration collective par district, la fourniture de la documentation technique en langue française, la remise d'un rapport final d'exécution par district, la disponibilité des pièces de rechange et d'un point de service après-vente dans chacun des trois districts d'installation, ainsi qu'une garantie de vingt-quatre (24) mois à compter de la réception provisoire prononcée par district.

Les délais contractuels sont les suivants :

  • Fourniture et livraison de l'intégralité des 595 kits au magasin de transit d'Antananarivo : cent cinq (105) jours calendaires au plus tard, comptés à partir du lendemain de la date de notification de l'ordre de service de commencer ;
  • Allotissement par district, réexpédition et livraison de l'intégralité des kits aux chefs-lieux des trois (03) districts de la Région Alaotra Mangoro : soixante (60) jours calendaires au plus tard, comptés à partir du lendemain de la date de réception quantitative des Fournitures au magasin de transit ;
  • Services connexes comprenant le transport terminal jusqu'aux sites d'implantation, l'installation, la mise en service, les essais de bon fonctionnement et la formation des exploitants de l'ensemble des kits : cent quatre-vingts (180) jours calendaires au plus tard, comptés à partir du lendemain de la date de notification de l'ordre de service d'installation. Cet ordre de service est émis par l'Acheteur après achèvement de la livraison aux chefs-lieux de district, et au plus tôt le 1er avril 2027, la période d'installation devant coïncider avec le calendrier cultural des exploitants bénéficiaires.

Les frais de magasinage, de gardiennage, d'assurance et de réexpédition entre les délais a) et b) sont à la charge exclusive du Fournisseur et réputés inclus dans le prix de l'Offre. Les lieux de destination finale, demeurent constitués par les sites d'implantation situés dans les trois districts.

Toute offre proposant un délai supérieur à l'un ou l'autre de ces délais sera considérée comme non conforme et écartée. Aucun bonus ne sera accordé pour une exécution anticipée.

TERMS OF REFERENCE

For

Individual Consultant (20 months)

-Time based-

HYDRAULIC ENGINEER

 

Background

Following the devastation caused by hurricanes Irma and Maria in September 2017, the Government of Sint Maarten embarked on a large-scale recovery and reconstruction program, based on the principle of building back better.

Since January 2018, the World Bank is assisting the Government of Sint Maarten. A significant part of Sint Maarten’s ongoing recovery and reconstruction program is financed through a Trust Fund financed by the Netherlands, managed by the World Bank, and implemented by Sint Maarten.

To support the implementation of the Trust Fund, the Government of Sint Maarten established the National Recovery Program Bureau (NRPB), which serves as the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) for the Government of Sint Maarten.

Short Description of the Project

The Wastewater Management Project (hereinafter referred to as “the Project”) implements a wide range of activities, in close collaboration with government counterparts and ministries, notably Ministry of Public Housing, Spatial Planning, Environment, and Infrastructure (hereinafter referred to as “VROMI”.

The project consists of the improvement of the coverage and performance of the wastewater system in Sint Maarten. This will be done through the expansion of the existing sewerage network to enable the connection for residents and commercial enterprises, the rehabilitation of critical parts of the existing sewage system to improve its climate resilience and operational efficiency and the improvement of the wastewater treatment plant.

Role of the Engineer

NRPB is seeking the services of an Engineer [hereinafter referred to as “Consultant”] to support the NRPB with technical expertise on all construction-related activities under the Wastewater Management Project and any other project that could utilize the specific expertise of the Engineer. The Engineer will assist the NRPB in the development of terms of references, technical drawings, bills of quantities, cost estimates, bidding documents etc. (S)he will monitor works on behalf of the project Manager (PM) and represent the NRPB in technical committee meetings and evaluations upon

SWAMP PM request. The Engineer shall report regularly on the progress of project implementation to the NRPB.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

The Engineer will be a full-time professional responsible for technical aspects of project execution and supervision and will support the NRPB with all matters concerning construction under the Project. Construction activities under the project include the installation of sewerage pipes, construction of manholes, connections to buildings and upgrade works in the wastewater treatment plant.

The Engineer’s responsibilities will include:

1. Work within the NRPB on the implementation of the Project following the rules and regulations of the World Bank.

2. In coordination with NRPB Procurement, as well as line ministries/external agencies, manage and supervise the preparation of all required technical project documents including Terms of Reference (ToRs) for consultants and consulting firms, specifications, and designs for works.

3. Cooperate and coordinate with operational units of line ministries/agencies to develop technical terms of references, scope of works, bills of quantities and cost estimates.

4. Assist NRPB Procurement in the preparation of technical tender documents.

5. Identify all technical elements and documentation required to implement assigned project activities.

6. Represent the NRPB as the contracting officer’s technical representative (COTR) during project execution and serve as the principal contact with consultants and contractors during project execution.

7. Represent the NRPB in technical bid evaluations during the contracting process.

8. Track activities’ progress, specifically to ensure timely conclusion of works.

9. Regularly monitor and report on project execution progress and budget performance.

10. Regularly liaise with the Project Manager, NRPB Procurement Officers, E&S Officers, Legal Officers, and M&E Specialist to ensure achievement of the program objectives, as well as ensure compliance with World Bank procedures.

11. Work directly with project counterparts and relevant stakeholders to ensure deliverables fall within the applicable scope and budget. This will involve coordinating with other departments within the Government as well as external counterparts, to ensure all aspects of each construction activity are compatible and to clarify specific requirements of each project.

12. Report periodically to the Project Manager on progress and challenges of ongoing construction activities.

13. Make suggestions that may improve his/her own job description or implementation, the overall implementation of SWaMP or the functioning of the NRPB.

14. Assist with any other project that could utilize the specific expertise of the Engineer.

15. Conduct any other ad hoc technical or contract management work as directed by the Project Managers.

Contractual Arrangements.

A time-based contract is expected to be signed. The start date of the contract will be October 2026 or soon thereafter. The contract’s duration will be 20 months, until 30 June 2028. The successful candidate is expected to be based within Philipsburg, Sint Maarten. The Consultant is expected to perform the above-mentioned tasks on an ongoing basis during the term of his/her assignment, to the satisfaction of the Project Manager.

The consultant will report monthly to the Project Manager

The performance of the Consultant will be appraised by the Project Manager based on the timely implementation and execution of tasks described under the key responsibilities for the role.

Qualification requirements

Minimum Requirements

· Master’s degree in civil engineering, water or wastewater Engineering;

- With a Master’s Degree: A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the field of technical design, construction management and site supervision

Or: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, water or wastewater Engineering;

- With a Bachelor’s Degree: A minimum of 7 years of professional experience in the field of technical design, construction management and site supervision;

· Functionally computer literate, possessing operational skills in word-processing and spreadsheet software such as MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and project management software such as MS Project;

· Proven relevant experience in preparation of technical documentation, Terms of references, technical bidding documents and specifications.

· Proven relevant experience of wastewater installations management and site supervision;

· Proven relevant experience in managing external consultants and contractors;

· Proven experience with the preparation of technical briefings and reports.

· Fluency in English;

· Ability to work with and coordinate other professionals in engineering activities;

· Demonstrated ability to work in teams within a collaborative mode; develop and maintain effective work relationships with counterparts;

· Ability to manage priorities and workflow within deadlines and work efficiently under pressure;

· Time management and organizational skills with attention to detail;

Preferred Experience

 

· Experience in multidisciplinary, donor-funded projects.

· Familiarity with World Bank procedures would be a significant advantage.

· Proficiency in Dutch in speech and writing is an advantage.

· Understanding the challenges faced by (Caribbean), Small Island Developing States (SIDS);

 

 

Strategic Competencies – brief description

 

NRPB as an organization is committed not only to WHAT we must achieve but also on HOW we are going to reach our objectives. Therefore, for this position we are looking for a profile that displays the following competencies:

Professional Acumen - Intermediate Level

· Applies problem-solving methodologies and tools to diagnose and solve operational and interpersonal problems;

· Determines the potential causes of the problem and works on certain scenarios;

· Sees opportunities and takes the initiative to act on them;

· Understands that responsible use of resources maximizes our impact on our beneficiaries;

· Open to change and flexible in a fast-paced environment;

· Effectively adapts own approach to suit changing circumstances or requirements;

· Evaluates data and courses of action to reach logical, pragmatic decisions;

· Takes an unbiased, rational approach with calculated risks;

Looking at the bigger picture – Strategic outlook – Beginner Level

· Aligns current work and activities with the NRPB’s strategic goals;

· Acts on and implements strategies and policies in accordance with the NRPB’s strategic goals;

· Comprehends operational and organizational goals and direction;

Leading myself and the others – Intermediate Level

· Regularly provides constructive feedback and recognition to team members regarding job performance;

· Collaborates and supports the development of others;

· Shares own knowledge and best practices with others for the purpose of assisting in their ongoing development;

Respect for diversity - Intermediate level

· Treats all individuals with respect;

· Responds sensitively to differences and encourages others to do the same;

· Shows flexibility in changing the styles when faced with multiple dimensions of culture to be effective across cultural contexts;

· Understands multiple cultural frameworks, values, and norms;

Successful Communication – Intermediate level

· Explains issues clearly and succinctly;

· Writes clearly and succinctly in standard communication settings and styles;

· Can clearly identify the subject and state the purpose of the communication;

· Communicates with impact as well as with empathy;

· Remains calm when dealing with conflicts; shows empathy;

Relationship Building. Consultation and Collaboration – Intermediate level

· Shares information and readily determines to whom to go for relevant information;

· Seeks assistance and feedback in the problem-solving process;

· Fosters teamwork;

· Initiate collaboration on projects or methods of operating;

· Demonstrates understanding of the impact of own role on all partners and always puts the end beneficiary first;

Courage and Integrity –Intermediate level

· Maintains general knowledge of ethics, laws, regulations, standards that may impact the organization

· Reinforces difficult decisions that align with the organizational strategies and goals

· Enforces policies consistently

· Influences others to behave in an ethical manner

· Takes immediate action regarding reports of unethical behaviors or conflict of interest

In the subject line, please state, “Hydraulic Engineer ”. The CV should clearly present relevant experience to meet minimum requirements and preferred requirements, as outlined in this terms of reference.

Applicants should ensure that their CV is received before __________2026, at 17h00 AST. Any CVs received after this deadline may not be considered.

When applying, please consider the following requirements:

· Applicants may also be subject to satisfactory background checks.

description:
REPÚBLICA DA GUINÉ-BISSAU

         MINISTÉRIO DO AMBIENTE, BIODIVERSIDADE E AÇÃO CLIMÁTICA INSTITUTO DA         BIODIVERSIDADE E DAS ÁREAS PROTEGIDAS - DR. ALFREDO SIMÃO DA SILVA (IBAP)                              PROJETO DE INVESTIMENTO NA RESILIÊNCIA DAS ZONAS COSTEIRAS DA                                                               ÁFRICA OCIDENTAL (WACA - RESIP II)   

                    ANÚNCIO DE CONCURSO – Refª AN/003/Agosto/WACA-ResIP 2 GB/CI/2026

                    RECRUTAMENTO DE UM(A) ENCARREGADO(a) DE PROJETO REDD+

   I. CONTEXTO

Tal como noutros países da África Ocidental, na Guiné-Bissau a degradação dos recursos e ecossistemas costeiros está a acelerar devido à crescente pressão demográfica na costa e às alterações climáticas. A deterioração costeira está a conduzir a uma perda significativa e potencialmente irreversível de ecossistemas críticos, tais como praias, sistemas de dunas e mangais, que fornecem importantes serviços ambientais, sociais e de proteção costeira (meios de subsistência e recursos naturais, alimentos, proteção contra a erosão e inundações). Por conseguinte, o Governo da Guiné-Bissau solicitou e obteve apoio técnico e financeiro do Banco Mundial para implementar o Projeto de Investimento para a Resiliência Costeira da África Ocidental - Guiné-Bissau (WACA ResIP 2 GB). Ver mais detalhes nos termos de referência.

  II. OBJETIVO

O objetivo deste anúncio é o recrutamento de um(a) encarregado(a) de projeto REDD+ que será responsável pelo seguimento e pela coordenação das atividades relacionadas com os projetos REDD+ implementados pelo Instituto da Biodiversidade e Áreas Protegidas (IBAP) e pela Fundação BioGuiné (FBG) na Guiné-Bissau.

   III. CONVITE

A Unidade de Gestão do ResIP 2 GB da WACA (UGP do ResIP 2 GB da WACA) convida os consultores individuais elegíveis a manifestar interesse em prestar os serviços acima descritos. Os consultores interessados devem fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações exigidas e experiência relevante. 

É levado ao conhecimento dos consultores o facto de serem aplicáveis as disposições relativas às regras do Banco Mundial em matéria de conflito de interesses, tal como descritas nos parágrafos 3.14 e seguintes dos “Regulamentos de aquisição para mutuários que procuram financiamento de projetos de investimento (FPI)”, datados de fevereiro de 2025 e revistos em setembro de 2025. 

  IV. PERFIL DO(A) CANDIDATO(A)

Os candidatos interessados em ocupar este posto, devem:

  • Formação acadêmica: Bacharelado ou mestrado em áreas como conservação da natureza, engenharia ambiental ou florestal, biologia vegetal, gestão de recursos naturais, ciências ambientais ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência profissional: Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em projetos ou instituições atuando em questões ambientais, de conservação ou de mudanças climáticas.

Conhecimento técnico:

  • Experiência na implementação de projetos relacionados a questões florestais e na redução do desmatamento ou reflorestamento.
  • Familiaridade com avaliações de impacto social, ambiental e de biodiversidade.
  • O conhecimento em sensoriamento remoto, SIG e o entendimento de como funciona o mercado de carbono é uma grande vantagem.
  • Conhecimento de projetos certificados REDD+, incluindo a aplicação de normas internacionais como Verra (VCS), ART-TREES ou Gold Standard, bem como conhecimento de metodologias de carbono azul, especialmente em ecossistemas de manguezais e áreas costeiras.
  • Experiência com monitoramento GIS e sistemas de análise espacial aplicados a florestas e áreas costeiras.
  • Habilidades linguísticas: Fluência em português e bom conhecimento de inglês. O conhecimento de crioulo ou francês é uma vantagem.Habilidades interpessoais: Habilidade de trabalhar em ambientes complexos e gerenciar múltiplos stakeholders com interesses diferentes, demonstrando habilidades de comunicação eficazes tanto com públicos técnicos quanto não técnicos. Ver mais detalhes nos termos de referência.

 

  • V. MÉTODO DE SELEÇÃO

O gabinete ou consórcio será selecionado utilizando o método de Seleção de Consultores Individuais (CI) de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos no Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários que procuram Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento (FPI) para Fornecimentos, Obras, Serviços e outros que Serviços de Consultoria, e Serviços de Consultoria de fevereiro de 2025, revisto em setembro de 2025.

Para se candidatar a este posto, os candidatos interessados devem apresentar um dossiê de candidatura contendo:

  1. Um currículo Vitae atualizado.
  2. Uma carta de apresentação (manifestação de interesse).
  3. Uma cópia(s) autenticada(s) dos diplomas e certificados obtidos.
  4. Uma cópia do documento de identificação (bilhete de identidade e/ou passaporte).
  5. Cartas de recomendação (opcional -nesta fase)
  6. Indicação do mínimo do nome e dos contatos (número de telemóvel e email) de duas pessoas de referência.

Critérios

Pontuação máxima
