Solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse – SMI Nº 0012/2026

 

A FUNDAÇÃO GETULIO VARGAS, ou simplesmente FGV, torna público que está aberto o prazo para consultores não individuais (pessoas jurídicas) elegíveis interessados na apresentação de MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE, com vistas à consultoria não individual especializada em mapeamento participativo e diagnóstico socioambiental da atividade pesqueira na Floresta Nacional de Tefé. GOVERNMENT OF SOMALILAND

MINISTRY OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT (MoLGUD)

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (REOI)

INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT SELECTION

Country: Somaliland
Project ID: P508408
Project Name: Bulsho Project – Strengthening Community Institutions for Social Cohesion, Inclusion and Resilience
Consulting Service: PIU Bulsho Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Officer
Selection Type: Individual Consultant

Reference: SO-MOLGUD-567776-CS-INDV
Duty Station: Hargeisa, Somaliland, with travel to project regions and districts
Duration: 12 months, renewable subject to satisfactory performance
Application Deadline: September 3, 2026, at 4:00 PM Hargeisa Time

1. BACKGROUND

The Ministry of Local Government and Urban Development (MoLGUD) of the Government of Somaliland is implementing the World Bank-financed Bulsho Project – Strengthening Community Institutions for Social Cohesion, Inclusion and Resilience (P508408).

The main objective of the Bulsho Program is to strengthen community and local institutions for improved social cohesion, inclusion, and resilience. The Program places citizens and communities at the center of government action and seeks to strengthen service delivery, local governance, citizen engagement, and the social contract between communities and government.

To support implementation of the Bulsho Project, the Government of Somaliland, through MoLGUD, intends to recruit a qualified and experienced Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) Officer as part of the Project Implementation Unit (PIU).

2. SCOPE OF THE ASSIGNMENT

The PIU Bulsho MEAL Officer will lead the implementation of the Project’s monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning system, ensuring high-quality data collection, validation, analysis, reporting, evidence generation, accountability, and learning in accordance with the Project Appraisal Document (PAD), Project Operations Manual (POM), Results Framework (RF), Monitoring and Evaluation Plan (MEP), and World Bank requirements.

The MEAL Officer will be responsible for monitoring, evaluation and reporting; Management Information System (MIS) and data management; surveys, research and evidence generation; accountability and citizen feedback; learning and knowledge management; data quality assurance; and capacity building. The Officer will also coordinate closely with other PIU members and relevant service providers, including Third-Party Monitoring, Digital Innovation, and Knowledge Management and Research firms.

The detailed scope of services, responsibilities, deliverables, reporting arrangements, and other requirements are provided in the attached Terms of Reference (TOR).

3. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

The successful candidate shall meet the following minimum qualifications and experience:

  • A Master’s degree from a recognized university in Statistics, Economics, Social Sciences, Development Studies, or a related field.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years of professional experience in Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) for donor-funded projects in fragile or conflict-affected contexts, preferably in Somaliland or the East Africa region.
  • Strong skills and demonstrated experience in quantitative and qualitative data analysis, research, and data visualization.
  • Demonstrated experience with Management Information Systems (MIS), statistical software such as STATA, SPSS or R, and digital data collection tools such as KoboToolbox.
  • Experience in setting up and managing KoboToolbox projects, including form deployment, version control, submission monitoring, and administration of user roles and permissions.
  • Demonstrated experience in Knowledge Management (KM), including developing and curating knowledge products and supporting organizational learning.
  • Proven ability to use M&E and research evidence for adaptive programming, evidence-based decision-making, and continuous improvement of project implementation.
  • Experience working with government institutions, preferably in fragile or conflict-affected settings.
  • Knowledge of World Bank M&E requirements and Results Frameworks is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of results-based management (RBM), Theory of Change, M&E frameworks, indicators, and qualitative and quantitative research methods.
  • Strong analytical, report-writing, communication, presentation, coordination, planning, and capacity-building skills.
  • Knowledge of Somaliland’s socio-political and institutional context and understanding of cross-cutting issues, including gender, inclusion, and conflict sensitivity.
  • High professional integrity and attention to detail.
  • Excellent command of English and Somali, including reading, writing, communication, and presentation skills.

4. REPORTING AND DURATION

The PIU Bulsho MEAL Officer will report to the Bulsho PIU Project Manager.

The assignment will initially be for 12 months and may be renewed subject to satisfactory performance and project requirements. The duty station is Hargeisa, Somaliland, with travel to project regions and districts.

5. SELECTION METHOD

The Ministry of Local Government and Urban Development (MoLGUD), Government of Somaliland, now invites eligible and qualified Individual Consultants to indicate their interest in providing the above-mentioned services.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: Procurement in Investment Project Financing – Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services, July 2016, revised November 2017, August 2018, November 2020 and September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant Selection method set out in the World Bank Procurement Regulations and applicable Government of Somaliland policies.

6. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS

Interested Consultants should submit:

  1. A detailed and updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contact details of three (3) professional referees;
  2. Copies of relevant academic qualification certificates; and
  3. A cover letter outlining the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and suitability for the assignment.

Interested and qualified candidates should submit their applications by email with the subject line:

“Application for PIU Bulsho MEAL Officer – SO-MOLGUD-567776-CS-INDV”

To: bulsho.somaliland@outlook.com
Cc: dg.molgud@sldgov.org

Applications must be received no later than September 3, 2026, at 4:00 PM Hargeisa Time.

Bulsho Project – Strengthening Community Institutions for Social Cohesion, Inclusion and Resilience
Ministry of Local Government and Urban Development (MoLGUD)
Government of Somaliland
Hargeisa, Somaliland

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are attached to this REOI.

PROJET RÉGIONAL PLUS POUR L'AUTONOMISATION DES FEMMES ET LE DIVIDENDE DÉMOGRAPHIQUE EN AFRIQUE SUBSAHARIENNE (SWEDD+)

******

AVIS À MANIFESTATION D’INTÉRÊT

Numéro de référence : BF-WAHO-BF-447082-CS-INDV

TITRE DU POSTE : Chargé de projet pour les composantes 2 et 3 du projet SWEDD+

Introduction

L'Organisation Ouest Africaine de la Santé (OOAS) est l'institution spécialisée de la Communauté Economique des Etats de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (CEDEAO) chargée des questions de santé.

Elle a pour mandat de fournir des soins de santé de haut niveau aux populations de la sous-région. Les maladies transmissibles et non transmissibles sont les principales causes de morbidité et de mortalité dans la région ; par conséquent, le contrôle des maladies et la prévention des épidémies font partie des priorités des 15 pays de la région de la CEDEAO et constituent un principe central des activités de l'OOAS.

La Banque mondiale a accordé des subventions à la CEDEAO pour que l'OOAS mette en œuvre le Projet d’Autonomisation des Femmes et du Dividende Démographique en Afrique Sub-Saharienne-Plus (SWEDD+) P176693.

C'est dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre de ce projet que l'OOAS cherche à recruter un (e) Chargé de Projet pour les composantes 2 et 3 du projet qualifié (e) et expérimenté (e).

Description des services

Le Chargé de Projet des composante 2 et 3 apporte un soutien stratégique, technique et programmatique à la mise en œuvre du projet « Autonomisation des femmes et dividende démographique en Afrique subsaharienne » (SWEDD+) dans le cadre des interventions régionales de l'OOAS dans le domaine de l'autonomisation des jeunes filles et des femmes et du dividende démographique, en veillant à la réalisation des  objectifs des composantes 2 et 3, qui constituent un travail important visant à accroître l'utilisation de services de santé et de nutrition de qualité pour les femmes, les mères, les nouveau-nés, les enfants et les adolescents, ainsi que le recours à des agents de santé qualifiés au niveau communautaire.

Fonctions et responsabilités :

Sous la coordination de la Coordonnatrice du Projet, le Chargé de Projet assistera quotidiennement la Coordonnatrice dans la conduite efficace et efficiente des activités liées aux composantes 2 et 3 du projet SWEDD+ à l'OOAS, en collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion du projet.

Parmi ses tâches, il ou elle sera responsable de :

  • Fournir un soutien technique au projet SWEDD+ à l'OOAS sur les interventions de l'OOAS couvrant les composantes 2 et 3 ;
  • Soutenir la réalisation des objectifs des composantes 2 et 3 attribués à l'OOAS, qui sont les suivants :
  • Soutenir le renforcement des cadres juridiques – l'achèvement du guide régional et de la directive sur la santé et les droits sexuels et reproductifs (SDSR) ;
  • Soutenir l'élaboration de modules spécifiques et adaptés aux adolescents dans les programmes de formation des sage-femmes et des infirmières ;
  • Soutenir la conduite de missions de plaidoyer auprès des gouvernements et des parlements de la CEDEAO, des chefs traditionnels et religieux (CTR) en vue de l'adoption de la directive et du guide sur la santé et les droits sexuels et reproductifs dans la région de la CEDEAO, en tant que partenaires clés pour mener le changement social et comportemental et promouvoir l'égalité des sexes ;
  • Élaborer le plan de travail et le budget annuels (PTAB) du projet ;
  • Élaborer les termes de référence et les mémorandums pour les activités ;
  • Organiser les réunions et les missions sur le terrain ;
  • Préparer la correspondance et les lettres d'invitation à envoyer aux participants pour les différentes activités et réunions ;
  • Préparer les rapports d'activité et d'avancement ;
  • Préparer les réunions de suivi sur la mise en œuvre des activités avec les pays, les partenaires et les agences chargées de la mise en œuvre des projets ;
  • Collecter des informations et des données auprès des unités de coordination de projet (PCU) au niveau national, ainsi qu'auprès des partenaires du projet et des agences de mise en œuvre ;
  • Aider l'unité de suivi et d'évaluation à remplir le cadre de résultats du projet ;
  • Organiser des missions de supervision et de suivi sur le terrain ;
  • Préparer les réunions des comités techniques et du comité directeur régional du projet ;
  • Suivre la mise en œuvre des recommandations de toutes les réunions ;
  • Représenter le coordinateur du SWEDD+ à toute réunion en cas d'absence ou chaque fois que cela est nécessaire, dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre du projet.

Accomplir toutes les autres tâches qui lui sont assignées par la direction de l'OOAS en matière d'intégration de la dimension de genre.

Documents à fournir

L’OOAS invite à présent les Consultants individuels éligibles (“Consultants”) à manifester leurs intérêts à fournir les Services. Les consultants intéressés devront fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils ont les qualifications et expériences pertinentes pour fournir les services.

Les consultants intéressés sont invités à soumettre un dossier de candidature comprenant :

 

  • Une lettre de manifestation d’intérêt adressée au Directeur Général de l’OOAS et portant en objet le titre du poste ;
  • Un Curriculum Vitae récent, daté, signé et faisant ressortir les diplômes, formations, expériences en passation des marchés y compris le nom des projets et des bailleurs, compétences et aptitudes du candidat pour la mission ;
  • Une copie du ou des diplôme (s) ;
  • Une copie des attestations/certificats de service fait ou certificat de travail attestant les expériences professionnelles du candidat telles que mentionnées dans son CV.

Seuls les diplômes et expériences prouvés seront considérés

Qualifications, expériences et compétences

  • Être titulaire d'une maîtrise en santé publique, épidémiologie, ressources humaines dans le domaine de la santé, économie, gestion, politique publique ou administration.
  • Un certificat en gestion de projet serait un atout.
  • Avoir au moins 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle.
  • Une expérience professionnelle dans la gestion de projets financés par la Banque mondiale serait un atout.
  • Excellentes compétences en matière de consolidation d'équipe et de leadership dans un environnement multiculturel.
  • Solides compétences informatiques (principales applications MS Office, y compris les outils de gestion de projet) et capacité à utiliser les technologies de l'information comme outil et ressource.
  • Très organisé et autonome, avec une attitude interpersonnelle positive.
  • Expérience avérée de la collaboration avec un large éventail de partenaires et de groupes de parties prenantes diversifiés.
  • Le candidat doit être originaire d'un des États membres de la CEDEAO.

Maîtrise de l'une des trois langues de travail/langues officielles de la CEDEAO : anglais, français, portugais. La connaissance pratique d'une deuxième langue officielle serait un atout

Méthode et procédure de sélection

Le consultant individuel sera sélectionné sur la base de la méthode de Sélection de Consultant Individuel conformément au Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) », sixième Edition, Février 2025 de la Banque mondiale. 

A l’issue de l’appel à manifestation d’intérêts, une liste restreinte de candidats qualifiés sera constituée. Les candidats ainsi présélectionnés seront invités à un test oral permettant de retenir le meilleur candidat à inviter à la négociation de contrat.

En cas d’égalité de points, le ou la consultant(e) ayant plus d’année expérience professionnelle dans la gestion de projets financés par la Banque mondiale sera privilégié.

Durée, lieu d'affectation et nature du contrat

La durée du contrat est de deux (02) ans, renouvelable pour une période couvrant la durée du projet actif financé par la Banque mondiale avec les fonds disponibles et des évaluations annuelles satisfaisantes de performances.

Il s'agit d'un contrat qui sera financé par les fonds disponibles dans le portefeuille au titre de l’accord de financement signé avec la Banque mondiale pour le projet SWEDD+.

À cette fin, des indicateurs clairs d'évaluation des performances seront définis et annexés au contrat. Toutefois, la décision de poursuivre ou de résilier le contrat doit être soumise à l'approbation de la Banque mondiale.

REPÚBLICA DE MOÇAMBIQUE

MINISTÉRIO DO TRABALHO, GÉNERO E ACÇÃO SOCIAL (MTGAS)

DEPARTAMENTO DE AQUISIÇÕES

(SERVICOS DE CONSULTORIA - SELECÇÃO DE FIRMAS)

 

Título da tarefa: Consultoria para a Realização do Segundo Inquérito de Seguimento no âmbito da Avaliação de Impacto do Programa Acção Social Produtiva (PASP)

 

Data: 03 de Agosto de 2026

Identificação do Projecto: Projecto de Protecção Social e Resiliência Económica (SPERP)

Referencia do Concurso: 37/MTGAS/SPERP/CS/QCBS/2026

 

O Governo de Moçambique (GdM), representado pelo Ministério do Trabalho, Género e Acção Social (MTGAS), recebeu um donativo da Associação Internacional para o Desenvolvimento (IDA) do Banco Mundial (BM) e do Fundo Fiduciário de Multi-Doadores para a Protecção Social (MozSP MDTF), para suportar a implementação do Projecto de Protecção Social e Resiliência Económica (SPERP) e pretende aplicar parte desses fundos para a Realização do Segundo Inquérito de Seguimento de Avaliação de Impacto do Programa de Acção Social Produtiva (PASP).

 

O PASP apoia os agregados familiares economicamente activos mais pobres, oferecendo assistência financeira através da inscrição de membros adultos em obras públicas e actividades geradoras de rendimento. Desde 2012, o programa tem sido implementado em distritos seleccionados, priorizando áreas com elevados índices de pobreza e vulnerabilidade a choques climáticos. O PASP é financiado pelo Governo, com apoio do Banco Mundial através do Projecto de Protecção Social e Resiliência Económica (SPERP) e do Projecto de Investimento no Desenvolvimento de Capital Humano Inclusivo no Norte de Moçambique (HCP), visando respectivamente assistir 218.300 e 20.000 agregados familiares até ao final de 2026.

 

O objectivo da consultoria é de é avaliar em que medida a implementação do PASP contribui para a promoção da inclusão socioeconómica das populações mais vulneráveis com capacidade para o trabalho. Para isso, serão utilizados indicadores quantitativos e qualitativos que meçam as mudanças nos meios de subsistência, segurança alimentar, e capacidade de resiliência dos beneficiários e das comunidades.

 

Os Termos de Referência (TDR) detalhados para a atribuição podem ser solicitados pelo email procurement.sperp@gmail.com .

 

O MTGAS convida empresas de consultoria elegíveis (“Consultores”) nacionais e internacionais, para manifestar seu interesse em fornecer os Serviços. Os consultores interessados devem fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações exigidas e a experiência relevante para executar os Serviços. Os critérios de pré-seleção são: (i) pelo menos cinco (5) anos no negócio com experiência  relevante; (ii) descrição de pelo menos três  (3) ) atribuições  específicas que demonstram a experiência do consultor relevante para a proposta, em contratos de $400.000 ou mais e (iii) experiencias similares comprovadas nas três regiões de Moçambique em pelo menos três (3) inquéritos domiciliários aos agregados familiares em zonas rurais de Moçambique – a empresa deve ter conhecimento das formalidades e costumes locais.

 

A informação deve ser anexada como documento de suporte a Manifestação de Interesse. As qualificações e experiência dos especialistas principais não devem ser incluídas na manifestação de interesse pois não fazem parte dos critérios de pré-seleção. Os especialistas principais não serão avaliados na fase de pré-selecção.

 

Chama-se a atenção dos Consultores interessados para a Seção III, parágrafos 3.14, 3.16 e 3.17 do "Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários do IPF" do Banco Mundial, Julho de 2016, revisto em Fevereiro de 2025, que estabelece a política do Banco Mundial sobre conflito de interesses.

 

Os consultores podem se associar a outras firmas para aprimorar suas qualificações, mas devem indicar claramente se a associação é na forma de consórcio e/ou subconsultoria. No caso de consórcio, todos os sócios serão solidariamente responsáveis pela totalidade do contrato, se selecionados.

 

Os Consultores serão selecionados de acordo com o método estabelecido no Regulamento de Aquisições - Seleção Baseada na Qualidade e Custo (SBQC).

 

Mais informações podem ser obtidas no endereço abaixo durante as horas normais de expediente das (07:30 às 15:30 horas). As manifestações de interesse devem ter o seguinte assunto “MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE N°37/MTGAS/SPERP/CS/QCBS/2026 – Realização do Segundo Inquérito de Seguimento no âmbito da Avaliação de Impacto do Programa Acção Social Produtiva (PASP).

APPEL A CANDIDATURES

RECRUTEMENT D'UN(E) RESPONSABLE DE LA COMPOSANTE 2 DU PROJET RIZ PLUS

Référence : CON-03-26/MG-RIZPLUS/INDV

Date de lancement : 19 août 2026

1. Le Gouvernement de la République de Madagascar a reçu un financement de la Banque Mondiale pour financer le Projet de productivité et de résilience des moyens de subsistance ruraux (RIZ PLUS), et à l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce crédit pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat de consultant individuel objet du présent appel à candidatures.

Ce contrat sera financé conjointement par l’Agence Française de Développement (AFD). La passation du Marché sera conforme aux règles de passation des marchés de la Banque mondiale.

2. Sous l'autorité du Coordonnateur National, le/la consultant(e) sera chargé(e) d'assurer le pilotage stratégique, la coordination et la supervision technique de la Composante 2 du Projet RIZ PLUS relative à l’intensification et à la gestion durable des infrastructures et des services d’irrigation. Il/Elle veillera notamment à la planification des activités d’irrigation et de micro-irrigation, à la coordination et à la supervision des Spécialistes Régionaux, à la qualité des études et travaux, à la préparation des dossiers de passation de marchés, à la structuration et à la pérennisation des AUE/FAUE, du FRERHA et des structures de GEPP, ainsi qu’au respect des exigences environnementales et sociales.

Le poste est basé à Antananarivo avec des déplacements fréquents dans les régions d'Alaotra Mangoro et de Sofia. Le contrat est prévu jusqu'au 29 décembre 2028, sous réserve d'évaluations satisfaisantes des performances du/de la consultant(e).

3. Les Termes de Référence détaillés peuvent être obtenus auprès de l'Unité de Gestion du Projet RIZ PLUS ou demandés à l'adresse électronique indiquée ci-dessous. Les candidats devront clairement préciser leurs coordonnées dans leur demande.

4. L’Unité de Gestion du Projet RIZ PLUS invite les candidat(e)s à manifester leur intérêt pour fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Un Consultant sera sélectionné conformément à la méthode de Sélection de Consultants Individuels prévue dans le « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d'Investissement (FPI) de la Banque mondiale », 7 édition – septembre 2025. Les candidats les mieux classés à l'issue de l'évaluation des dossiers seront invités à un entretien.

5. Le/la consultant(e) recherché(e) devra répondre aux qualifications minimales suivantes :

  • Être titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur ou d'un Master II (Bac+5 minimum) en Hydraulique, Génie Rural ou Génie Civil ;
  • Avoir au moins dix (10) ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de l'hydraulique, du Génie Rural ou du Génie Civil ;
  • Avoir au moins sept (7) années d'expérience dans un poste lié à l’irrigation des périmètres de superficie de plus de 2 000 ha dans des projets de développement financés par des bailleurs de fonds internationaux ;
  • Avoir au moins cinq (5) expériences réussies dans la réalisation et la supervision d’études d’irrigation (APS/APD/DAO) et de contrôle de travaux au cours des dix dernières années ;
  • Avoir au moins trois (3) expériences en matière d'encadrement d'équipes techniques pluridisciplinaires et/ou de coordination multisites ;
  • Avoir au moins deux (2) expériences d'appui à la structuration des AUE/FAUE ou de mécanismes de financement de l'entretien des infrastructures hydro-agricoles ;
  • Maîtriser la conception, le dimensionnement et la supervision des aménagements hydro-agricoles et systèmes de micro-irrigation ;
  • Maîtriser l'informatique bureautique, internet, messagerie, les logiciels DAO (AutoCAD), les logiciels SIG (QGIS) et les applications de réunion à distance ;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance de la nouvelle organisation du MiASA et de ses entités ;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance des procédures de la Banque mondiale, notamment en matière de passation de marchés et de gestion des risques environnementaux et sociaux, et/ou d'autres bailleurs de fonds internationaux ;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance de la SNDR III et des politiques sectorielles agricoles malagasy ;
  • Avoir une bonne connaissance des textes réglementaires régissant les infrastructures hydro-agricoles à Madagascar, notamment le NIHYCRI, le Code de l'Eau et la Loi n°2014-042 du 9 janvier 2015 ;
  • Maîtriser le français ; la maîtrise du malagasy est indispensable et la connaissance de l'anglais est souhaitée.

Seront considérés comme des atouts :

  • Une connaissance des régions d'intervention d'Alaotra Mangoro et de Sofia ;
  • Une aptitude à réaliser des levés topographiques avec station totale ;
  • Une maîtrise de logiciels spécifiques SIG et DAO tels que QGIS et Covadis, Revit ou équivalents ;
  • Une expérience en irrigation climato-résiliente et en gestion intégrée des ressources en eau (GIRE).

6. Les candidat(e)s intéressé(e)s sont invités à déposer leurs dossiers de candidature, par courrier électronique ou sous pli fermé, comprenant une lettre de motivation, un CV détaillé avec références professionnelles, les copies certifiées conformes des diplômes ainsi que les attestations de travail.

Les dossiers de candidatures doivent parvenir au plus tard le 02 Septembre 2026 à minuit pour les candidatures transmises par courrier électronique et entre 08h30 à 16h30 pour les candidatures déposées physiquement ou envoyés par courrier à l’adresse suivante :

SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE PARA CONTRATAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA ESPECIALIZADA PARA A PRESTAÇÃO DE SERVIÇOS TÉCNICOS DE PLANEJAMENTO, ORGANIZAÇÃO E EXECUÇÃO DE UM PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO IN COMPANY EM COMPRAS PÚBLICAS, DESTINADO A SERVIDORES E COLABORADORES NO ÂMBITO DO PODER EXECUTIVO DO ESTADO O TOCANTINS, CONFORME ACORDO DE EMPRÉSTIMO Nº 9584-BR

 

MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE (MI) Nº 03/2026/SEFAZ/BIRD/PRÓ-GESTÃO TOCANTINS

 

O ESTADO DO TOCANTINS contratou um empréstimo do Banco Internacional para Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (BIRD) para a implementação do PRÓ-GESTÃO TOCANTINS: SUSTENTABILIDADE FISCAL, EFICIÊNCIA E EFICÁCIA DO GASTO PÚBLICO e pretende utilizar parte dos recursos desse empréstimo em pagamentos admissíveis para Serviços de Consultoria.

 

Os serviços desta solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse visam contratar empresa de consultoria especializada para a prestação de serviços técnicos de planejamento, organização e execução de um Programa de Capacitação In Company em Compras Públicas, destinado a servidores e colaboradores no âmbito do Poder Executivo do Estado do Tocantins.

 

A Secretaria do Planejamento e Orçamento (SEPLAN) convida empresas de consultoria elegíveis à apresentação de expressão de manifestação de interesse com vistas a executar os referidos serviços de consultoria. As empresas interessadas manifestam seu interesse em participar da futura licitação, apresentando o seu portfólio, com qualificação e experiência da empresa, onde serão avaliadas conforme os critérios. Lembrando que na etapa de manifestação de interesse não serão analisados os dados de cada especialista, só experiências da empresa. Os critérios para selecionar a lista curta são:

A empresa deverá comprovar capacidade técnica para a execução de programas de capacitação de porte equivalente, por meio da apresentação de manifestação de interesse, comprovando a execução de, no mínimo, 1 (um) contrato de capacitação ou treinamento com as seguintes características: Público mínimo, Carga horária total, Abrangência de múltiplos órgãos ou entidades, nos últimos 5 (cinco) anos.

Admite-se a constituição de consórcios e associações para efeito de reforçar as qualificações a serem informadas.

As manifestações de interesse de consultoras interessados são exigidas nos termos dos procedimentos estabelecidos pelo “Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento do Banco Mundial que emite normas para as aquisições em operações de financiamento de projetos de investimento Bens, Obras, Serviços Técnicos e Serviços de Consultoria - Quinta Edição Setembro de 2023”. O método utilizado será Seleção Baseada na Qualidade e no Custo (SBQC), previsto nos termos do item 7.3 da Seção VII. Métodos de seleção aprovados: Serviços de consultoria, do Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento do Banco Mundial.  De acordo com o Regulamento: "A lista curta de empresas pré-selecionadas será composto de 5 (cinco) a 8 (oito) empresas que apresentem as melhores qualificações e experiências, portanto, somente estas empresas da Lista Curta receberão a Solicitação de Proposta (SDP), sendo convidadas a apresentar suas propostas”.

SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÕES DE INTERESSE

Serviços de Consultoria – Consultor Individual

VAGA: GESTOR PROVINCIAL DO MOXICO

REF: 99CS4/MINPLAN/26

O Governo de Angola solicitou um crédito ao Banco Internacional de Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (IBRD) do Grupo Banco Mundial para o financiamento do Projecto de Aceleração da Diversificação Económica e Criação de Emprego (DIVERSIFICA MAIS) e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos do financiamento para a contratação dos serviços de um consultor individual para a posição de Gestor Provincial do Moxico.

O gestor provincial prestará apoio directo ao Director e Coordenador do projecto em todas actividades necessárias para estruturar, operacionalizar e administrar o projecto a nível provincial.

Os Termos de Referência (TOR) detalhados para a atribuição podem ser obtidos no endereço abaixo.

O Projecto de Aceleração da Diversificação Económica e Criação de Emprego (DIVERSIFICA MAIS) do Ministério do Planeamento convida os consultores individuais elegíveis para manifestarem o seu interesse em fornecer os Serviços. Os Consultores interessados deverão fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações exigidas e experiência relevante para executar os Serviços. Os critérios de selecção, bem como a ponderação para cada um, são:

  • Licenciatura em economia, gestão, administração/gestão de negócios, comércio, marketing ou em engenharia, ciências sociais e ambiente; O grau de mestre é considerado uma vantagem;
  • 7 anos de experiência comprovada na sua área de trabalho e profundo conhecimento das realidades da província;
  • Experiência relacionada com o comércio internacional, alfândegas, organização internacional ou regional, Gestão e acompanhamento de obras, financiamento e apoio ao sector privado em Angola é considerado uma vantagem;
  • Experiência e capacidade comprovada de compreender, analisar e avaliar o funcionamento de empresas individuais, privadas ou públicas;
  • Experiência em gestão, administração e planeamento no sector público ou no sector privado;
  • Conhecimentos de informática completa, incluindo o uso do Word e Excel;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação interpessoal e de desenvolvimento de contactos na indústria (networks);
  • Grande capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e em ambientes multiculturais;
  • Fluência na língua portuguesa e competência na comunicação oral.
  • Disponibilidade imediata

A duração dos serviços será por um período de doze (12) meses, em regime de tempo integral, podendo ser prorrogado como resultado de um desempenho satisfatório.

A atenção dos consultores interessados deve recair sobre a Seção III, parágrafos, 3.14, 3.16 e 3.17 do “Regulamento de Aquisições dos Mutuários do IPF” do Banco Mundial de Setembro de 2025 (“Regulamentos de Aquisições”), estabelecendo a política do Banco Mundial sobre conflito de interesses.

Um Consultor será seleccionado de acordo com o método de selecção ICS (Consultor Individual) estabelecido nos Regulamentos de Aquisições do Banco Mundial.

Mais informações podem ser obtidas, apenas por e-mail, no endereço abaixo, durante o horário das 8h00 às 16h00, de segunda a sexta-feira, horário de Angola.

As manifestações de interesse deverão ser entregues, apenas por e-mail, no endereço abaixo indicado até ao dia 11 de Setembro de 2026, acompanhada da seguinte documentação:

  • Curriculum Vitae, com indicação de pelo menos três referencias;
  • Fotocópia do Bilhete de Identidade ou Passaporte;
  • Fotocópia do(s) documentos académicos;
  • Carta de Recomendação / Avaliação de Desempenho.

As manifestações de Interesse a serem recebidas, serão avaliadas em duas fases:

  1. Avaliação curricular (Obrigatório);
  2. Entrevista (somente para quem passar na avaliação curricular)

World Bank Loaned Emerging Infectious Diseases Prevention, Preparedness and Response Project – Hainan Province Project (Global “One Health” Hainan Demonstration Project)

Procurement of Equipment for Enhancing Infectious Disease Surveillance and Testing Capacity
Package No. 10
(Contract No.: HN-G-68)Invitation for Bids

Date: June 25, 2026

Bid Reference No.: 0733-26092916/10

1The Government of the People’s Republic of China has received a loan from the World Bank towards the cost of the China: Emerging Infectious Diseases Prevention, Preparedness and Response Project – Hainan Province Project (Global “One Health” Hainan Demonstration Project), and intends to apply part of the proceeds of this loan to eligible payments under the contract for the Procurement of Equipment for Enhancing Infectious Disease Surveillance and Testing Capacity, Package No. 10 (Contract No.: HN-G-68).

2CITIC International Tendering Co., Ltd. (the Procurement Agent), on behalf of Hainan Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention (the Purchaser), now invites eligible and qualified bidders to submit sealed bids for the following goods and related services:

Contract No.

HN-G-68

Contract Title

Procurement of Equipment for Enhancing Infectious Disease Surveillance and Testing Capacity, Package No. 10

Main Types and Quantities of Goods

Fully Automatic Ultra-Low Temperature Storage System, Molecular Interaction Analyzer, Nucleic Acid Mass Spectrometer, and other equipment, as well as related services. For details, please refer to the Schedule of Requirements in Section VI of the Bidding Document.

Delivery Period

90 calendar days from the date of contract signing.

3The procurement under this bidding process will be conducted through the Request for Bids (RFB) method under National Competitive Procurement as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (“Procurement Regulations”). All eligible bidders meeting the requirements stipulated in the Procurement Regulations are invited to submit bids.

4Interested eligible bidders may obtain further information from the address specified in this Invitation for Bids and may inspect or purchase the bidding documents from June 25, 2026 to the bid submission deadline of August 4, 2026, during the hours of 9:00–11:30 a.m. and 13:30–17:00 p.m. (Beijing Time) on each working day (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and statutory holidays).

5Prospective bidders should note the provisions regarding eligibility and conflict of interest specified in Clause 4 of the Instructions to Bidders of the bidding document. Any bidder with a conflict of interest shall be considered ineligible.

6The qualification requirements for bidders include:

Business Scale

The bidder’s average annual turnover for the most recent three years (2023–2025) shall be no less than RMB 28 million.

Contract Experience

The bidder, within the past three years (from January 1, 2023 to the present), shall have successfully completed at least one contract, as a supplier, for the supply of laboratory instruments or equipment that are similar in nature and complexity to the products to be procured under this project, with the value of such contract being no less than RMB 9.2 million.

The bidder shall provide supporting documents that meet the requirements, which shall at least include: the contract agreement, acceptance certificate issued by the user, payment receipt documents for the supply contract, etc. Copies of contracts submitted as part of the bid documents shall, at a minimum, include the contract pages showing the following information: the project name, procurement content, contract signing date, contract amount, and contract signature and seal page. The bidder shall also provide the name and contact details of the end-user contact person.

Technical Experience

The offered Molecular Interaction Analyzer shall have at least one year of manufacturing experience, and at least one unit/set of the Molecular Interaction Analyzer shall have been sold and completed its warranty period. The bidder shall provide supporting documents demonstrating compliance with these requirements, including copies of key pages of sales contracts for similar goods and other relevant documents.

Production Capacity

Not Applicable.

Financial Position

The bidder’s financial position, as reflected in the audited annual financial statements (including the balance sheet and income statement) for the most recent three years (2023, 2024, and 2025), shall demonstrate sustained profitability. The minimum requirement is that the bidder’s net assets (calculated as total assets minus total liabilities) for each of the past three years shall be positive.

Cash Flow Capacity

The bidder shall have sufficient access to liquid assets [1. Liquid assets include cash and cash equivalents, short-term financial instruments, short-term available-for-sale securities, marketable securities, accounts receivable, short-term financing receivables, and other assets that can be converted into cash within one year], credit facilities, and other financing sources to meet the cash flow requirements necessary for contract performance. The bidder’s other ongoing contracts shall also be taken into consideration. The minimum requirement is: no less than RMB 5.5 million.

Litigation History

The total amount of any pending claims, arbitration, or other litigation shall not exceed 50% of the bidder’s net assets.

Joint bidding is permitted under this procurement. The maximum number of members in a joint venture shall be: 2. Either the lead member of the joint venture or the other joint venture member must meet the above qualification requirements.
Further detailed information is provided in the bidding documents.

7. Interested eligible bidders may submit an application to purchase the bidding documents at the address specified in this Invitation for Bids and shall pay a non-refundable fee of RMB 1,000. The payment shall be made either in cash or by direct remittance to the account of the Procurement Agent (Account Name: CITIC International Tendering Co., Ltd.; Bank Name: China CITIC Bank Beijing Sanyuanqiao Branch; Account No.: 8110701013102383606). The bidding documents will be delivered by mail. The Purchaser and the Procurement Agent shall not be responsible for any loss or delay of documents during the mailing process.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

 

 SAINT LUCIA

 

Assignment Title: Consultancy Services for the Preparation of the Castries Urban Stormwater Management Plan

 

Reference No.: SLU-SURFIN-STMWTR-QCBS-26

 

The Saint Lucia Urban Resilient Flood Investment Project (SURF-IN) is financing flood mitigation investments in Castries and Anse La Raye. The Pre-Feasibility Study undertaken by HR Wallingford has revealed a critical data gap: the absence of stormwater drainage maps and detailed operation and maintenance plans for Castries. Responsibilities for drainage infrastructure remain unclear between the Castries City Council (CCC) and the Ministry of Infrastructure, Ports Services, Energy (MIPSE). Preliminary hazard modelling has demonstrated correlations between poor maintenance regimes and flood risk, underscoring the need for improved drain de-siltation and solid waste removal.

 

The establishment of an Urban Stormwater Management Plan will improve maintenance procedures, strengthen inter-agency coordination, enhance budgetary processes, and guide investment prioritization.  Castries has separate storm water and sanitary waste drainage systems. The proposed Plan must take adequate account of future climate scenarios as well as current conditions to ensure investments perform effectively throughout their design life. The Task and Deliverables proposed for this assignment pertain only to the storm water management system. 

 

The consulting firm will work under the direction of the Ministry of Economic Development and Youth Economy to:

  • Develop a comprehensive GIS-based drainage asset inventory and management database for the Castries urban area
  • Establish clear delineation of maintenance responsibilities between CCC and the MIPSE
  • Assess current drainage network condition and identify accumulated deferred maintenance requirements
  • Develop an optimized maintenance management plan with realistic resource requirements
  • Recommend structural improvements and equipment needs to enhance maintenance efficiency

 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below and also attached with the REOI.

 

The Ministry of Economic Development and Youth Economy now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services.

 

 

 

 

The shortlisting criteria are:

 

  1. At least five (5) years’ experience in providing consulting services in urban stormwater drainage management, flood risk management, drainage infrastructure assessment, or infrastructure planning.
  2. Demonstrated experience in at least two (2) similar assignments involving GIS-based drainage or utility asset inventory, network mapping, spatial database development, and preparation of GIS deliverables.
  3. Demonstrated experience in at least two (2) assignments involving inspection and condition assessment of open and closed drainage systems, including identification of blockages, sediment/debris accumulation, flow restrictions, and damaged drainage assets.
  4. Demonstrated experience in at least two (2) assignments involving preparation of drainage maintenance management plans, including maintenance districts, inspection schedules, resource/equipment requirements, deferred maintenance assessment, and O&M budgeting.
  5. Demonstrated experience in at least one (1) assignment involving climate-resilient drainage planning, coastal/tidal drainage influences, groundwater monitoring, or groundwater-surface water interaction.
  6. Demonstrated experience in stakeholder consultation and institutional coordination for public infrastructure assignments, including coordination between government agencies, communities, or affected property owners.

 

Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. In the assessment of submissions, consideration will be given to technical competence, qualifications and experience including local and regional. Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.15, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Sixth  Edition, March 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. In addition, please refer to the following specific information on conflict of interest related to this assignment: Consultants shall not be hired for any assignment that would be in conflict with their prior or current obligations to other clients, or that may place them in a position of being unable to carry out the assignment in the best interests of the Borrower (paragraph 3.17 of the Procurement Regulations).

 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

 

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. (0800 to 1630 hours, local time). REQUEST FOR EXPERESSION OF INTEREST FOR CEPCU Social Development SPECIALIST

1. Background

The Government of Somaliland has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Enhancing Public Resource Management Project (SERP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services (individual consultant). to develop a lean, portfolio-focused coordination and performance management function that strengthens oversight, reduces implementation fragmentation, and promotes institutional learning across the World Bank-financed portfolio. Therefore, the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development (MoFED) intends to hire an International Social Development Specialist. The Social Development Specialist will fill this gap through portfolio-level advisory support, monitoring, and knowledge transfer.

2. Objective(s) of the Assignment

The Social Development Specialist will provide portfolio-level advisory support on social risk management, stakeholder engagement, grievance redress, inclusion, GBV, SEA/SH risk monitoring, and social risk management systems strengthening. The role is intended to strengthen portfolio oversight and institutional capacity and shall not substitute the implementation responsibilities of PIUs and other implementing entities.

3. Scope of Work and Key Responsibilities

  • Support activities designed to manage social risks as elaborated in the ESCP, ESMF, LMP, SEP, , and all other social risk management action plans.
  • Support and advise the PIUs on how to undertake continuous and effective stakeholder and community engagements and consultations, including implementation of the Stakeholder Engagement Plan.
  • Facilitate the immediate reporting of any severe safeguard incidents per the Project Operations Manual and Environmental and Social Incidents Reporting Toolkit protocols, including input to Root Cause Analysis and support to corrective action plan implementation.
  • Develop training materials and conduct capacity development to build staff capacities for effective social risk management at the CEPCU and PIUs/implementing entities. /
  • Develop social risks management tracking system across the portfolio, Compile regular monitoring and reporting on integrated feedback and grievance management and overall project performance on social risk management, including GBV, Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (SEA/SH), as input to regular project progress narrative reports and presentations as outlined in the ESCP.
  • Ensure PIU social specialists have a structured way of monitoring and project supervision including implementation of key mission action plans; workshops, consultations, and meetings and where necessary, participate in joint implementation and supervision missions, project-related workshops, consultations, and meetings as required by the World Bank, including travel to project sites throughout Somaliland.
  • Together with the CEPFU Procurement Specialist, support PIUs/implementing entities on how to integrate E&S risk management provisions into procurement activities, ensuring mitigation measures are factored into procurement planning and adequately resourced.
  • Consolidate lessons learned from portfolio implementation and project completion to inform future operations.

4. Selection Criteria

 The selection shall be based on qualification, experience and skills of the candidate and followed by an interview. The qualifications, experience, and skills should be included:

5. Consultant’s Qualifications and Experience

A. Education:

  • An advanced degree in Law, Social Science, Political Science, Human Rights, Development Studies, Gender Studies, or another relevant discipline
  • At least eight (8) years of experience in the social development field, with a focus on stakeholder and community engagement, inclusion, gender and GBV, complaints and grievance management, vulnerable and minority groups, disability, displaced populations, and refugee/returnee influx.
  • Familiarity with the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF).
  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Good experience managing grievance and complaints systems within a public or private sector programme.
  • Confidence and experience managing inputs to information technology databases.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and commitment to working in teams.
  • Demonstrated capacity to provide on-the-job training on social standards/safeguards and achieve successful knowledge transfer.

B. Desirable

  • Broad understanding of Somaliland's policies, laws, and regulations on social issues.
  • Experience working on humanitarian programmes.
  • Master's degree in a relevant subject.

C. Reporting and other Deliverables: The Social Development Specialist will report to the Head of CEPCU and work under the overall guidance of the Director General, MoFED

D. Duration of Assignment: The assignment is expected to take 12 months.

The Ministry of Finance and Economic Development with the Center of Excellence for Portfolio Coordination Unit (CEPCU) invites potential candidates for Social Development Specialist as per the Terms of Reference. CONSULTANT’S QUALIFICATIONS BASED SELECTION (CQS)

Name of Project

“Innovative Social Protection System for Inclusion of Vulnerable People” (INSON)

Loan No./Credit No./Grant No.

IDA Credit No. 7555-UZ / Grant No. TF C4589-UZ

Assignment Title

Production of Targeted Social Awareness and Informational Videos on Protection Mechanisms Against Harassment and Violence

Procurement Plan Ref Number

UZ-INSON-CQS-3.1.4.1.

Country of Delivery

Republic of Uzbekistan

 

The Republic of Uzbekistan has received financing from the World Bank for the implementation of the INSON Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward consulting services.

The consulting services (“Services”) include the development and production of five targeted social awareness and informational video materials aimed at increasing public awareness of protection mechanisms against harassment and violence, promoting a zero-tolerance approach to violence, and informing the population and professionals about available protection mechanisms, response procedures, and social support services.

The scope of services includes the development of concepts and scenarios, preparation of scripts and storyboards, organization and implementation of video production and filming, provision of a full range of post-production services, including editing, sound design, graphics, and subtitling, as well as preparation and delivery of final video materials and related dissemination products.

The assignment is expected to be implemented over a maximum period of five (5) months.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following link:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NaO-PlvLz5eWVTWXS8EIvkNjBlSm_R-5PeRWgrwEYWA/edit?usp=sharing

The National Agency for Social Protection (NASP) under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The EOI should include the firm’s profile, description of relevant assignments, clients, implementation periods, the firm’s role, and links to the relevant video portfolio.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (September 2023) (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The best qualified firm will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualifications Based Selection (CQS) method set out in the Regulations and based on the following criteria:

Interested firms should meet the following qualification requirements:

  • At least five (5) years of professional experience in video production, social media content creation, or audiovisual communications;
  • Proven experience in producing short films, social campaigns, or awareness-raising video materials for government institutions, international organizations, or development projects;
  • Demonstrated capacity to provide the full cycle of audiovisual production, including concept development, scriptwriting, filming, editing, sound design, and post-production;
  • Experience in developing socially significant content on sensitive topics such as violence prevention, social protection, healthcare, human rights, or gender equality will be considered an advantage;
  • Availability of professional technical equipment and production resources necessary to ensure high-quality filming and post-production;
  • Experience working with government institutions, non-governmental organizations, and international organizations will be considered an asset;
  • Demonstrated experience in social and behavior change communication (SBCC) or public awareness campaigns on sensitive social issues, particularly those involving vulnerable populations, is an asset.
  • Submission of a portfolio demonstrating relevant experience and the quality of services provided.

Further information can be obtained through piuinsonprocurement@gmail.com during office hours 09:00 to 17:00 hours Tashkent time.

Expressions of interest, demonstrating relevant qualifications and experience must be delivered electronically to the email address piuinsonprocurement@gmail.com by August 7, 2026.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTANT FIRM)

 

National Recovery Program Bureau (NRPB)

 

Consultancy (Firm) to Review and Enhance Legislative Framework regarding On-Site Sanitation and Develop Fecal Sludge Management Standards

being implemented as part of the Sint Maarten Wastewater Management Project (SWMP)

 

The Sint Maarten Wastewater Management Project

Assignment Title: Consultancy (Firm) to Review and Enhance Legislative Framework regarding On-Site Sanitation and Develop Fecal Sludge Management Standards undertaken as a part of the Sint Maarten Wastewater Management Project

Credit/Loan no.: TF-C5700

Reference no.: SX-NRPB-563528-CS-QCBS EOI

 

Deadline: 17:00 p.m. Atlantic Standard Time, Friday, August 28, 2026

1. The Government of Sint Maarten (GoSXM) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Sint Maarten Wastewater Management Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services under this request for expression of interest.

2. The Government of Sint Maarten (GoSXM), represented by the National Recovery Program Bureau (NRPB) is looking to select an experienced (international or national) firm for a consultancy service for the Review and to Enhance Legislative Framework regarding On-Site Sanitation and Develop Fecal Sludge Management Standards in Sint Maarten. The overall objective of this consultancy is to provide specialized technical expertise to develop two foundational, interlinked instruments for sustainable sanitation and wastewater management in Sint Maarten: a National Sanitation Strategy (NSS) including phased implementation plans for its expansion and for the overall wastewater management system, and a regulatory and operational framework for improved management of fecal sludge from septic tanks, including locally appropriate standards, licensing mechanisms, monitoring protocols, and proposed amendments to existing legislation where required to enable their implementation.

3. The consulting firm shall be responsible for delivering the outputs described below. It is imperative for the consulting firm to undertake a comprehensive review and provide actionable recommendations and documents detailed in the outputs below. The outputs expected from the assignment are:

· Technical note situational analysis - Comprehensive assessment of existing legislative and institutional framework, sanitation coverage, environmental and health conditions, and FSM practices. Include socio-economic and demographic assessment influencing sanitation service demand and affordability

· Draft National Sanitation Strategy & Implementation Plan - Complete draft of the NSS and its phased implementation plan, including proposed institutional roles, financing options, and considerations of harmonizing with other strategies and plans

· Draft FSM regulatory package - A consolidated package containing: Draft tariff methodology, phased tariff implementation plan; Draft standards for containment, collection, and transport; Draft licensing and monitoring framework for service providers, including proposed fee/sanction structures; A proposal for a sustainable FSM long term financing model

· Stakeholder consultation - Facilitate at least one validation workshop to present and receive feedback on the draft strategy and regulatory package from all relevant stakeholders (VROMI, private sector, civil society); Provide a summary of workshop outcomes and how feedback was

addressed

· Final National Sanitation Strategy and implementation plan - Final versions of the strategy and plan, incorporating feedback from stakeholders and the client

· Final FSM regulatory package and recommendations - Finalized standards and licensing framework, incorporating all feedback; Proposed amendments to existing legislation and regulations; Draft legal provisions where required; Draft a roadmap for legal adoption and implementation, and the financial framework.

4. The detailed scope and deliverables of the assignment are available in the Terms of Reference (TOR).

5. The National Recovery Program Bureau (NRPB) now invites eligible firms (“Consultant”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultant should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and experience to perform the Services demonstrated by:

· At least 5 years of experience in providing similar sanitation policy and regulatory advisory services.

· Experience in Sanitation policy, strategy development, institutional reform, stakeholder engagement, financing models.

· Experience in Regulatory framework design, standards development, licensing schemes, enforcement mechanisms, legal drafting.

· Experience in Fecal sludge management (technical standards), environmental and health assessment, water quality, treatment technologies.

These would form the shortlisting criteria.

6. The selection process will be undertaken in line with the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Fourth Edition November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”) for open competitive selection. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

7. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (November 2020) (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

8. All submissions should be uploaded to the NRPB’s procurement portal which can be found at https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com Consultancy (Firm) to Review and Enhance Legislative Framework regarding On-Site Sanitation and Develop Fecal Sludge Management Standards no later than Deadline: 17:00 p.m. Atlantic Standard Time, Friday, August 28, 2026.

9. All queries from interested bidders must be submitted electronically to https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com through the Vendor Discussions section under the respective Project (procurement) https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com/portal/?tab=pastOpportunities Interested bidders should register in the NRPB's procurement portal at https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com/login/. Detailed instructions for registration are available at https://nrpbsxm.org/procurement/ (NRPB EUNA SOLUTIONS REGISTRATION PAGE).

Recrutement d’un Consultant (Firme) pour l’audit des comptes du Programme d’Accès aux Services d’Eau et d’Assainissement (PASEA) pour les exercices 2026, 2027 et 2028

AVIS D’APPEL PUBLIC A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET

N° 137/ ZR-CEP-O-558664-CS-QCBS/PASEA/2026

Le Gouvernement de la République du Démocratique du Congo a sollicité un crédit de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA) d’un montant équivalent à US$ 400 000 000 en vue de financer le coût du Programme d’Accès aux Services d’Eau et d’Assainissement en RDC (PASEA) et se propose d’utiliser une partie des fonds de ce crédit pour financer les services suivants :  Audit des comptes du Programme d’Accès aux Services d’Eau et d’Assainissement (PASEA) pour les exercices 2026, 2027 et 2028

 

Le présent avis d’appel public à manifestation d’intérêt fait suite à l’Avis général de Passations des Marchés publié sur UNDB le 30 novembre 2022.

 

L’objectif de l’audit financier et comptable est de permettre d’exprimer une opinion professionnelle et indépendante sur les états financiers et les relevés des dépenses à la fin de la période considérée et de s’assurer que les ressources mises à la disposition du Projet sont utilisées aux fins pour lesquelles elles ont été octroyées en vue de l’atteinte des objectifs de développement du Projet.

 

L’audit financier et comptable doit s’assurer que les états financiers, établis par l’Equipe de Coordination du Projet (ECP) sont élaborés de manière à rendre compte des transactions financières dudit projet et qu’un système de contrôle interne adéquat mis en place et en œuvre est efficace ainsi qu’un archivage approprié et acceptable des transactions.

 

De manière spécifique, la mission du consultant est de :

  • Vérifier que les ressources financières mises à la disposition du projet ont été utilisées conformément aux dispositions de l’accord de financement et exclusivement aux fins prévues dans le respect des principes d’efficience et d’efficacité ;
  • Vérifier la conformité des acquisitions de biens, travaux et services du projet avec les dispositions des accords de financement, les procédures de passation des marchés applicables ainsi que les plans de passation des marchés approuvés ;
  • Examiner la conformité du processus de passation des marchés, apprécier le respect des procédures, l’utilisation des documents et outils de gestion prévus dans le cadre du financement du projet ;
  • Vérifier la fiabilité du système comptable et financier du projet ainsi que la régularité et la tenue des comptes et pièces justificatives ;
  • Apprécier la cohérence entre les ressources mobilisées, les dépenses engagées et le niveau d’exécution des activités du projet, sur base des informations financières et opérationnelles disponibles.
  • Effectuer des vérifications physiques, des visites de terrain afin de confirmer l’existence, la réalité et la conformité des biens, travaux et services financés par le projet ;

 

Les Termes de Reference (TDR) sont joints à cette demande de manifestation d'intérêt de la mission ou peuvent être trouvés sur le site web suivant : https://www.cepordc.com/.

La Cellule d’Exécution des Projets-Eau (CEP-O) invite les candidats intéressés à présenter leur candidature en vue de fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Le Consultant doit être un Cabinet d’Audit et d’Expertise Comptable faisant profession habituelle de réviser les comptes, régulièrement inscrit au Tableau d’un Ordre des Experts comptables reconnu au plan international par l’IFAC ou la FIDEF, et jugé acceptable par l’IDA. Les critères de qualification sont les suivants :

 

#

Les dossiers de manifestation d’intérêt doivent être concis et comprendre au maximum 30 pages, police calibri ou similaire, taille 11. 

 

Il est porté à l’attention des Consultants que les dispositions de la Section III, paragraphes 3.14, 3.16 et 3.17 du « Règlement de passation des marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projet d’Investissement (FPI) (juillet 2016, révisée en Novembre 2017, Aout 2018, Novembre 2020, Septembre 2023, février 2025 et septembre 2025) « Règlements de Passation des marchés »), relatives aux règles de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts sont applicables.

 

Un consultant sera sélectionné selon la méthode de Sélection Fondée sur la Qualité et le Coût (SFQC). Les critères d’éligibilité, l’établissement de la liste restreinte et la procédure de sélection seront conformes aux « Règlements de passation des marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projet d’Investissement (FPI) ((juillet 2016, révisée en Novembre 2017, Aout 2018, Novembre 2020, Septembre 2023, février 2025 et septembre 2025) « Règlements de Passation des marchés » et les « Lignes Directrices »  de la Banque mondiale sur la Prévention et la Lutte contre la Fraude et la Corruption dans les projets financés sur les Prêts de la BIRD, et les crédits et les subventions de l’IDA (datant du 1er juillet 2016), ainsi que les dispositions stipulées dans l’Accord de financement applicables au projet.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(LEARN-IC-NIO-7.4.1 – Project Manager 1)

UKRAINE

Lifting Education Access and Resilience in Times of Need in Ukraine Program

Grant No. TF0C5794

Assignment Title: Project Manager 1

Reference No. LEARN-IC-NIO-7.4.1

Ukraine and World bank have signed the agreements for the Program “Lifting Education Access and Resilience in times of Need in Ukraine Program” (hereinafter referred to as the LEARN or Operation). 

LEARN was developed to address critical challenges and provide essential support to the education sector, aligning with the Ministry of Education and Science’s (MoES) Strategic Action Plan. The objectives of the Operation are to (i) improve teaching and learning conditions; and (ii) strengthen management capacity of the education system.

The objective of the Consultant's assignment is to ensure effective project management and coordination within the Cross-sectoral Project Management Unit of the NUS Implementation Office to achieve reform objectives.

The Consultant will be contracted through competitive selection in line with the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”). 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the Procurement Regulations, setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

MOES now invites qualified interested persons to submit their expression of interest in Ukrainian and English as provided in the Terms of reference.  

The detailed Terms of Reference and submission modalities for the assignment are attached to this Request for Expression of Interest.

The deadline for submission of applications is 14:00 am Kyiv time August 25, 2026.  

TERMS OF REFERENCE

 

for Consulting Services (Individual Consultant)

Project Manager 1

Contract No. LEARN-IC-NIO-7.4.1

Lifting Education Access and Resilience in Times of Need in Ukraine Program

URTF Grant No. TF0C5794

 

 BACKGROUND

 

Ukraine and the World Bank have signed the agreements for the Program "Lifting Education Access and Resilience in Times of Need in Ukraine Program" (hereinafter referred to as the LEARN). The objectives of the LEARN are: to (i) improve teaching and learning conditions; and (ii) to strengthen the management capacity of the education system.

 

The total financing for the Operation is US$451 million using a combination of the World Bank's financial instruments: Program-for-Results (PforR) complemented by Investment Project Financing (IPF).

The Program-for-Results (PforR) is funded by a US$235 million credit provided by Bank resources, supported by credit enhancement from the Advancing Needed Credit Enhancement for Ukraine (ADVANCE Ukraine) Trust Fund, which is backed by the Government of Japan. This is formalized under the Financing Agreement between Ukraine and the International Development Association for the Program (CREDIT NUMBER 7626-UA). An additional US$150 million is provided under the Special Program for Ukraine and Moldova Recovery (SPUR) of the International Development Association (IDA) Crisis Facility, as outlined in the Loan Agreement between Ukraine and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development for the Program (LOAN NUMBER 9721-UA). Financing Agreement (Additional Financing: Lifting Education Access and Resilience in Times of Need in Ukraine Program) between Ukraine and the International Development Association (CREDIT NUMBER 7905-UA) was signed in the amount of US$4.9 million.

Furthermore, US$30 million in Investment Project Financing (IPF) is secured under the Grant Agreement between Ukraine and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the International Development Association, acting as the administrator of the Ukraine Relief, Recovery, Reconstruction, and Reform Multi-Donor Trust Fund (URTF GRANT NUMBER TF0C5794).

Furthermore, US$31.1 million in Additional Financing is provided through grant resources, consisting of US$30.0 million from the Ukraine Relief, Recovery, Reconstruction, and Reform Multi-Donor Trust Fund and US$1.1 million from the Global Partnership for Education Fund. This additional financing is formalized under the Grant Agreement between Ukraine and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the International Development Association, jointly acting as a Supervising Entity for the Global Partnership for Education Fund and as administrator of the Ukraine Relief, Recovery, Reconstruction, and Reform Multi-Donor Trust Fund (URTF GRANT NUMBER TF0D0612; GPE GRANT NUMBER TF0D0613), and supports activities related to the continued implementation of the Program.

 

LEARN was developed to address critical challenges and provide essential support to the education sector, aligning with the Ministry of Education and Science’s (MoES) Strategic Action Plan.

LEARN will focus on supporting the Strategic Action Plan Priority 2: School education and the New Ukrainian School (NUS). The continuation of the NUS reform is a key priority of the MoES.

The objectives of the Program are to (i) improve teaching and learning conditions; and (ii) strengthen management capacity of the education system.

The Program is implemented in Ukraine by the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine (MoES) with the support of the World Bank Group. The implementation period is 2024-2027.

More detailed information is given at the link https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P504171

 

The Operation will focus on supporting the Strategic Action Plan Priority 2: School education and the New Ukrainian School (NUS). The continuation of the NUS reform is a key priority of the MoES.

The objectives of the Operation are to (i) improve teaching and learning conditions; and (ii) strengthen management capacity of the education system.

For this program, "teaching and learning conditions" refer to three critical factors of education service delivery:

i. safety, including shelters as a pre-condition for schools to open for in-person learning and free and inclusive school bus transportation for students living further distances from schools;

ii. learning materials, especially updated textbooks and age-appropriate learning materials in line with the NUS model; and

iii. teachers trained on NUS standards, principles, and the use of the updated learning materials.

Meanwhile, "management capacity of the education system" refers to institutional capabilities to plan, allocate, and monitor resources based on robust data at the student and school levels.

The NUS Implementation Office (NIO) will be established by the Ministry as an advisory and consultative body. The NIO's primary purpose is to support and implement the New Ukrainian School (NUS) reform by providing expert guidance, strategic oversight, and coordination of reform initiatives across Ukraine.

 OBJECTIVE

The objective of this assignment is to ensure effective project management and coordination within the Cross-sectoral Project Management Unit of the NUS Implementation Office to achieve reform objectives.

SCOPE OF SERVICES

The Consultant shall provide the following services, including but not limited to:

  • Manages specific projects and initiatives within the NUS reform implementation.
  • Ensures coordination between different units and teams to achieve project objectives.
  • Develops and implements project plans, including timelines, resources, and budgets.
  • Conducts monitoring and reporting on project progress.
  • Identifies and manages project risks, develops mitigation strategies.
  • Maintains communication with all project stakeholders.

 

REPORTING

Project Manager 1 reports directly to the Operational Deputy Head of New Ukrainian School Implementation Office. For operational matters, works in coordination with relevant unit heads.

Monthly reports must include details of progress, challenges, and tasks completed, along with time sheets.

PROVIDED RESOURCES

MoES shall provide the Consultant with the information necessary to carry out his/her assignment in a timely manner. MoES shall provide the Consultant with a workplace, including necessary equipment to carry out his/her functions (e.g. PC, communications and office equipment).

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum requirements (mandatory):

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project management and administration/implementation
  • At least 1 year of experience in collaboration with national and local government authorities
  • At least 2 years of experience in education sector, preferably school education
  • Experience of collaboration with international financial or donor organizations
  • Advanced spoken and written English (upper intermediate or better level of English including knowledge of project management terminology)
  • Fluency in Ukrainian

Desired skills and qualifications:

  • Experience in managing educational projects
  • Strong understanding of project management methodologies
  • Knowledge of NUS reform principles and objectives
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • Ability to work in conditions of high uncertainty
  • Crisis management experience

PERIOD AND LOCATION OF EMPLOYMENT

The Consultant shall provide his/her services until August 31, 2027. The contract may be extended subject to satisfactory performance and mutual agreement between the Consultant and the Ministry of Education and Science (MoES) during the Project financing period.

The Consultant shall provide his/her services on a full-time basis.

The incumbent will be based in Kyiv, Ukraine. The Consultant should be required and expected to take business trips to other regions of Ukraine to support implementation of the Project.

APPLICATION PACKAGE

Interested persons should submit their CVs in Ukrainian and English at the following email address: kateryna.kovtun@mon.gov.ua, Cc: serhiy.artemenko@uiherp.org and maryna.chubenko@mon.gov.ua  indicating the email subject: " LEARN-IC-NIO-7.4.1: Selection of Project Manager 1: [NAME]".

The deadline for submission of the documents is 14:00 am Kyiv time August 25, 2026.

If the Consultant fails to provide CVs in both languages, the Client reserves the right to reject the Consultant's application.
