The Federal Government of Nigeria (FGN), through the Federal Ministry of Water Resources and Sanitation (FMWRS), has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of implementing the Sustainable Power and Irrigation for Nigeria (SPIN) Project, and intends to apply part of the proceeds to finance the engagement of a Consulting Firm for the Construction Supervision of the Design & Build Irrigation Schemes (Modernization and Expansion) across selected irrigation schemes nationwide.

The SPIN Project is designed to strengthen dam safety and improve the management of water resources for hydropower and irrigation in selected areas of Nigeria. Under Subcomponents 2.2 and 2.3 of the Project, the FGN seeks to rehabilitate and modernize irrigation and drainage infrastructure while improving irrigation management systems to enhance water delivery efficiency, expand command areas, and strengthen climate resilience.

Purpose of the Assignment

The modernization and expansion of the irrigation schemes will be executed under a Design Build (DB) contractual arrangement governed by the FIDIC Yellow Book (2017 Edition). Due to the complexity of the DB modality, the Employer requires an independent and highly qualified Supervision Consultant (“the Consultant”) to act as the Employer’s Representative throughout the project life cycle.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for Adani and Ndieze Irrigation Scheme located in Enugu & Ebonyi States, can be accessed at the following link: https://1drv.ms/w/c/bea66a6a0847ee73/IQBvbJdu_lTLQaK7gY9BbIhQAWl_4w8Ua5FAa1Ayy2NP3PA?e=ANEyvK

The Federal Ministry of Water Resources and Sanitation, through the Federal Project Management Unit (FPMU) of the SPIN Project, now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested firms must provide sufficient information demonstrating that they meet the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

Shortlisting Criteria

  • The firm shall have a minimum of ten (10) years of demonstrated in experience providing construction supervision services for large scale infrastructure projects, Experience with Design Build (DB) or FIDIC Yellow Book based contracts is an added advantage.

  • The firm shall demonstrate experience in supervising rehabilitation, or expansion of gravity fed and pressurized irrigation systems, including canal networks (open/closed channels), water control structures, drainage systems, and on farm distribution infrastructure.
  • The firm shall demonstrate its technical and managerial capabilities, including the capacity to mobilize a multidisciplinary team of qualified engineers and specialists for the supervision of large irrigation infrastructure projects.

Evidence of similar assignments previously undertaken (Contract Award Letters, Job Completion Letters, and other evidence that may be required to verify such experience).

The Ministry of Finance and Planning (MoFP) is seeking to recruit qualified Data Analysis and Reporting Officer under the Social Recovery & Job Creation Project (SRJC), financed by the World Bank for the benefit of The Ministry of Local Government.

The selected Data Analysis and Reporting Officer will be assigned to work at the Ministry of Local Government — to support the Ministry of Local Government in strengthening institutional reporting, improving data analysis, and enhancing the quality and consistency of information used for planning, monitoring, and decision-making.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Data Analysis and Reporting Officer will support the collection, validation, analysis, and reporting of institutional data and information. The Officer will coordinate with relevant departments to improve reporting processes, prepare analytical reports, and support evidence-based planning and institutional performance.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collect, organize, validate, and analyze reports and data received from relevant departments.
  • Prepare periodic reports, statistical summaries, analytical reports, briefing notes, and presentations.
  • Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure the timely submission and accuracy of reports and data.
  • Consolidate institutional reports and ensure the consistency and completeness of information.
  • Maintain and update reporting records, databases, and related documentation.
  • Develop dashboards, charts, and reporting tools to support management decision-making.
  • Review data quality and identify inconsistencies or gaps requiring follow-up.
  • Support the preparation of reports required by senior management, development partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Recommend improvements to reporting systems and data analysis practices.
  • Maintain organized electronic and hard-copy records related to reporting and data analysis.
  • Perform any other related duties as may be assigned by the Director General of the Projects Department.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Statistics, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Economics, Public Administration, or any other related field.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience in reporting, data analysis, institutional reporting, or administrative coordination.
  • Demonstrated experience in preparing reports, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, and presenting findings.
  • Experience working with government institutions or internationally financed projects is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience in Power BI, Excel dashboards, or other data visualization tools is considered an advantage.
  • Excellent communication and report-writing skills in both Arabic and English.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

O Estado de Alagoas recebeu financiamento do Banco Mundial para custear parcialmente o Programa Progestão Alagoas, e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos para serviços de consultoria.

Os recursos têm por objetivo a execução do Programa Progestão, o qual visa promover a melhoria contínua da gestão fiscal, orçamentária e patrimonial da administração pública estadual por meio de ações que findem na redução e na racionalização do gasto público com resultados perenes, de modo a contribuir para a sustentabilidade fiscal de Alagoas.

Nesse sentido, o Alagoas Previdência se propõe a utilizar parte dos recursos do programa para a seleção de Consultor Individual para desenvolvimento de solução tecnológica para apoio a administração e gestão do Assessoria Especial de Investimentos deste Alagoas Previdência, objetivando a consolidação da carteira de investimento do Alagoas Previdência, e a extração de relatórios periódicos.

Com o objetivo de contratar esse serviço, o Alagoas Previdência convida profissionais a manifestarem seu interesse na prestação dos serviços como consultor individual.

Os profissionais interessados deverão proporcionar informações que indiquem que estão qualificados para prestar os serviços, mediante a apresentação de currículo, devendo constar nome completo, CPF, endereço completo, telefone, e-mail, histórico acadêmico, experiências comprovadas nas competências abaixo.

Obs.: A presente Manifestação de Interesse deverá conter todos os documentos comprobatórios anexados juntos ao documento de Manifestação de Interesse (Currículos, Certificados, Atestados, Diplomas...), em um único arquivo com tamanho máximo de 7mb.

É necessário que o perfil do(a) profissional atendas às seguintes exigências, que são indispensáveis à presente contratação:

Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Estatística, Economia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência comprovada (mínimo de 3 anos) em modelagem e desenvolvimento de dashboards com ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau, Qlik ou equivalentes;

Domínio de análise estatística e visualização de dados financeiros;

Comprovar conhecimento em modelagem de risco financeiro e compliance como desejável para o Consultor.

Para este perfil, também é desejável:

Experiência prática ou conhecimento comprovado em estruturação de carteiras de investimento de RPPS ou entidades similares;

Capacidade de interpretar extratos, rentabilidades e estruturas de ativos para auxiliar na modelagem lógica da solução.

O profissional será selecionado de acordo com os procedimentos indicados no Regulamento de aquisições para mutuários de operações de financiamento de projetos de investimento do Banco Mundial, quarta edição de novembro de 2020.

É parte integrante desta Manifestação de Interesse o e Termo de Referência (TdR) no qual consta a descrição detalhada das atividades a serem desempenhadas e dos produtos a serem elaborados, e que está disponível no website: www.sefaz.al.gov.br/licitacao

Os profissionais interessados deverão encaminhar as manifestações até o dia 02 de setembro de 2026, às 12 horas, devidamente identificadas como TR AL1.1 BR-ALPREV/AL-539014-CS-INDV, no seguinte endereço eletrônico celp@sefaz.al.gov.br.

Untuk itu Project Supervision Consultant for Semarang River and Baru River  ini terdiri atas Tenaga Ahli Utama (Key expert) yang diperlukan. Perusahaan konsultan harus menyediakan tenaga ahli professional yang ditugaskan selama 15 bulan kalender. Kerangka Acuan Kerja (KAK) Project Supervision Consultant for Semarang River and Baru River terlampir pada REOI ini /  atau dapat diunduh pada tautan berikut: https://bit.ly/ProjectSupervisionSemarangBaru

 

Balai Besar Wilayah Sungai Pemali Juana mengundang perusahaan konsultan yang memenuhi syarat untuk memasukkan pernyataan berminat untuk memberikan layanan jasa konsultan. Perusahaan konsultan yang berminat harus memberikan informasi yang mendukung bahwa perusahaan konsultan yang bersangkutan memenuhi syarat untuk menjalankan layanan jasa tersebut diatas  (misalnya: brosur/riwayat organisasi dan pengalaman dalam menjalankan layanan jasa konsultan dengan sifat dan kondisi yang sama, dan informasi lainnya yang relevan). Kriteria untuk shortlist adalah:  

  1. Pengalaman Perusahaan

Perusahaan berpengalaman dalam jasa konsultan minimal 10 tahun dengan bisnis utamanya jasa konsultansi : Bantuan Teknis, Studi Kelayakan, Desain dan Perencanaan serta Pengawasan Teknis di dalamnya bidang Sumber Daya Air.

  1. Pengalaman serupa yang diperlukan :
  1. Perusahaan Konsultan memiliki pengalaman dalam pengawasan/supervisi pengendalian banjir di Sungai, pengawasan/supervisi perkuatan tebing Sungai, pengawasan/supervisi Pembangunan tanggul Sungai dan pengawasan/supervisi pengendalian banjir perkotaan dalam kurun waktu 10 tahun
  2. Perusahaan Konsultan diutamakan memiliki pengalaman dalam pengawasan/supervisi pembangunan kolam retensi dan/atau pengawasan/supervisi pembangunan pompa banjir dengan kapasitas ≥ 1500 l/detik dalam kurun waktu 10 tahun terakhir
  3. Perusahan Konsultan diutamakan sudah pernah menyelesaikan kontrak proyek pengelolaan dana bantuan/pinjaman luar negeri (> Rp 2.500.000.000,00) dalam kurun waktu 10 tahun terakhir

 

Setiap pengalaman perusahaan yang dicantumkan harus disertai dengan referensi dari Pengguna Jasa yang bersangkutan berupa Kontrak, Berita Acara Serah Terima, Surat Perjanjian KSO (apabila ber-KSO) serta data dukung lainnya.

 

  1. Kemampuan teknis dan Manajerial perusahaan

Perusahaan Konsultan memiliki tenaga ahli tetap (dibuktikan dengan payroll regular perusahaan atau bukti lainnya) yang relevan dengan penugasan ini. Kualifikasi dan Pengalaman Tenaga Ahli Utama (Key experts) tidak disertakan dalam kriteria pemilihan daftar pendek. Tenaga Ahli Utama (Key experts) tidak akan dievaluasi pada tahap pemilihan daftar pendek (shortlisting). Hanya pengalaman perusahaan anggota KSO yang akan dievaluasi, pengalaman sub-consultant tidak akan dievaluasi

Perusahaan konsultan yang berminat harap memperhatikan prosedur dalam paragraf 3.14, 3.16, dan 3.17 Peraturan Bank Dunia: Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, November 2020 (selanjutnya disebut: Procurement Regulations) tentang kebijakan Bank dunia mengenai konflik kepentingan. Selain itu, silakan merujuk ke informasi spesifik berikut tentang konflik kepentingan terkait dengan penugasan ini sesuai paragraph 3.17 Procurement Regulations.

 

Perusahaan konsultan diperkenankan untuk berasosiasi dengan perusahaan konsultan lain dalam bentuk KSO (Kerjasama operasi) atau sub-konsultan guna meningkatkan kualifikasinya tetapi harus menunjukkan dengan jelas apakah asosiasi tersebut berbentuk KSO dan/atau sub-konsultan. Dalam hal KSO, semua mitra dalam KSO harus secara bersama-sama bertanggung jawab atas seluruh kontrak, jika dipilih. Jumlah Perusahaan yang melakukan KSO tidak lebih banyak dari 3 (tiga) Perusahaan.

 

Perusahaan konsultan akan diseleksi mengacu pada metode CQS (Consultant Qualification Selection) sesuai dengan Procurement Regulations

Assignment Title: Senior Consultant-Waste Mng Policy and Institutional Development

Credit/Loan no.: TF-B9747

Reference no.: SX-NRPB-560450-CS-INDV

 

The Government of Sint Maarten has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Emergency Debris Management Project (EDMP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The overall objective of the assignment is to engage a Senior Consultant to provide specialized technical and strategic expertise to support the implementation of activities aimed at strengthening the waste management sector. The Consultant will contribute to policy enhancement, capacity building and asset management within the Ministry of Public Housing, Spatial Planning, Environment and Infrastructure (VROMI) and other relevant government entities.

 

The assignment will support ongoing operations and the establishment of a stronger institutional and policy framework for sustainable waste management and improved sector performance.

The Supervision Consultant will deliver the following:

  • Inception Report and Work Plan
  • Develop a National Disaster Waste Policy (Activity E.1)
  • Development of Terms of Reference for dedicated policy capacity (Activity A.3)
  • Public guidance protocols for hurricane-related waste management and disaster readiness (Activity E.2)
  • Final assignment report

 

The Consultant shall ensure that all activities are implemented in accordance with the quality standards, time and budget elaborated in the contract document.

 

The National Recovery Program Bureau (NRPB) now invites eligible consultants (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The selection criteria are:

  • Advanced degree in Environmental Engineering, Waste Management, Environmental Policy, Public Administration, Civil Engineering, or related discipline.
  • At least 10 years of professional experience in disaster waste management, environmental governance, institutional strengthening, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience in coordination across multiple actors.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting standalone activities in a wide context, capacity-building initiatives, and policy advisory assignments.
  • Experience in supporting government agencies in the development of policies and operational improvement programs.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, analytical, and report-writing skills.

 

Applicants are free to choose a format for their Expression of Interest. At this stage, Consultants are expected to provide:

  1. CVs including relevant information about qualifications and expertise, strategic competencies or achievements;
  2. Relevant references from previous similar projects/clients.

 

NRPB reserves the right to invite any or all interested candidates to an interview.

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” November 2020 edition (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

 

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Open Competitive Selection of Individual Consultants as set forth in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Expressions of interest must be submitted via the NRPB’s procurement portal which can be done via: National Recovery Program Bureau of St. Maarten - Senior Waste Management Policy and Institutional Development Consultant by Monday, September 7th, 2026 at 5:00 PM (AST).

 

All queries from interested bidders must be submitted electronically to https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com through the Vendor Discussions section under the respective project. Interested bidders should register in the NRPB's procurement portal at https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com/login/. Detailed instructions for registration are available at https://nrpbsxm.org/procurement.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

Assignment Title: CONSULTING SERVICES FOR NEEDS ASSESSMENT, TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS, AND SUPPORT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN INTEGRATED BORDER INTELLIGENCE AND RISK MANAGEMENT SOLUTION

Reference No. 98CS1/MINPLAN/26

The Government of Angola has received financing from the World Bank Group's International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) toward the cost of the Accelerating Economic Diversification and Job Creation Project (Diversifica Mais) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services for Needs Assessment, Technical Specifications, and Support for the Development of an Integrated Border Intelligence and Risk Management Solution.

Consulting Services (“the Services”) aim to provide technical support to the Coordinated Border Management Committee (CGCF) in all phases prior to and during the development of an Integrated Border Intelligence and Risk Management Solution. The role of the consulting firm includes:

  1. Identifying the functional and operational needs at the borders, mapping and reviewing existing processes, and inventorying technological systems in use;
  2. Developing the functional and technical architecture of the solution, defining interoperability requirements, creating a data dictionary and data model, and estimating the development and implementation costs;
  3. Assisting in the preparation of the bidding documents for the selection of the technology development company and issuing a substantiated technical opinion on the recommended proposal;
  4. Technically supervising the development of the solution by the contracted company, verifying compliance with the approved technical specifications, validating deliverables and progress reports, and supporting the testing and implementation at border points;
  5. Evaluating the national legal and regulatory framework relevant to the implementation of the solution, identifying gaps, and providing advice and support to the CGCF to address them;
  6. Preparing detailed technical specifications for the core module of the solution, covering general principles, the complete risk management cycle, the risk management engine, the alert system, intelligence governance and human review, auditing, monitoring and performance, and the incorporation of artificial intelligence.

The expected duration of the consultancy contract will be twenty-four (24) months.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Accelerating Economic Diversification and Job Creation Project (Diversifica Mais) now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  • A minimum of 7 years of proven experience in process reengineering and/or IT systems specification projects;
  • Demonstrable experience in projects related to border management, customs, immigration, or public safety;
  • Preference given to companies with MININT pre-approval to handle confidential government data;
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification, which validates project management skills;
  • ITIL Service Strategy Certification, which demonstrates skills in IT service strategy;
  • TOGAF® Certification Program, which demonstrates expertise in the development and implementation of enterprise architecture, essential for ensuring data integration and efficiency in the integration of complex systems;
  • Must be formally registered with the APD, ensuring compliance with current regulations regarding data protection and privacy;
  • Preference will be given to companies that hold the “Made in Angola” seal in the areas of telecommunications and/or information systems, in accordance with Presidential Decree No. 213/23, which establishes the Legal Framework for Incentives to Domestic Production;
  • Must be duly registered with the National Institute for the Promotion of the Information Society (INFOSI), ensuring that it operates in accordance with national guidelines for technological development;
  • Submit a certificate of tax compliance, proving its good standing with the tax authorities and ensuring its suitability to perform the contract.
  • Demonstrate institutional, technical, and reputational suitability consistent with national security projects and the management of sensitive information;
  • Ensure that its key employees involved in the project undergo background checks, in accordance with applicable law;
  • Comply with any additional guidelines, restrictions, or requirements established by MININT regarding the protection of national security

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” revised in September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

1. This request for expressions of interest follows the General Procurement Notice for the Dar es Salaam Metropolitan Development Project - Phase 2 (DMDP 2) that appeared in the United Nations Development Business (UNDB) online Notice No. OP00277705 of March 6, 2024.

2. The Government of the United Republic of Tanzania has received a credit from the International Development Association (IDA) towards the cost of the Dar es Salaam Metropolitan Development Project – Phase 2 (DMDP 2), implemented by the Prime Minister’s Office – Regional Administration and Local Government (PMO-RALG) in collaboration with the Dar es Salaam Local Authorities (DLAs). Part of the proceeds of this financing will be applied to eligible payments under the contract for the Provision of Consultancy Services for Preparation of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments and Resettlement Action Plans for Area-Based Investments in Dar es Salaam City, Kinondoni, Ubungo, Temeke and Kigamboni Municipalities, and Priority Drainage Interventions in Dar es Salaam under DMDP 2.

3. The overall objective of the assignment is to support PMO-RALG and the Dar es Salaam Local Authorities to prepare comprehensive Environmental and Social Impact Assessments, Environmental and Social Management Plans, and Resettlement Action Plans for all three (3) Sub-Assignments concurrently, ensuring that environmental, social, land acquisition, livelihood, and resettlement issues are identified, assessed, and managed in full compliance with Tanzanian requirements and the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework, with findings delivered in time to inform the respective parallel design processes.

Sub-Assignment A covers the Preparation of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments, Environmental and Social Management Plans, and Resettlement Action Plans for selected area-based investments in Kinondoni Municipality and Ubungo Municipality under DMDP 2. Sub-Assignment B covers the Preparation of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments, Environmental and Social Management Plans, and Resettlement Action Plans for selected area-based investments in Dar es Salaam City, Temeke Municipality, and Kigamboni Municipality under DMDP 2. Sub-Assignment C covers the Preparation of an Environmental and Social Impact Assessment, Environmental and Social Management Plan, and Resettlement Action Plan for priority drainage interventions under of DMDP 2 across all five Dar es Salaam Local Authorities.

4. The specific objectives of this assignment are to: (i) Establish environmental and social baseline conditions for each selected subproject site or drainage corridor and its wider area of influence; (ii) Assess direct, indirect, induced, cumulative, and residual environmental and social risks and impacts throughout the full project cycle; (iii) Undertake land acquisition and resettlement screening and prepare site-specific RAPs, abbreviated RAPs, or due diligence notes as required; (iv) Conduct census, socio-economic survey, asset inventory, affected-person verification, and valuation support; (v) Prepare practical, costed, and implementable ESMPs and RAPs integrating findings into design, procurement, and supervision arrangements; and (vi) Ensure compliance with applicable Tanzanian requirements and the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF).

5. The scope of services for each of the sub-assignment will include, but not be limited to undertaking: Inception Activities, Document Review, and Work Planning; Policy, Legal, Regulatory, and Institutional Review; Site Screening and Scoping; Environmental and Social Baseline Studies; Resettlement Screening, Census, Socio-Economic Survey, and Asset Inventory; Stakeholder Engagement and Disclosure; Analysis of Alternatives; Environmental and Social Impact Assessment; Preparation of the Environmental and Social Management Plan;  Preparation of Resettlement Action Plans; Coordination with the Design Consultant; and Preparation of Final Reports and Regulatory Submission Packages. The consultant shall ensure that all deliverables/outputs are technically sound, internally consistent, and suitable for decision-making, public disclosure, and subsequent implementation.

6. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) can be found at the following website: https://www.tamisemi.go.tz. Requests for clarification should be sent through the following e-mail addresses: cities.project@yahoo.com or cities.project@tamisemi.go.tz, and the Client will send responses to clarifications through the same e-mail addresses.

7. The Permanent Secretary, PMO-RALG, now invites eligible consulting firms to indicate their interest in providing the above services. Interested consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services. The short-listing criteria are: (a) Type of core business and at least 10 years in relevant business; (b) Relevant similar experience, which should specifically include the following: (i) Experience in similar assignments - information to be provided should include the name of the assignments, the names and full contact addresses of the clients, the contract value (in equivalent US dollars), the period (month/year) of execution of the assignments, and the role played in the assignments (Lead or JV Partner); (ii) Demonstration of experience working in similar conditions; and (c) The firm's technical and managerial capability (provide only the organizational structure, and the general qualifications, field of expertise and number of key personnel). Consultants shall not use the Affiliate Member's Managerial, Technical or Experience Capabilities to enhance their qualifications.

Note that: The Request for Expression of Interest (REOI) for this Consultancy Services for Preparation of a Combined Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) and Resettlement Action Plan (RAP) for Area Based Investments in DLAs and Priority Drainage Interventions in Dar es Salaam under DMDP 2 is being advertised at the same time together with another similar Tender for Consultancy Services to Undertake an Environmental and Social Impact Assessment, and Resettlement Action Plan for Flood and Erosion Control Interventions in the Middle and Upper Basin of the Msimbazi River in Dar es Salaam; and the assignments in these two Tenders will be executed simultaneously. REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

 

 

Country:  MOZAMBIQUE

Project:  Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project

Agreement: Preparation Advance No. -V522-MZ.

Assignment Title: Individual Consultancy Services to Provision Hydrologist Specialist Project Advisor for providing Project Advisory to undertaking the review of the hydrological studies of the planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.

 

Reference: MZ-GMNK-442364-CS-INDV

 

 

 

The Government of Mozambique (GoM) hereinafter referred to as “the Borrower” have received Advance funds from International Development Association (IDA) towards the costs of the Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project, Preparation Phase. The funds have been channeled through the Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project Office (GMNK) as the Project Implementation Agency, and GMNK intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consulting Services for providing Project Advisory for undertaking the review of the hydrological studies of the planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.

 

 

The GMNK now invites eligible Individual Consultant (“Consultants”) to express their interest in providing the Services. Interested Individual Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services. The shortlisting criteria are:

 

  1. qualification, experience and skills in providing Project advisory services for reviewing the hydrological studies of hydropower projects;
  2. a minimum of Post Graduate Degree in the relevant hydrological disciplines and must have at least 15 years of professional experience relevant to the assignment.
  3. description of similar assignments previously carried out - must have done at least two (2) similar assignments (hydrological of hydropower advisory services), and
  4. experience of working in Sub-Sahara Africa - at least one (1) of the assignments should be in Sub-Shara Africa - and other regions.

 

Evidence shall be attached as supporting documents for the Expression of Interest.

 

Objective

 

The Project is being prepared for seeking financial support of the World Bank (the “Bank”) and therefore must comply with the World Bank Safeguards Policies and Performance Standards (see the concept project information document stage at the WB website [1]).  Accordingly, the Mphanda Nkuwa Project needs to comply with the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) – Community Health and Safety (ESS4[2]). To this effect two panel of experts (PoEs) need to be formed: (i) Panel of Experts for Dam Safety (PoE-DS); and (ii) Panel of Experts for Environmental and Social Management (PoE-ESM).

Key Responsibilities/ Scope of Reviews

 

The hydrologist will:

 

  1. Review of the hydrological studies pertaining to the long-term inflow to the reservoirs, and spillway and diversion design floods with reference to international criteria. Assess the adequacy of spillway and diversion facilities, also considering increasing hydrological variability associated with global warming. Review of soil erosion data and estimate of sediment yield into the reservoirs, estimated reservoir sedimentation, and assessment of the long-term sustainable capacity that could be maintained by implementing appropriate management strategies. Review of layouts related to sediment management of the reservoirs including sediment flushing.
  2. Review of the design of spillway and tailrace facilities including flow conditions, energy dissipation and need for hydraulic modelling.
  3. Review of the designs of the diversion works, schedule and risk factors associated with diversion during construction and with the closure of diversion works at initial reservoir filling.

 

Expected Assignment Timeline

 

The assignment is for a period of six (6) years, covering project preparation, construction, and initial reservoir filling. Request for Express of Interest (REOI)

 

Consultancy Services for Implementation Support and Works Supervision for Output and Performance Based Roads Contracts under the Cambodia Regional Connectivity Improvement (CRCI) Project

(Firms Selection, Reference No. KH-CRCI-MPWT-QCBS-01)

1. The Ministry of Public Works and Transport (MPWT) of the Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC) has applied for financing support from the World Bank's (WB) International Development Association (IDA) to implement the Cambodia Regional Connectivity Improvement Project (CRCI) with and duration of six (6.5) years starting in early 2027. The CRCI consists of the following 4 components:

Component 1: Road Corridor Improvement

Component 2: Institutional Capacity Strengthening in Logistics and Trade Facilitation

Component 3: Phase 1 Project Management and Phase 2 Preparation

Component 4: Contingent Emergency Response

MPWT is responsible for overall technical supervision, execution and management of the Project.

The CRCI seeks to enhance transport connectivity along Cambodia’s segment of Asian Highway 21 (AH21), a key east-west corridor linking Cambodia and Viet Nam. Upgrading this section will promote economic growth in Cambodia’s northeastern provinces and strengthen trade relations with neighboring countries. The project aims to improve community road access to essential services, including health centers, referral hospitals, schools, and markets, by upgrading climate-resilient national roads. Additionally, it will lower transportation costs and mitigate risks of road disruptions, thereby supporting the efficiency of agricultural supply chains and promoting tourism development within the project area. The CRCI will use the Output and Performance Based Road Contract (OPBRC) approach to support upgrades, climate resilience, safety, and maintenance for parts of NR 64, NR 62, all of NR 9, and sections of NR 7.

2. The scope of services sought under this REOI covers Implementation Support and Works Supervision (ISWS) for activities associated with Component 1 (the civil works component), which includes the following tasks:

a) Supervision of four OPBRC packages of road rehabilitation work of 247km, covering NR 64 (chainage km 0 to km 92), NR 62 (chainage km 92 to km 112), and NR 9 (chainage km 113 to km 246), including ground works for the future installation of high-speed optical cable.

b) Monitoring the maintenance services of four OPBRC packages of 247km over full 4-year duration of the contract’s maintenance phase.

c) Provision of implementation and supervision support and related technical capacity building activities and provide Institutional Development and Project Management Support to MPWT.

The Rehabilitation Works for Phase 1 will be divided into four OPBRC packages, commencing at kilometer 19+800 of NR 64. The route traverses the eastern side of Siem Reap Province, connects to the NR62 section, covers the entire NR 9 in Preah Vihear Province, and proceeds to the NR7 section in Stung Treng Province.

The OPBRC contracts extend over a period of 6.5 years, comprising 2.5 years (30 months) allocated for rehabilitation activities, followed by 4 years (48 months) dedicated to maintenance.

The ISWS Consultant is expected to start the assignment in parallel with the first OPBRC Contractor, which is planned to be awarded by February 2027 and finalize the services after completion of 78-month period. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

3. The CRCI now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

(i) Years of relevant experience (30%): The firm shall have at least ten (10) years of experience in supervising road improvement, rehabilitation, or construction works, and at least five (5) years of experience in supervising road maintenance works; such experience in Cambodia or other Southeast Asia countries is an advantage;

(ii) Experience in large road supervision contracts (35%): The firm shall have successfully completed at least three (3) assignments of comparable scope within the past ten (10) years, involving implementation support and/or supervision of road works with a civil works contract value of at least US$6.0 million each; Experience on at least two (2) projects financed by multilateral development banks or other international development partners is required.

(iii) Experience in supervising OPBRC (35 %): The firm shall have experience in comparable implementation support and supervision services (ISWS) for at least two (2) contracts involving road works and maintenance under design & build forms of contract (e.g., DBMOT, DBFOT, BOT, BOOT) or performance-based contracts; experience in ISWS for Output- and Performance-Based Road Contracts (OPBRC) is a strong advantage.

For each of the three criteria above, Consultants shall list relevant contracts separately, with a maximum of 15 contracts per criterion. If more than 15 references are submitted for any criterion, only the first 15 will be considered. No specific template is required for Contract/Project Data Sheets; however, each data sheet shall provide sufficient information for evaluation against the relevant criterion, including contract period, amount in USD equivalent, type of association such as joint venture or sub-consultancy and the applicant firm’s participation percentage, type of road contract supervised, financier, country, and a brief description of services. Consultants are responsible for providing complete information; no clarifications will be sought during evaluation.

Experience of sub-consultants and incomplete assignments will not be considered. References without dates or sufficient project details will not be counted. Qualifications of Key Experts or proposed staff will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage. EOIs shall be submitted in English, and only shortlisted Consultants will be invited to submit full technical and financial proposals.

Firms shall provide evidence of satisfactory performance from previous clients for the assignments listed in the EOI, such as client performance reports and contact details. Consultants may associate with other firms to strengthen their qualifications but must clearly state whether the association is a joint venture and/or sub-consultancy. If selected as a joint venture, all partners shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract.

4. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/104QFdw-Xq7V4ZpnGdAY-oJB1c_eE4LAN, or can be obtained at the address given below.

6. A consulting firm will be selected using the Quality- and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method in accordance with the applicable World Bank Procurement Regulations. 1.Le Gouvernement de la République du Congo a obtenu de la Banque internationale pour la reconstruction et le développement (BIRD) un prêt d'un montant de 70 millions USD, ainsi qu'un don d'un montant de 12 millions USD du Partenariat mondial pour des paysages durables et résilients (PROGREEN), soit un total de 82 millions USD, pour la mise en œuvre du Projet de création d'activités économiques inclusives et résilientes au changement climatique (ProClimat Congo - P177786). Le ProClimat a également bénéficié d'un financement additionnel de 50 millions USD de la part de l'IDA. La durée du Projet est de cinq (5) ans. Une partie de ces fonds servira à effectuer le paiement au titre de la mission susmentionnée.

2. L’objectif global de la mission de l’agence spécialisée est d’analyser et de sélectionner les plans d’affaires soumis par les Micro, Petites et Moyennes Entreprises (MPME), les Coopératives et les Groupements candidats aux subventions du ProClimat. Spécifiquement, il s’agira de :

  • Recueillir les plans d’affaires anonymisés des candidats auprès des ONG en coordination avec les BSP/UGP (cf. schéma 1 et tableau 1 ci-dessous pour les détails sur le nombre de plans d’affaires à sélectionner) ;
  • Analyser et sélectionner les plans d’affaires sur les aspects de la viabilité technique, économique et financière ainsi que la viabilité environnementale et sociale sur la base des critères de sélection contenu dans le manuel ;
  • Valider les plans d’affaires en tenant compte des critères de validation du Manuel de financement du ProClimat ;
  • Produire un rapport d’analyse et de validation des plans d’affaires.

Les Termes de Référence (TDR) complets pour la mission sont disponibles à l’adresse indiquée ci-dessous.

Le projet de création des activités économiques inclusives et résilientes face au changement climatique (ProClimat) invite les firmes « Consultants » éligibles à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir des informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et un tableau de présentation des expériences/missions similaires avec justificatifs en annexe (attestations de bonne exécution, précédents contrats, etc.).

Les firmes installées au Congo doivent également fournir un dossier administratif contenant principalement (liste non exhaustive) :

  • Une copie valide de la Licence Unique d’Exploitation des Entreprises (LUEE) délivrée par l’ACPCE (uniquement pour les firmes nationales) ;
  • Une copie du Registre de Commerce et Crédit du Mobilier (RCCM) dans le domaine.

Les firmes installées hors du Congo doivent également fournir un dossier administratif contenant principalement (liste non exhaustive) :

  • Une copie du Kbis/RCCM ;
  • Une copie de l’attestation de non faillite en cours de validité.

4. Les critères pour l'évaluation des Manifestations d’Intérêt sont les suivants :

  • Être un cabinet reconnu par les services compétents ;
  • Avoir une connaissance du contexte agricole congolais ;
  • Avoir au moins 5 ans d’expérience avérée dans l’analyse des plans d’affaires dans les secteurs agroforestier, agropastoral, halieutique, PFNL, écotouristique, etc. ;
  • Avoir une expérience en analyse et sélection des plans d’affaires suivant les critères techniques financiers, commerciaux, environnementaux et sociaux ;
  • Avoir une expérience avec les groupes vulnérables en République du Congo ;

Country:        The Republic of the Gambia

Project Title: The Gambia Public Administration Modernization for Citizen Centric Service Delivery (PAMP) Project.

Assignment Title: Capacity Assessment of Local Environment Committees (LECs)

Grant Number: IDA-E3820

Project ID NO:  P176924

Procurement Method: Individual Consultant Selection Method (IC)   

Reference No.   GM-CPCU-MOFEA-516922-CS-INDV

  1. Background:

The Gambia Public Administration Modernization for Citizen Centric Service Delivery Project (PAMP) supports the implementation of the Government program, the Recovery Focused National Development Plan (RF-NDP) 2023-2027. In January 2024, the GoTG approved and adopted the RF-NDP 2023-2027, i.e., program implementation is currently in its infancy. The RF-NDP aims to consolidate gains in democratic governance, accelerate green economic and social transformation, and build resilience to shocks and crises. It has three major strategic objectives: (1) building household and community resilience to address shocks and crises arising from climate change and economic volatility and to counter the effects of pandemics like COVID-19; (2) consolidating gains and addressing critical development gaps in governance and economic and social transformation; and (3) strengthening accountability, building partnerships and setting up robust and sustainable resource mobilization strategies for effective delivery of development actions and expected outcomes. The RF-NDP is organized across seven pillars.

The proposed PforR focuses on a subset of RF-NDP priority actions related to enhancing domestic resource mobilization and financial reporting, human resources management, and citizen engagement in the education sector. These include the second pillar on Governance Reforms priority actions to “enhance governance and management of civil society organizations” and “professionalize and instill meritocracy, ethical conduct, transparency and accountability in the public service and personnel management” and the third pillar on Macroeconomic Stability and Inclusive Growth priority action to “enhance Public Financial Management (PFM) for macro-fiscal stability and strengthening democracy.”

  1. Objective of The Assignment:

The Government of the Gambia (GoTG), through the Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs (MoFEA) has received a grant from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank, for the financing of the Public Administration Modernization for Citizen Centric Service Delivery Project (PAMP). Coordination and implementation of the PAMP is being undertaken by the Central Projects Coordination Unit (CPCU) of the MoFEA.

The Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education (MoBSE) and the Ministry of Health (MoH) are the two key service-delivery ministries selected to participate in the PAMP, that has a key objective to support service delivery in these two sectors of education and health.

The Program Development Objective (PDO) of PAMP is to enhance domestic resource mobilization, expenditure and human resource management, and mechanisms for citizen engagement. In turn, these reforms support downstream service delivery in the education and health sectors. The PDO is to be achieved through the delivery of activities measured by disbursement-linked indicators in three Results Areas; which are; Results Area 1: Strengthening Management of Public Revenues and Expenditures; Results Area 2: Strengthening the Public Administration and Results Area 3: Improved Transparency and Citizen Engagement in Service Delivery.

  1. Scope of Work:

Review capacity assessment of the governance (regulatory, institutional, technical, and financial) framework underpinning LECs absence/inability to be established or operate effectively, the concerns, and challenges across both the national and local government levels.

Preparation of a detailed and comprehensive report, including recommendations and implementation plan for the GoTG through the NEMC to establish and operationalize all LECs.

    1. Inception report
    2. Review of documents
    3. Stakeholder mapping
    4. Comprehensive analysis
    5. Stakeholder engagement and consultations
    6. Final report and recommendations

The full Terms of Reference (TOR) will be made available upon request

  1. Qualification and Competency
  • Master's degree from a recognized university in Environmental Management, Natural Resource Governance, Public Policy, Public Administration, Development Studies, Social Sciences, or a closely related field. Additional professional certifications in institutional capacity assessment, results-based management, or participatory planning are desirable.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience in institutional capacity assessments, organizational development, or governance strengthening assignments, preferably with public sector bodies or decentralized local government entities.
  • Demonstrated experience working with environmental management institutions, local government authorities (municipal or area councils), or community-based natural resource management structures in Sub-Saharan Africa. Experience in The Gambia or the West Africa region is a strong advantage.
  • Proven track record in assessing legal, regulatory, and institutional frameworks, including identifying gaps between policy mandates and operational capacity at local level. Experience referencing instruments such as the NEMA Amendment Bill 2025, the Local Government Act, or equivalent legislation in comparable jurisdictions is an advantage.
  • Experience designing practical institutional strengthening plans with clear recommendations, indicative costing, and realistic timelines.
  • Strong experience in designing and executing inclusive, participatory stakeholder mapping and consultation processes involving government ministries, local councils, civil society organizations, and community structures.

Full TOR Availability Notice

The full Terms of Reference (TOR) will be made available upon request. Please send your request via email to the addresses provided below. Contract duration is 3 months.

Submission of Expressions of Interest:

The Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs (MoFEA) through the Gambia Public Administration Modernization for Citizen Centric Service Delivery (PAMP) Project, through the National Environment Agency (NEA), now invites eligible individual consultants to express interest in providing the Services. Request for Expressions of Interest for Consulting Service

Country:        The Republic of the Gambia

Project Title: The Gambia Public Administration Modernization for Citizen Centric Service Delivery (PAMP) Project

Assignment Title: Recruitment of TA for the Strengthening, Updating and Preparation of ESIA Guidelines and procedures for Screening

Grant Number: IDA-E3820

Project ID NO:  P176924

Procurement Method: Individual Consultant Selection Method (IC)   

Reference No.   GM-CPCU-MOFEA-516921-CS-INDV

  1. Background:

The Gambia Public Administration Modernization for Citizen Centric Service Delivery Project (PAMP) supports the implementation of the Government program, the Recovery Focused National Development Plan (RF-NDP) 2023-2027. In January 2024, the GoTG approved and adopted the RF-NDP 2023-2027, i.e., program implementation is currently in its infancy. The RF-NDP aims to consolidate gains in democratic governance, accelerate green economic and social transformation, and build resilience to shocks and crises. It has three major strategic objectives: (1) building household and community resilience to address shocks and crises arising from climate change and economic volatility and to counter the effects of pandemics like COVID-19; (2) consolidating gains and addressing critical development gaps in governance and economic and social transformation; and (3) strengthening accountability, building partnerships and setting up robust and sustainable resource mobilization strategies for effective delivery of development actions and expected outcomes. The RF-NDP is organized across seven pillars.

The proposed PforR focuses on a subset of RF-NDP priority actions related to enhancing domestic resource mobilization and financial reporting, human resources management, and citizen engagement in the education sector. These include the second pillar on Governance Reforms priority actions to “enhance governance and management of civil society organizations” and “professionalize and instill meritocracy, ethical conduct, transparency and accountability in the public service and personnel management” and the third pillar on Macroeconomic Stability and Inclusive Growth priority action to “enhance Public Financial Management (PFM) for macro-fiscal stability and strengthening democracy.”

  1. Sectoral Context and Objective of The Assignment:   

Environmental and Social Impact Assessment is a major planning tool being implemented globally and primarily aimed at foretelling the possible negative impacts whilst enhancing the positives and promoting sustainable development. At Rio Earth Summit in 1992, state parties have been enjoined to put in place policy, legislative and institutional framework to ensuring environmental management. Also, state parties have been enjoined in implementing EIA as a planning tool to ensuring sustainable development.

Following through on this international commitment, The Gambia, has in 1992, developed it her premium policy on the environment- the Gambia Environment Action Plan (GEAP), which sought to engender an integrated approach to natural resources management, with a strong emphasis on the need to ensure that environmental considerations are factored in all national plans and projects for sustainability. The NEMA Amendment Bill 2025 PART VII requires the completion of environmental and social screening for all development projects with environmental and social impacts before implementation starts. The objective is to predetermine the extent of potential negative impacts, which in turn determines whether specific projects can be implemented at specific sites.

The EIA Guidelines 1999 and EIA Procedure 1999, are subsidiary instruments aimed at enhancing the requirements of Part V of the Act, as mentioned above, in the implementation of the EIA process in The Gambia. These documents, as the names imply, are guidance tools utilized by both the agency and ESIA consultants to guide the implementation of ESIA process in The Gambia. The tools outlined steps to be followed in screening, scoping, determination of categorization and undertaking of the impact study itself. Together with the NEMA Amendment Bill 2025 cited above, these instruments have proven essential to enabling the ESIA processing taking roots in The Gambia since inception in the early 1990s.

  1. Scope of Work:
  1. Scope of Services:
    • Review of the existing instruments – the EIA Procedures (1999) and EIA Guidelines (1999) – to identify gaps.
    • Carry out a literature review of similar instruments implemented in the sub-region and beyond, with a view to identifying and adopting best practices for implementation in The Gambia.
    • Conduct stakeholder engagement to capture valuable suggestions and inputs.
    • Prepare updated instruments: the EIA Procedure and EIA Guidelines.
    • Update the ESIA Guidelines and Procedures, including the screening form.
  1. Key Tasks:
    • Inception report:
    • Review of documents:
    • Stakeholder mapping:
    • Stakeholder engagement and consultations:
    • Updated instruments:
  1. Qualification and Competency
  • A relevant Master's degree (or higher) from a recognized university in Environmental Law, Environmental Management, Environmental Policy, Environmental Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum 12 years of relevant professional experience in environmental assessment, regulatory review, or environmental governance, of which at least 7 years must involve leading assignments of a similar nature, specifically the review or revision of ESIA guidelines, procedures, or equivalent regulatory instruments.
  • At least 2 completed assignments with demonstrable outputs involving the review or development of national EIA/ESIA regulatory frameworks, guidelines, or procedures. Brief descriptions of these assignments, including client, date, and scope, should be provided with the application.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in stakeholder mapping and participatory consultation, with demonstrated capacity to develop and execute a detailed strategy for engaging NEA, line ministries, the private sector, civil society organizations, and traditional authorities.
  • Proven drafting capacity, with ability to produce ESIA guidelines and procedures that are operationally practical, legally sound, and institutionally feasible for implementation in a public agency context.
  • Familiarity with the NEMA Amendment Bill 2025 and relevant Gambian environmental regulations is an advantage. Familiarity with World Bank Environmental and Social Standards (WB ESS) is also an advantage. Candidates are expected to review relevant instruments prior to commencement.
  • Ability to facilitate stakeholder engagement in local Gambian languages (Wolof, Mandinka, Fula, or others) is an advantage. Candidates without this capacity should demonstrate a clear and costed plan for working with qualified interpreters.

The full Terms of Reference (TOR) will be made available upon request. Please send your request via email to the addresses provided below. The assignment is expected to be completed within 3 months from the date of signing the contract.

Avis à Manifestation d’Intérêts : N°2026-5/PCH pour le recrutement d’un Spécialiste en Système d’Information et de                  

                                                          Gestion des bases de données au profit du Projet Capital Humain (PCH)

Sources de financement : E3990 – GW ; P179509 DONATIVO IDA

 

  1. Contexte

La République de Guinée-Bissau, par l'intermédiaire du Ministère de l'Économie, du Plan et de l'Intégration Régionale, a sollicité et obtenu de l'IDA/BM un don pour financer les coûts des activités du Projet Capital Humain, par l'intermédiaire de l'Unité de Gestion et de Coordination dudit Projet (UGCPCH) et entend utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer les paiements autorisés aux termes des contrats pour lesquels ce avis a été préparé, à savoir « recruter un (e) Spécialiste en Système d’Information et de Gestion des Bases de données au profit du Projet Capital Humain».

  1. Objectif

 L’objectif est d’appuyer le projet pour le renforcement du Système d’Information et de Système d’Information et de Gestion des Bases de Données des différentes activités

  1. Taches principales du spécialiste en SIG des bases de données

Placé sous l’autorité du Coordonnateur national, le spécialiste a pour mission principale d’appuyer le projet pour le renforcement du Système d’Information et de Système d’Information et de Gestion des Bases de Données des différentes activités

Le ou la spécialiste sera responsable de :

  • Exploiter et appuyer les utilisateurs dans l’exploitation des différentes applications du projet, y compris les modules du SIG relatifs au ciblage/identification des ménages (y compris le PMT et la validation), à l’enregistrement des bénéficiaires, au suivi des paiements et à la gestion des plaintes et recours.
  • Participer à la formation et à la supervision de collecte des données PMT dans les nouvelles zones d’intervention du projet, en garantissant la qualité et l’intégrité des données collectées;
  • Configurer, tester et déployer les applications du SIG, en coordination avec les développeurs et prestataires techniques, et assurer la documentation des applications pour les utilisateurs ;
  • Participer à la formation et à la supervision de la validation communautaire des ménages et assurer la formation et la supervision de l’enregistrement des personnes éligibles pour les TM dans les zones d’intervention du projet ;
  • Participer à l'implémentation et à la maintenance des applications et de l'infrastructure informatique (réseau informatique, système serveur et système de sécurité, du Système de Visio-conférence et du matériel informatique.) du projet ;
  • Garantir la sécurité, la confidentialité et la sauvegarde des données, conformément aux protocoles de protection des données.
  • Collaborer avec les prestataires de paiement pour assurer l’interopérabilité du SIG avec leurs systèmes d’information.
  • Gérer les comptes utilisateurs, profils et droits d’accès, selon les besoins opérationnels ;
  • Fournir une assistance technique continue aux équipes de terrain et partenaires sur l’utilisation du SIG et des outils de collecte numérique ;
  • Produire et diffuser des rapports réguliers et ad hoc issus du SIG pour appuyer la gestion du programme, le suivi et l’évaluation ;
  • Surveiller la performance du SIG et proposer des améliorations ou mises à jour en fonction des besoins
  • Assurer la programmation et la gestion d’outils de collecte de données, tels que KoboToolBox ou Survey Solutions, dans le cadre des activités du poste décrit
  • Développer une plateforme en ligne en adaptant le système SIG (Système Intégral de Gestion) du PRSSB, qui a été développé sous MS Access (pour les formulaires et rapports) et avec des tables reliées à SQL Server (pour les tables, vues et procédures). La première étape du processus consistera à adapter l’ancien SIG en remplaçant l’interface MS Access par une interface web, tout en préservant et en exploitant sa structure de base de données (tables, vues et procédures) développée dans SQL Server. Dans une deuxième phase, de nouveaux modules ainsi que des adaptations des modules existants seront demandés pour répondre aux nouvelles orientations du projet
  • Assurer une veille technologique et en cybersécurité afin de proposer des solutions innovantes, d’anticiper les risques informatiques et de renforcer en permanence la résilience du système d’information du projet.
  • Participer à l’élaboration et à la mise en œuvre des besoins informatiques du projet et des utilisateurs.

Pour plus de précisions bien vouloir se référer aux termes de références.

  1. Durée du contrat

Le/La spécialiste sera initialement recruté(e) pour une durée d'un an, avec une période probatoire de trois (03) mois. Le contrat pourra être prolongé d'année en année, sous réserve d'évaluations de performance satisfaisantes par le Coordinateur et avoir l’Avis de Non-Objection (ANO) de la Banque Mondiale (BM).

  1. Qualifications, compétences et expériences requises

Profil de l’expert : le (la) Spécialiste en Système d’Information et de Gestion des Bases de Données doit avoir les compétences et savoirs ci-dessous :

Savoir et compétences Le Spécialiste en Système d’Information et de Gestion des Bases de Données doit avoir les compétences et savoirs ci-dessous :

  • Être titulaire au moins d’un BAC + 4 en informatique/développeur ou équivalent.
  • Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins 5 ans dans le domaine de la Gestion des bases de données, de collecte de données et du développement d’applications web et mobile est requise ;
  • Une bonne maîtrise de l’administration de base de données ;
  • Une bonne maîtrise de la configuration des réseaux informatiques ;
  • Une bonne maîtrise du développement web et mobile ;
  • Maîtrise parfaite des langages UML, SQL, PHP et Python ;
  • Maîtrise parfaite des langages de développement et Framework tels que NodeJs, Html5, JAVASCRIPT, JQuery, Bootstrap, Symfony ;
  • Maîtrise parfaite de SGBD comme SQL SERVER, MYSQL, POSTGRESQL ;
  • Maîtrise parfaite des systèmes d’exploitation Linux/Unix et Windows ;
  • Maîtrise parfaite d’Android Studio, Apache Cordova, Ionic et Angular JS ;
  • Maîtrise parfaite des CMS WordPress ou Joomla.
  • Connaissance des plateformes d’enquête/de collecte de données telles que KoboToolBox et KoboCollect
  • Assurer une veille technologique en matière de cybersécurité et proposer des améliorations continues des dispositifs de protection des systèmes d'information et des bases de données.

Savoir être

  • Aisance relationnelle ;
  • Grande/forte capacité de communication ;
  • Excellente capacité d’analyse et qualités rédactionnelles élevées ;
  • Être apte physiquement à faire de fréquents déplacements dans sa zone d’intervention.

Savoir faire

  • Avoir une intégrité professionnelle et des aptitudes à travailler en équipe et sous pression ;
  • Avoir un esprit d’initiative et de rigueur dans le traitement des dossiers ;
  • Avoir un sens élevé de la gestion des priorités ;
  • Avoir des capacités de synthèse, d’analyse, de conceptualisation, et des facilités de rédaction ;
  • Avoir un sens élevé de l’organisation du travail et de l’anticipation ;
  • Avoir une maîtrise des principes de cybersécurité appliqués aux systèmes d'information, incluant la protection des infrastructures informatiques, la sécurisation des bases de données, la mise en œuvre des mécanismes de sauvegarde et de restauration, la gestion des accès, ainsi que la garantie de la confidentialité, de l'intégrité et de la disponibilité des données.
  1. Methode de selection

Le Spécialiste en Système d’Information et de Gestion des Bases de Données sera recruté sur la base de ses qualifications académiques et expériences professionnelles pertinentes, et de sa capacité à réaliser la mission. Le recrutement se déroulera en deux (02) phases que sont :

  • Présélection sur dossier
  • Entretien.
  1. Dossier de candidature

Le dossier de candidature comprendra obligatoirement :

  • Une lettre de motivation ;
  • Un curriculum vitae détaillé comportant des Noms et contacts de 03 personnes de références ;
  • Les attestations et/ou certificat de travail certifié pour les déclarations figurant dans le CV ;

Avis à Manifestation d’Intérêt pour le Recrutement de 3 ONG pour les sensibilisations et mobilisation des parents d'élèves et des communautés

Financement Projet N° P507220

Date de l’Avis : 31 Juillet 2026

D’une manière générale, l'Union des Comores à travers le Ministère de l’Education Nationale, de l’Enseignement, de la Recherche Scientifique, de la Formation et de l’Insertion Professionnelle s’associe et participe à l’Approche programmatique multi phase (APM) pour promouvoir des méthodes innovantes pour favoriser l’apprentissage en Afrique de l’est et australe. L’APM proposée, intitulée « Advancing Innovative Methods to Promote Learning » (AIM4Learning) ou Favoriser des méthodes innovantes pour promouvoir l’apprentissage, intègre des approches résolument nouvelles pour offrir une meilleure éducation aux élèves.

Cependant, l’Union des Comores a subi ces dernières années des chocs et des perturbations qui ont fortement impacté le système éducatif du pays, accentué les pertes d’apprentissages, les profondes inégalités scolaires et les risques d’exclusion scolaire des groupes les plus vulnérables. Il est nécessaire de rétablir et sauvegarder l’éducation en tant que droit fondamental, vecteur de développement, facteur de réduction de la pauvreté et levier puissant pour la paix, la résilience aux changements climatiques et au développement durable.

C’est ainsi que le Gouvernement comorien a obtenu un Don de l’Association International de Développement (IDA) et du Fonds du Partenariat mondial pour l’éducation équivalent à 23,7 millions de dollars pour répondre aux besoins du pays en matière d’amélioration et du renforcement de l’éducation pour l’amélioration des Résultats en Matière de Capital Humain aux Comores.

Elle a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce Don pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat portant sur la mission relative au « Recrutement de 3 ONG pour les sensibilisations et mobilisation des parents d'élèves et des communautés dont 1 ONG par île ».

2. Objectif de la mission

L’objectif général de la mission est de :

Renforcer l’engagement des parents et des communautés dans l’éducation, la santé et le bien-être des enfants à travers des activités structurées de sensibilisation communautaire dans les écoles ciblées par le projet.

Objectifs spécifiques

Les objectifs spécifiques sont :

  • Informer et sensibiliser les parents d’élèves sur l’importance de l’éducation et de la réussite scolaire des enfants ;
  • Promouvoir des pratiques favorables à la santé, l’hygiène et la nutrition des enfants ;
  • Encourager l’implication active des parents dans la vie scolaire et le suivi pédagogique des enfants ;
  • Renforcer le dialogue entre l’école, les parents et la communauté ;
  • Promouvoir des comportements favorables au bien-être et à la protection des enfants.

Zone d’intervention

Les activités seront mises en œuvre dans les écoles sélectionnées par le projet dans les trois îles de l’Union des Comores :

  • Ngazidja (Grande Comore)
  • Ndzouani (Anjouan)
  • Mwali (Mohéli)

La phase initiale pourra concerner environ 30 écoles, avec une extension progressive vers environ 80 écoles selon le phasage du projet.

L’ONG sera recrutée conformément au « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissements (FPI) Fournitures, Travaux, Services Autres que des Services de Consultants et Services de Consultants » 7ème Edition Septembre 2025.

RECRUTEMENT D’UN CABINET CHARGE DU RECRUTEMENT DU PERSONNEL DU PROJET DE DEVELOPPEMENT DE L’AVICULTURE ET DE L’AQUACULTURE AU CONGO (PD2AC)

Contexte

Dans le cadre de la préparation du Projet de Développement de l’Aviculture et de l’Aquaculture au Congo (PD2AC), la Banque mondiale, à travers le Mécanisme d’Octroi de Dons pour la Préparation de Projets (GFPP), a conclu le 30 septembre 2025 avec le Gouvernement de la République du Congo un Accord de Don, pour une durée de 18 mois dont la gestion est assurée par le Projet de création des activités économiques inclusives et résilientes au changement climatique (ProClimat). A cet effet, Une partie de ces fonds sera affectée au financement de l’activité relative au : « Recrutement d’un cabinet chargé du recrutement du personnel du Projet de Développement de l’Aviculture et de l’Aquaculture au Congo PD2AC ».

Objectifs de la mission

L’objectif général de la mission est d’assister le Gouvernement dans le recrutement transparent, compétitif et professionnel du personnel clé du Projet de Développement d’Aviculture et Aquaculture du Congo PD2AC.

De manière spécifique, le cabinet devra :

  • accompagner le Projet dans la conduite complète du processus de recrutement ;
  • assurer la transparence, l’équité et la confidentialité du processus ;
  • identifier et présélectionner des candidats qualifiés conformément aux profils requis ;
  • proposer les 3 meilleurs candidats pour chaque poste ;
  • garantir le respect des procédures nationales et des exigences de la Banque mondiale en matière de recrutement.

Profil du Consultant

 Le cabinet devra :

  • être légalement constitué (avec une forme juridique bien définie dans le RCCM ) ;
  • justifier d’au moins cinq (05) années d’expérience dans le recrutement de personnel ;
  • avoir une expérience avérée dans le recrutement du personnel de projets financés par les partenaires techniques et financiers, notamment la Banque mondiale ;
  • disposer d’une expertise en recrutement de profils techniques, fiduciaires, environnementaux et sociaux ;
  • avoir réalisé au moins trois (3) missions similaires au cours des cinq dernières années ;
  • disposer d’experts qualifiés en gestion des ressources humaines et en techniques de recrutement.
  • Une expérience dans les projets agricoles ou de développement rural sera un atout

Durée

La mission est prévue pour une durée de trois (3) mois à compter de la date de signature du contrat.

Processus de sélection

La sélection du Consultant se fera en accord avec les procédures définies dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement des Projets d’Investissements (FPI) de la Banque Mondiale, version de septembre 2025. La méthode de sélection à utiliser est Sélection basée sur la Qualification du consultant (SQC). A l’issue de l’évaluation des manifestations d’intérêt, seul le cabinet évalué le mieux qualifié sera invité à soumettre sa proposition technique et financière. Les consultants peuvent s’associer à d’autres firmes pour améliorer leurs qualifications, mais ils doivent indiquer clairement si l’association prend la forme d’un groupement et/ou d’une sous-traitance. Dans le cas d’un groupement, tous les membres du groupement d’entreprises seront solidairement responsables de l’ensemble du contrat, s’ils sont sélectionnés. Toutefois, le nombre des partenaires d’un groupement ne dépassera pas deux (2).

Les manifestations d’intérêts doivent être déposées sous plis fermé et accompagnées de version électronique (dernière version signée et scannée) à l’adresse ci-dessous au plus tard le 14 Août 2026 à 16 h précises, heure locale avec la mention : « Recrutement d’un cabinet chargé du recrutement du personnel du Projet de Développement de l’Aviculture et de l’Aquaculture au Congo PD2AC ».
